Me Talewukum

Judges

Igpewun-a

Introduction

Ka baseen te Me Talewukum, insaamul seini ne me guhuren te panugtulen te Israil puun te peglusud dan te Kanaan peendiye te timpu ne iyan e migmandu te Israil ka me Hari. Nahuhud te seini ne baseen ka dakel ne neyimu te me bahani ran ne ingngaranan te “Me talewukum.” Me pangulu te sundalu ka kasuluhan kandan, wey kene ne me talewukum sumale te pegsabut ta te seini ne lalag. Iyan amana neila si Samsun kandan langun. Ka neyimu rin diye egkabasa te kapitulu 13–16.

The document of Judges, these are gathered stories of Israil from their attacking of Kanaan up_to the time that the ones_ruling Israil were kings. It's told in this reading the big acts of their warriors that called “Judges.” Most of them were leaders of soldiers, and not judges according to our(incl) understanding of this word. Samsun is most recognized of them all. What he did will_be_read there at chapters 13–16.

Seini ka egkatuenan ta te seini ne baseen: miglampus ka Israil tenged su maparuma-ruma sikandan te suhu te Manama, piru ka pegpariyu dan kandin iyan nakarereet kandan. Andam layun ka Manama ne egluwas te keet-etawan din te timpu ne eg-inniyug sikandan te sale dan, wey eglibed eg-abey sikandan diye te kandin.

This is what we(incl) can learn on this reading: Israil succeeded because they followed_submissively of the command of God (MS Manama), but their distancing from him what caused_destruction of them. God is always ready to save his people at the time that they turn_back on their sins, and they will_return again there to him.

Ka pegdakep ki Adunibisik te kabuhalan enni Huda wey Simyun

The capturing of Adunibisik by the descendants of Huda and Simyun

11 Te migpatey e si Huswi, mig-inse e ka me Israilita diye te Magbebaye ne Manama ne miggenendue, “Hentew-a kanami ka eggun-a ne eggira te me matig-Kanaan?” 2 Ne migtabak ka Magbebaye ne Manama, “Iyan eggun-a ka me sundalu te me kabuhalan ni Huda su imbehey kud kandan ka tane.”

11 When Huswi died already, the Israilitas asked there to the Lord God saying, “Who among_us(excl) go_first to fight the (ones) from_Kanaan?” 2 And the Lord God answered, “What go_first were the armies/soldiers of the descendants of Huda because I have given_already to them the land.”

3 Ne ingkahiyan te me sundalu te me kabuhalan ni Huda ka me sundalu te me kabuhalan ni Simyun ne me karumaan dan, “Dumeyi key diye te tane ne intahahe kanami, wey egsabeka ki ka egkuntere te me matig-Kanaan. Ne egdumaan ney degma sikaniyu diye te intahahe ne tane para kaniyu.” Purisu indumaan sikandan te me sundalu te me kabuhalan ni Simyun. 4 Sikan naa, te peglusud te me sundalu ne me kabuhalan ni Huda wey ni Simyun, impatalu e te Magbebaye ne Manama kandan ka me matig-Kanaan wey ka me matig-Piris, wey natalu ran ka sapulu ne libu (10,000) ne etew diye te Bisik. 5 Ne neumaan dan si Adunibisik diye wey migpabunbunuey sikandan, wey natalu te me sundalu te me kabuhalan ni Huda ka me matig-Kanaan wey me matig-Piris. 6 Ne migpallahuy si Adunibisik, piru inlupug sikandin te me sundalu te me kabuhalan ni Huda, wey narakep dan sikandin. Ne impanempug dan ka me timbebakal te belad din wey te paa rin. 7 Ne migkahi si Adunibisik, “Insulian ad te Manama te inggimu ku te pitu ne pulu (70) ne me Hari ne impanempuhan ku te me timbebakal te belad dan wey te paa ran wey impepamurut ku te mummu diye te diralem te lamisa ku.” Ne in-uyan dan sikandin diye te Hirusalim wey diyad e sikandin migpatey.

3 And the armies/soldiers of the descendants of Huda said to the armies/soldiers of the descendants of Simyun who were their relatives, “Accompany us(excl) there in the land that's prepared for us(excl), and we(incl) will_unite in fighting the (ones) from_Kanaan. And we(excl) will_go with you(pl) also there on the land that's prepared for you(pl).” Therefore they were accompanied by the armies/soldiers of the descendants of Simyun. 4 That's why, on the attacking of the armies/soldiers of the descendants of Huda and of Simyun, the Lord God caused_them_to_defeat the (ones) from_Kanaan and the (ones) from_Piris, and they defeated ten thousand (10,000) people there at Bisik. 5 And they caught_up Adunibisik there and they fought_one_another, an the armies/soldiers of the descendants of Huda defeated the (ones) from_Kanaan and the (ones) from_Piris. 6 And Adunibisik ran_away, but he chased by the armies/soldiers of the descendants of Huda, and they were able_to_catch him. And they cut_off the thumbs of his hands and his feet. 7 And Adunibisik said, “God took_revenge on me of what_ I _did to the seventy (70) kings that I have cut_off the thumbs of their hands and feet and I caused_(them)_to pick_up crumbs under my table.” And they brought him there in Hirusalim and he died there.

Ka pegkaahew te Hirusalim wey te Hibrun

The snatching of Hirusalim and Hibrun

8 Ne inlusuran te me kabuhalan ni Huda ka Hirusalim wey naahew ran seini. Impangimatayan dan ka me mahinged wey insilaban dan ka siyudad. 9 Nataman, migpakiggire e man-e ka me kabuhalan ni Huda te me matig-Kanaan ne mig-ugpe diye te me bubungan, diye te inged te Nigib, wey diye te me napu dapit te iglineb. 10 Ne migpakiggira pad man-e ka me kabuhalan ni Huda te me matig-Kanaan ne diye mig-ugpe te siyudad te Hibrun (Kiryat-Arba dengan ka ngaran te Hibrun). Natalu ran ka me pangulu ne ensi Sisay, si Ahiman wey si Talmay.

8 And the descendants of Huda attacked Hirusalim and they snatched_ it _away. They killed the residents and they burned the city. 9 Afterwards, the descendants of Huda fought again with the (ones) from_Kanaan who lived there on the mountains, there in the place of Nigib, and there on the mountain on the side of east. 10 And the descendant of Huda fought again with the (ones) from_Kanaan who lived there in the city of Hibrun (Kiryat-Arba was the name of Hibrun long_ago.) They defeated the leaders Sisay, Ahiman and Talmay.

Ka pegkaahew ni Utnil te lungsud te Dibir

The snatching by Utniil of the city of Dibir

(Huswi 15:13‑19)

(Joshua 15:13‑19)

11 Puun diye, migpakiggira pad man-e sikandan te me mahinged te Dibir. (Kiriyiat-Sipir dengan ka ngaran te Dibir.) 12 Ne migkahi si Kalib, “Igpaasawa ku ka anak ku ne mengebay ne si Aksa, te etew ne eglusud wey egpakaahew te Kiryat-Sipir.” 13 Iyan nakaahew dutu si Utnil ne anak ni Kinis ne hari ni Kalib. Sikan naa ka impaasawe e ni Kalib ki Utnil ka mengebay ne anak din ne si Aksa. 14 Te nekeg-asawe e sikandan, imbanasalan ni Utnil si Aksa ne egpabuyuen te kamet diye te amey rin. Purisu miggendiye si Aksa ki Kalib, wey te nakalegsad e sikandin te asnu rin, mig-insaan e sikandin ni Kalib, “Nekey-a ka innendini nu?” 15 Ne migtabak si Aksa, “Egbuyu a te duma ne dasag su ka imbehey nu keddi ne tane diye te inged te Nigib, ware weyig.” Purisu, imbehayan sikandin ni Kalib te me sebseb ne diye te dibabew wey diye te diralem te Nigib.

11 From there, they fought again with the residents of Dibir. (Kiriyat-Sipir was the name of Dibir long_ago.) 12 And Kalib said, “I will_cause_ my unmarried child Aksa _to_marry, to a person who attacks and captures Kiryat-Sipir.” 13 And Utnil the child of Kinis who was Kalib's younger_brother (was) the (one who) captured it. Therefore Kalib caused_ his unmarried child Aksa _to_marry Utnil. 14 When they were married, Utnil urged Akas to ask for a field to her father. Therefore Aksa went to Kalib, and when she got_off from her donkey, Kalib asked her, “What did you(sg) come_here_for?” 15 And Aksa answered, “I am asking for another gift because the land that you(sg) have given me there in place of Nigib, has no water/river.” Therefore, Kalib gave her springs there on the upper and there in lower of Nigib.

Ka pegpanalu te me kabuhalan ni Huda wey ni Binhamin

The winning of the descendants of Huda and Binhamin

16 Ne due me Kinihanen ne me kabuhalan te anuhang dengan ni Muwisis. Migduma sikandan te kabuhalan ni Huda wey miggendiye sikandan te siyudad te me Palmira ne diye te disirtu diye te Huda. Ka seeye ne inged, diye te inged te Nigib ne marani te Arad, wey miglemung sikandan te me mahinged diye. 17 Ne migduma ka me kabuhalan ni Huda te me kabuhalan ni Simyun ne miglusud te me matig-Kanaan ne mahinged diye te Sipat. Ne ingguhus dan ka siyudad, sikan naa ka ingngaranan e ka siyudad te Hurma.[fn] 18 Naahew degma te kabuhalan ni Huda ka intiru ne sakup te Gasa, Askalun wey te Ikrun. 19 Ne migdumaan te Magbebaye ne Manama ka kabuhalan ni Huda, wey naahew ran ka me bubungan. Piru ware dan narelrel ka me mahinged diye te napu, su due me karwahi ran ne putew. 20 [xr]Ne imbehey ki Kalib ka Hibrun su sika ka inlalag ni Muwisis. Ne indelrel rin ka tatelu ne anak ni Anak ne nangugpe diye. 21 [xr]Piru ware narelrel te kabuhalan ni Binhamin ka me Hibusihanen ne diye nangugpe te Hirusalim. Sikan naa ka minsan kuntee miglemung ded mig-ugpe ka me Hibusihanen te kabuhalan ni Binhamin diye te Hirusalim.

16 And there were Kinihanons who were descendants of Muwisis' parent-in-law long_ago. They went_along_with the descendant of Huda and they went to the city of the Palms which is there in the desert there in Huda. That place, was there in the place of Nigib near Arad, and they lived_among the residents there. 17 And the descendants of Huda went_along_with the descendants of Simyun that attacked the (ones) from_Kanaan who resided there in Sipat. And they broke the city, that's why the city was called Hurma.[fn] 18 The descendant of Huda won_over also the entire territory of Gasa, Askalun and Ikrun. 19 And the Lord God went_along_with the descendant of Huda, and they won_over the mountains. But they were_ not _able_to_send_away the residents there in the plain, because they have iron chariots. 20 [xr]And Hibrun was_given to Kalib because that's what_ Muwisis _said. And he sent_away the children of Anak who resided there. 21 [xr]But the descendants of Binhamin were_ not _able_to_send_away the Hibusihanons who lived there in Hirusalim. That's why that even today the Hibusihanons still lived_among the descendants of Binhamin there in Hirusalim.

Ka peg-ahew te kabuhalan ni Husi te Bitil

The winning by the descendant of Husi with Bitil

22 Ne inlusuran te kabuhalan ni Husi ka Bitil, wey indumaan sikandan te Magbebaye ne Manama. 23 Ne migsuhu sikandan te me talag-iipat diye te Bitil. (Lus dengan ka ngaran te Bitil.) 24 Ne nakakita ka me talag-iipat te etew ne miglihawang puun te siyudad wey migkahiyan dan sikandin, “Panulua key ke egmenuwen te egseled te siyudad, eg-unahan ney re sikeykew.” 25 Ne impanulu din sikandan ke egmenuwen te egseled te siyudad, wey impangimatayan dan ka me mahinged diye te siyudad piru impalihawang dan ka seeye ne etew duma te langun ne pamilya rin. 26 Ne miggendiye ka seeye ne etew te tane te me Hitihanen, wey migpasasindeg sikandin te sabeka ne siyudad wey ingngaranan din te Lus, ne seeye ded ka ngaran taman kuntee.

22 And the descendant of Husi attacked Bitil, and the Lord God was with them. 23 And they sent spies there to Bitil. (Lus was the name of Bitil long_ago.) 24 And the spies saw a person who was coming_out from the city and they said to him, “Teach us(excl) how to enter the city, we'll just reward you(sg).” 25 And he taught them how to enter the city, and they killed the residents there in the city but they sent_out that person with all his family_members. 26 And that person went to the land of Hitihanons, and he made (LIT cause_to_stand) one city and he called (it) Lus, and that's still the name until today.

Ka me mahinged ne ware narelrel te me Israilita

The residents who were not sent_away by the Israilitas

27 [xr]Piru ware narelrel te kabuhalan ni Manasis ka me mahinged te me siyudad te Bitsan, Tanak, Dur, Ibliam, Migidu wey ka langun ne nangugpe diye te marani ne me bariyu. Piru warad iya mig-awe ka me matig-Kanaan te seeye ne inged. 28 Te migmaresen e ka me kabuhalan ni Israil, impehes dan ka me matig-Kanaan ne egpatrabahuwen, piru ware dan iya sikandan narelrel. 29 [xr]Ne ware narelrel te kabuhalan ni Ipraim ka me matig-Kanaan ne diye nangugpe te Gisir, purisu migpalemungey red sikandan ka nangugpe diye.

27 [xr]But the descendant of Manasis were_ not _able_to_send_away the residents of the cities of Bitsan, Tanak, Dur, Ibliam, Migidu and all who lived in the near villages. But the (ones) from_Kanaan did not leave on that place. 28 When the descendants of Israil became_powerful, they forced the (ones) from_Kanaan to work, but they were_ not _able_to_send_ them _away. 29 [xr]And the descendant of Ipraim were_ not _able_to_send_away the (ones) from_Kanaan who lived in Gisir, therefore they lived_together there.

30 Ne ware degma nareldel te kabuhalan ni Sabulun ka me mahinged te Kitrun, wey ka me mahinged te Nahalul. Migpalemungey red sikandan ka nangugpe dutu piru impehes dan sikandan patrabahuwa.

30 And the descendant of Subulun also were_ not _able_to_send_away the residents of Kitrun, and the residents in Nahalul. They still lived_together there but they were forced to work.

31 Ne ware ded degma nadelrel te kabuhalan ni Asir ka me mahinged te Aku, Sidun, Ahulab, Aksib, Hilba, Apik wey Rihub. 32 Purisu migpalemungey red degma ka kabuhalan ni Asir te me matig-Kanaan ne mig-ugpe te seeye ne me inged, ne ware dan narelrel.

31 And the descendant of Asir also were_ not _able_to_send_away the residents of Aku, Sidun, Ahulab, Aksib, Hilba, Apik and Rihub. 32 Therefore the descendant of Asir also lived_together with the (ones) from_Kanaan who lived on those places, which they were_ not _able_to_send_away.

33 Ne minsan ka kabuhalan ni Naptali ware degma nakadelrel te me mahinged te Bit-Simis wey Bit-Anat. Purisu, migpalemungey red ka kabuhalan ni Naptali te me matig-Kanaan. Ne impehes dan patrabahuwa seeye se mahinged te Bitsimis wey Bit-Anat.

33 And even the descendant of Naptali were also not able_to_send_away the residents of Bit-Simis and Bit-Anat. Therefore, the descendant of Naptali lived_together with the (ones) from_Kanaan. And they forced those residents of Bitsimis and Bit-Anat to work.

34 Piru natalu mule te me Amunihanen ka me kabuhalan ni Dan wey indelrel diye te bubungan eyew kene egpekeugpe diye te napu. 35 Ne ware mig-awe ka me Amurihanen diye te bubungan te Hiris, Ayalun, wey Salbim. Piru migmaresen ka kabuhalan ni Husi, sikan naa ka impehes dan sikandan patrabahuwa. 36 Ka eletanan te tane te me Amunihanen diye migbunsud te dalan patakereg te Akrabim taman diye te kewun-aan te Sila.

34 But the descendants of Dan on_the_contrary were_defeated by the Amunihanons and sent_away to the mountains so_that (they) can't live there in the valley. 35 And the Amurihanons didn't leave there in the mountain of Hiris, Ayalun, and Salbim. But the descendant of Husi become_strong, that's why they forced them to work. 36 The boundary of the land of the Amunihanons began there at the ascend path of Akrabim towards_ahead of Sila.

Ka panalihan te Manama diye te Bukim

The angel of God there at Bukim

21 Ne puun te Gilgal, miggendiye ka panalihan te Magbebaye ne Manama te Bukim wey ingkahiyan ka me Israilita, “Impalihawang ku sikaniyu puun te Ihiptu, wey in-uyan ku sikaniyu diye te tane ne insaad ku ne igbehey te kaap-apuan niyu. Ne migkahi a, ‘Kene ku egbalbalawan ka kasabutan ku kaniyu. 2 [xr]Ne kene kew himu te kasabutan te me mahinged te sika ne inged. Guhusa niyu ka me altar dan.’ Piru ware niyu tumana ka suhu ku. Mania te iling due ka inggimu niyu? 3 Sikan naa ka egkahiyan ku sikaniyu kuntee te kene ku egdeldelen sikandan due te kaniyu. Egpekeiling sikandan te duhi diye te egbayaan niyu, wey egpakasahilut kaniyu ka me diyus-diyus dan.” 4 Te nalalag e seeye te panalihan te Magbebaye ne Manama diye te langun ne Israilita, migpanaman-taman e sikandan migpaninehew. 5 Ne ingngaranan dan ka seeye ne inged te Bukim,[fn] wey diyad e sikandan migpanubad te Magbebaye ne Manama.

21 And from Gilgal, the angel of the Lord God went to Bukim and told the Israilitas, “I caused_ you(pl) _to_go_out from Ihiptu, and I brought you(pl) there in the land that I promised to give to your(pl) ancestors. And I said, ‘I will_ not _change my agreement with you(pl). 2 [xr]And don't(pl) make an agreement with the residents of this land/place. Destroy(pl) their altars.’ But you(pl) didn't fulfill my command. Why did you(pl) do like that? 3 That's why I will_tell you(pl) today that I won't send_away them from (LIT there) you(pl). They are_like thorns there in your(pl) way_going, and their false_gods will_ensnare you(pl).” 4 When the angel of the Lord God spoke it already there to all Israilitas, they cried intensely. 5 And they called that place Bukim,[fn] and there they sacrificed to the Lord God.

Ka pegpatey ni Huswi

The dying of Huswi

6 Te impeyipanew e ni Huswi ka me Israilita, miggendiyad e ka tagse kabuhalan te tane isip karatuan ne inggaat kandan eyew sikandan e ka egkamkamuney. 7 Migpamakey te Magbebaye ne Manama ka me kabuhalan ni Israil te timpu ne neuyag pad si Huswi. Ne minsan te migpatey e si Huswi, migpabulus ded man-e sikandan migpamakey te Magbebaye ne Manama taheed te neuyag pad ka me igbuyag dan ne nakakita te langun ne kein-inuwan ne inggimu te Magbebaye ne Manama diye te Israil. 8 Ne migpatey ka suluhuanen te Magbebaye ne Manama ne si Huswi ne anak ni Nun, te mahatus wey sapulu (110) ne leg-un ka idad din. 9 [xr]Inlebeng dan sikandin diye te eletanan te tane ne imbehey kandin diye te Timnat-Hiris, ne diye te bubungan te Ipraim, ne egpakarapit te igkahibang ne balabahan ne dapit te igsile te bubungan te Gaas.

6 When Huswi caused_ the Israilitas _to_go, each descendant went to the land as wealth_left_behind to them so_that they will_be_ the (ones) _to_own_it. 7 The descendants of Israil served the Lord God at the time when Huswi was still alive. And even when Huswi died already, they also continued serving the Lord God while the elders were_ still _alive who had_seen all the amazing_things did by the Lord God there in Israil. 8 And the servant of the Lord God Huswi child of Nun died, when he was one hundred ten (110) years. 9 [xr]They buried him there at the boundary (LIT ending) of the land given to him there in Timnat-Hiris, which is there on the mountains of Ipraim, on the north (LIT left corner on the east side) of the mountain of Gaas.

Ka peg-engked te pegpamakey te me Israilita

The stopping of Israilitas in serving

10 Te migpatey e ka langun ne etew te seeye ne kabuhalan, warad nekeila te Magbebaye ne Manama ka nakasinundul ne kabuhalan ne ware kalintahaan te immangimu te Manama diye te Israil. 11 Miggimu ka me Israilita te mareet diye te tangkaan te Magbebaye ne Manama wey migpamakey sikandan te me larawan ni Baal. 12 In-engkeran dan ka Magbebaye ne Manama te kabuybuyahan dan ne iyan migpalihawang kandan puun te Ihiptu. Mig-ikul sikandan wey migsimba te me diyus-diyus te me etew ne nakalingut kandan; impeyibelu dan ka Magbebaye ne Manama. 13 In-engkeran dan ka Magbebaye ne Manama, wey migpamakey e sikandan te me larawan te diyus-diyus ne si Baal wey Astarut. 14 Ne tenged te nangebel-ebel ne langet te Magbebaye ne Manama te me Israilita, imbalahad din e sikandan ne egpanlusuran te me kuntere ne egpangahew te me karatuan dan. Intuhutan din e sikandan ne egkatalu te me kuntere ne nakalingut kandan, wey warad egpakapangabang kandan puun te me kuntere dan. 15 Minsan hendei egpakiggira ka me kabuhalan ni Israil, egkatalu sikandan su imbalahad man e sikandan te Magbebaye ne Manama iling te impaney-paney rin kandan, wey impahunlibet din kandan. Sikan naa ka amana miglised sikandan.

10 When all the people of that generation (LIT descendants) died already, the following generation (LIT descendants) no_longer able_to_recognize the Lord God who didn't know what_ God _has_done there in Israil. 11 The Israilitas did bad_things there in front of the Lord God and they served the statues of Baal. 12 They left the Lord God of their elder(s) who caused_ them _to_exit Ihiptu. They followed and worshiped false_gods of the people who were around them; they provoked the Lord God to be angry. 13 They left the Lord God, and they served the two statues of false_gods Baal and Astarut. 14 And due to the smoking anger of the Lord God to the Israilitas, he abandoned them already to be_attacked by the enemies who take_away their riches. He allowed them to be defeated by the enemies around them, and nobody was_able_to_help them from their enemies. 15 Wherever the descendants Israil fought, they will_be_defeated because the Lord God abandoned them already like what_ he _warned them, and what_ he _sworn them. That's why they suffered much.

16 Ne mig-alam ka Magbebaye ne Manama te me pangulu,[fn] ne iyan egluwas kandan puun te seeye se egpangahew te me karatuan dan. 17 Piru minsan pad due, ware sikandan migpammineg te me pangulu ran.[fn] Ware sikandan migmatinumanen te Manama wey nasi migsimba te me diyus-diyus. Kene sikandan ne iling te me kaap-apuan dan, tenged su mahaan de sikandan eg-inniyug te me suhu te Magbebaye ne Manama ne in-ikul dengan te me kaap-apuan dan. 18 Indumaan te Magbebaye ne Manama ka langun ne pangulu ne in-alam din. Ne taheed te neuyag pad ka me pangulu ran, egluwasen din sikandan puun te me kuntere dan. Tenged su igkeyid-u rin ka keet-etawan din ne egdeg-uy tenged te pegbayad-bayad wey te pegpanleig-leig kandan. 19 Piru te timpu ne napatey e ka pangulu, miglibed e man-e ka me etew te subla pad ne mareet ne hinimuwan dan ne iyan ka pegpamakey wey pegsimba te me diyus-diyus. Nasublaan dan pad ka sale te me kaap-apuan dan. Ne ware sikandan mig-engked ka miggimu te maddeet wey te pegpakehal ran te me ulu ran. 20 Sikan naa ka nangebel-ebel ka langet te Magbebaye ne Manama te me Israilita. Migkahi sikandin, “Tenged su insupak te seini ne me keet-etawan ka kasabutan ne inggimu ku te me kaap-apuan dan, wey ware dan tumana ka me suhu ku, 21 kene kud e igpariyu kandan ka me etew diye te inged ne ware nasakup ni Huswi te neuyag pad sikandin. 22 Eggamiten ku sikandan eyew te peg-eleg-eleg te me Israilita, ke egtumanen dan naa ka me suhu ku iling te inggimu te me kaap-apuan dan.” 23 Sikan ka intuhutan te Magbebaye ne Manama ne egpalunggehaat ka seeye ne me etew te seeye ne inged, ware din sikandan ga-gaani te egdeldel, wey ware din tuhuti ne egkatalu sikandan ni Huswi.

16 And the Lord God chose leaders,[fn] who will_save them from those who take_away their riches. 17 But despite of this, they didn't listen to their leaders.[fn] They didn't become_obedient to God and instead they worshiped false_gods. They were not like their ancestors, because they are quickly_turned_away_the commands of the Lord God which were followed long_ago by their ancestors. 18 The Lord God accompanied all the leaders that he chose. And while their leaders were_ still _alive, he will_rescue them from their enemies. Because he pities on his people that groaned due to hardshipping and oppressing of them. 19 But at the time when the leader(s) died already, the people returned again to their more wicked actions which was serving and worshiping false_gods. They surpassed with the sin of their ancestors. And they didn't stop doing bad_things and their hardening of their heads. 20 That's why the anger of the Lord God smoked to the Israilitas. He said, “Because these people disobeyed the agreement that I made to their ancestors, and they didn't fulfill my commands, 21 I won't put_away from them the people who are in the place that was not defeated (LIT put_as_a_member) by Huswi when he was_still_alive. 22 I will_use them in_order to test the Israilitas, if they will_fulfill my commands like what_ their ancestors _did.” 23 That's why the Lord God allowed that those people to remain in that place, he didn't send_ them _away quickly, and he didn't allow that they will_be_defeated by Huswi.

Ka nasame ne keet-etawan te Kanaan

The remaining people of Kanaan

31 Inggaat te Magbebaye ne Manama ka seeye ne keet-etawan eyew te peg-eleg-eleg te seeye se langun ne Israilita ne ware pad nakaheram ne egpakiggira diye te Kanaan. 2 Inggimu rin de seeye eyew egpanuluen ka me Israilita ne egkabasbas sikandan se ware pad nakaheram ne egpakiggira. 3 Seini ka nasame ne keet-etawan: ka me Pilistihanen ne nangugpe te lalimma ne siyudad, ka langun ne Kanaanen, ka me Sidunihanen, ka me Hibihanen ne diye nangugpe te me bubungan te Libanun, puun de iya te bubungan te Baal-Hirmun taman diye te Libu-Hamat. 4 Insame sikandan eyew ig-eleg-eleg te me Israilita te pegnengneng ke eg-ikulen dan naan ded ka me suhu ne impabehey te Magbebaye ne Manama ki Muwisis diye te me kaap-apuan dan. 5 Su miglemung ma ka me Israilita te me Kanaanen, me Hitihanen, me Pirisihanen, me Hibihanen, wey te me Hibusihanen. 6 Ne migmangasawa sikandan te me mengebay te duma ne me kabuhalan, wey impaasawa ran ka me mengebay ran te me kanakan te seeye ne me kabuhalan wey migpamakey e sikandan te me diyus-diyus dan.

31 The Lord God left those people in_order that to test all the Israilitas who didn't tried warring there in Kanaan. 2 He just did it to teach the Israilitas that those who haven't tried warring they will_be_trained. 3 These (are) the people left: the Pilistihanons who lived in five cities, the all Kanaanons, the Sidunihanons, the Hibihanons who lived there in the mountains of Libanun, from the mountain of Baal-Hirmun up_to the Libu-Hamat. 4 They were left in_order to test the Israilitas in knowing if they will_follow the commands that the Lord God caused_ Muwisis _to_give to their ancestors. 5 Because the Israilitas lived_among the (ones) from_Kanaan, Hitihanons, Pirisihanons, Hibihanons, and Hibusihanons. 6 And they married unmarried_women of_the other descendants, and they caused_ their unmarried_women _to_marry unmarried_men of those descendant and they served their false_gods.

Ka pangulu ne si Utnil

The leader Utnil

7 Ne miggimu ka me Israilita te mareet diye te tangkaan te Magbebaye ne Manama; imbalahad dan e sikandin, wey migpamakey e sikandan te me diyus-diyus ne me Baal wey me Asira. 8 Purisu, nangebel-ebel ka langet te Magbebaye ne Manama diye te me Israilita, wey intuhutan din sikandan ne egkatalu ni Kusan-Risataim ne Hari te Misuputamya. Ne nasakup din ka me Israilita te walu ne leg-un. 9 Ne migpangananey ka me Israilita diye te Magbebaye ne Manama, wey mig-alam sikandin te etew ne egluwas kandan ne iyan si Utnil ne anak ni Kinis ne hari ni Kalib. 10 Ne immanduan sikandin te Panisingan te Magbebaye ne Manama, wey neyimu sikandin ne pangulu[fn] te Israil. Ne migpakiggira sikandin ki Kusan-Risataim ne Hari te Misuputamya, wey impepanalu sikandan te Magbebaye ne Manama. 11 Sikan naa ka ware samuk te Israil te hep-at ne pulu (40) ne leg-un. Ne nataman, migpatey e si Utnil ne anak ni Kinis.

7 And the Israilitas did bad_things in front of the Lord God; they abandoned him, and they served the false_gods Baal and Asira. 8 Therefore, the anger of the Lord God smoked against (LIT there) the Israilitas, and he allowed them to be defeated by Kusan-Risataim the king of Misuputamya. And the Israilitas put_under_ his _authority for eight years. 9 And the Israilitas asked_for_help to the Lord God, and he chose a person that will_rescue them who was Utnil the child of Kinis who was the younger_brother of Kalib. 10 And the Spirit of the Lord God commanded him, and he became leader[fn] in Israil. And fought with Kusan-Risataim the king of Misuputamya, and the Lord God caused_ him _to_win. 11 That's why there_was_no commotion in Israil for forty (40) years. And then, Utnil the child of Kinis died.

Ka pangulu ne si Ihud

The leader Ihud

12 Ne miggimu ka me Israilita te mareet diye te tangkaan te Magbebaye ne Manama. Tenged te inggimu ran, impeuripen sikandan te Magbebaye ne Manama diye ki Iglun ne Hari te Muwab. 13 Migpabulig si Iglun te me Amunihanen wey me Amalikanen. Ne inlusuran dan ka Israil wey natalu ran seini, wey naahew ran ka siyudad te me Palmira. 14 Ne migtrabahu ka me Israilita para ki Iglun ne Hari te Muwab te sapulu wey walu (18) ne leg-un.

12 And the Israilitas did bad_thing there in front of the Lord God. Because of what_ they _did, the Lord God caused_ them _to_be_slaves of Iglun the king of Muwab. 13 Iglun asked_help from the Amunihanons and Amalikanons. And they attacked Israil and they defeated it, and they won_over the city of the Palms. 14 And the Israilitas worked for Iglun the king of Muwab for eighteen (18) years.

15 Ne migpangananey e man-e ka me Israilita diye te Magbebaye ne Manama. Ne mig-alam sikandin te egluwas kandan ne iyan si Ihud, gibang sikandin wey anak ni Gira ne puun te kabuhalan ni Binhamin. Ne si Ihud naa ka egsugsuhuen te me Israilita ne egparulungen te buhis dan diye ki Iglun ne Hari te Muwab. 16 Te ware pad migligkat si Ihud, migsayab pad sikandin te mahalang ne sundang ne liware te mitrus ka kalayat, wey inggiket din seini diye te kawanan ne bubun din ne nabunbunan te kumbale din. 17 Ne in-uyan din e ka buhis diye ki Iglun ne Hari te Muwab. Lelambehi ne etew si Iglun. 18 Te nakabehey e ni Ihud ka buhis, impeuli din e ka me etew ne duma rin ne mig-uyan te buhis. 19 Migduma pad sikandin kandan, piru te diyad e sikandan te me larawan ne me batu ne marani te Gilgal, migpalilibed si Ihud diye te Hari wey migkahi, “Mahal ne Hari, due igguhud ku keykew ne sikanta re.”

15 And the Israilitas asked_for_help to the Lord God again. And he chose someone_to_save them who was Ihud, he is left_handed and child of Gira from the descendant(s) of Binhamin. And Ihud was the one_frequently_asked by the Israilitas to send their tax to Iglun the king of Muwab. 16 Before Ihud started_walking, he forged a sharp two_edged_knife which was half meter long, and he tied it on his right thigh which was_covered by his cloth. 17 And he brought the tax there to Iglun the king of Muwab. Iglun was very fat person. 18 When Ihud was_able_to_give the tax, he caused_ the people who were his companions that brough the tax _to_go_home. 19 He went_along_with them yet, but when they were there already at the statues of stones that's near Gilgal, Ihud returned to the king and said, “Beloved king, I have something_to_tell you(sg) that's only us(excl).”

Ne ingkahiyan te Hari ka me sinalihan din, “Awe kew pa.” Ne nanlihawang e ka langun ne sinalihan din.

And the king said to his trusted (ones), “Go_out(pl).” And all the trusted (ones) went_out.

20 Taheed te migsabsabeka re ka Hari ne migpinpinnuu te sinabeng din ne diye te atep,[fn] migparani si Ihud kandin wey migkahi, “Due igguhud ku keykew ne migpuun te Manama.” Te egsasindeg e ka Hari, 21 inggulabut e ni Ihud te gibang ne belad din ka mahalang ne sundang diye te kawanan ne bubun din, wey indugsu din e seini te getek te Hari. 22 Naalep-alep ka sundang lagkes ka subeng wey mig-abas seini diye te peka te Hari wey nabukusan te tabe din. Ne warad seini baruta ni Ihud. 23 Ne impanlekeban e ni Ihud ka me gumawan wey impamagulan din e seini, wey diyad sikandin migbaye te gumawan ne diye te liyu ka migpallahuy. 24 Te nakaayun e sikandin, nangingume e ka me sinalihan te Hari wey nakita ran ne nalekeban ka me gumawan te sinabeng diye te dibabew, nakakahi sikandan te, “Mig-indes bu re sikandin diye te liyuan din.” 25 Migtetahad sikandan diye te lihawangan. Piru te nalingengen e sikandan ka egtetahad, nabantalan e sikandan su ware ma miglulukat ka Hari te me gumawan te sinabeng. Purisu, in-angey ran ka yabi wey impanlukatan dan e ka me gumawan. Ne iyan dan en iya nakita ka Hari dan ne nakabahed de diye te seeg ne napatey e.

20 While the king was alone sitting in his room there on the roof,[fn] Ihud came_near to him and said, “There's something_ that I _tell you(sg) from God.” When the king was about_to_stand, 21 Ihud pulled_out the sharp two_edged_knife there on his right thigh with his left hand, and he stabbed it there in the king's stomach. 22 It penetrated_deep even the handle of the two_edged_knife and it penetrated_over there at king's back and it was covered with his fats. And Ihud didn't draw_ it _out. 23 And Ihud closed the doors and locked it, and he went_out running there at the back door. 24 When he was away already, the trusted (ones) of the king came and they saw that the doors of the room there on the top were closed, they were able_to_say, “Maybe he_just_defecating there at his toilet.” 25 They waited there at the outside. But when they waited long already, they were worried because the king didn't open the doors of the room. Therefore, they took the key and they opened the doors. And what they saw was the king lying there on the floor that dead already.

26 Ne taheed te natalehen sikandan, migpallahuy e si Ihud. Miglihad sikandin diye te liyu te me larawan ne me batu wey migpallahuy sikandin peendiye te inged ne Siira. 27 Te miggingume e sikandin diye, imparahing din e ka trumpita[fn] diye te bubungan te Ipraim eyew te peg-umew te me Israilita. Ne migtupang e ka me Israilita puun te me bubungan, wey impanguluwan din sikandan. 28 Ne migkahi sikandin, “Sinundul kew keddi! Su impepanalu kew e te Magbebaye ne Manama te me Muwabihanen ne me kuntere niyu.” Sikan naa ka migsinundul e sikandan kandin ka migpanupang wey naahew ran ka lapasanan te me Muwabihanen peendiye te Hurdan. Ne ware minsan sabeka ne impalapas dan dutu. 29 Te seeye ne aldew, nakapatey sikandan te sapulu ne libu (10,000) ne me Muwabihanen ne neelin ne mannekal. Ne ware minsan sabeka ne etew ne nakapallahuy. 30 Te seeye ded ne aldew, natalu te me Israilita ka me Muwabihanen, wey ware samuk te Israil te walu ne pulu (80) ne leg-un.

26 And while they were delayed, Ihud ran_away. He passed_over there at the back of the statues of stones and he ran_away going_to the place Siira. 27 When he arrived there, he sounded the trumpet[fn] there at the mountain of Ipraim in_order to call the Israilitas. And the Israilita went_downhill from the mountains, and he led them. 28 And he said, “Follow(pl) me! Because God caused_ the Muwabihanons _to_be_defeated by you(pl).” That's why they followed him going_down and they won_over the ford of the Muwabihanons going_to Hurdan. And there's_no one that they caused_to_cross there. 29 On that day, they killed ten thousand (10,000) Muwabihanons who were_all strong. And there's_no one person able_to_run_away. 30 On that day also, the Israilitas defeated the Muwabihanons, and there_was_no commotion in Israil for eighty (80) years.

Ka pangulu ne si Samgar

The leader Samgar

31 Ne due nakasinundul ki Ihud ne pangulu ne iyan si Samgar ne anak ni Anat. Inluwas din degma ka Israil puun te me Pilistihanen. Nakapatey sikandin te hen-em ne gatus (600) ne me Pilistihanen ne iyan din de inggamit ka tuked ne ig-alew te baka.

31 And there's a leader who followed Ihud who was Samgar the child of Anat. He rescued Israil also from the Pilistihanons. He was_able_to_kill six hundred (600) Pilistihanons by using a staff for sending_away the cattle.

Ka me pangulu ne ensi Dibura wey Barak

The leaders Dibura and Barak

41 Te migpatey e si Ihud, miggimu e man-e ka me Israilita te mareet diye te tangkaan te Magbebaye ne Manama. 2 Sikan naa ka intuhutan sikandan te Magbebaye ne Manama ne egkatalu ni Habin ne Hari te Kanaan ne iyan migmandu te siyudad te Hasur. Iyan pangulu te me sundalu ni Habin, si Sisira ne mig-ugpe diye te Harusit-Ha-Guwim. 3 Si Habin due siyam ne gatus (900) ne karwahi ne putew. Ne imbaybayaran din ka me Israilita te daruwa ne pulu (20) ne leg-un. Purisu migpangananey te Magbebaye ne Manama ka me Israilita.

41 When Ihud died, the Israilitas did bad_thing again there in front of the Lord God. 2 That's why the Lord God allowed them to be defeated by Habin the king of Kanaan the (one who) ruled the city of Hasur. The leader of the soldier of Habin, was Sisira who lived there at Harusit-Ha-Guwim. 3 Habin had nine hundred (900) iron chariots. And he hardshipped the Israilitas for twenty (20) years. Therefore the Israilitas asked_for_help to the Lord God.

4 Te seeye ne timpu, si Dibura ka pangulu[fn] te Israil, malitan sikandin ne prupita wey asawa ni Lapidut. 5 Nabatasan din ne egpinpinnuu te diralem te kayu ne palmira, ne diye te elat-elat te Rama wey te Bitil ne diye te bubungan te Ipraim. Ne egmangendiye naa te kandin ka me Israilita ne egpewusey. 6 Sabeka ne aldew, impeumew rin si Barak ne anak ni Abinaum ne diye mig-ugpe te Kidis ne sakup te inged te Naptali. Te pegginguma ni Barak, ingkahiyan e sikandin ni Dibura, “Insuhu ka te Magbebaye ne Manama te Israil ne egparurumeen ka te sapulu ne libu (10,000) ne lukes te me kabuhalan ni Naptali wey ni Sabulun, wey hendiye kew te bubungan te Tabur. 7 Egpeendiyeen te Magbebaye si Sisira ne pangulu te me sundalu ni Habin eyew egpakiggira kaniyu diye te Weyig ne Kisun duma te me karwahi rin wey me sundalu rin, piru egpepanaluwen kew te Magbebaye te peggira niyu kandan.”

4 At that time, Dibura (was) the leader[fn] in Israil, she was a woman prophet and spouse of Lapidut. 5 She's accustomed to sit under the palm tree, which was between Rama and Bitil at the mountain of Ipraim. And the Israilitas would_go to her to take_settlements. 6 One day, he summoned Barak the child of Abinaum who lived in Kidis which under_the_jurisdiction in place of Naptali. On Barak's arrival, Dibura told him, “The Lord God of Israil command you(sg) to have_ ten thousand (10,000) men from the descendants of Naptali and Sabulun _accompany you(pl), and go(pl) to the mountain of Tabur. 7 The Lord will_cause_ Sisira the leader of the soldiers of Habin _to_go_there in_order to fight you(pl) there at the Kisun River with his chariots and his soldiers, but the Lord God cause_ them _to_be_defeated by you(pl).”

8 Ne ingkahiyan ni Barak si Dibura, “Eggendiya a ke egduma ka keddi; piru ke kene ka egduma keddi, kena a eggendiye.”

8 And Barak told Dibura, “I will_go_there if you(sg) come with me; but if you(sg) won't accompany me, I won't go_there.”

9 Ne migtabak si Dibura, “Uya, egduma a keykew. Piru kene ne sikeykew ka egkabantug te seini ne gira, su egtuhutan te Magbebaye ne Manama ne egkatalu si Sisira te malitan.” Seeye naa, migsasindeg si Dibura wey migdume e ki Barak te egpeendiye te Kidis. 10 Ne impeumew ni Barak ka me kabuhalan ni Sabulun wey ni Naptali ne egpeendiyeen te Kidis. Sapulu ne libu (10,000) ne sundalu ka migduma kandin, wey migduma degma kandin si Dibura.

9 And Dibura answered, “Yes, I will_accompany you(sg). But it is not you(pl) who will_become_famous on this war, because the Lord God will_allow Sisira to be defeated by a woman.” So then, Dibura got_up and accompanied Barak going to Kidis. 10 And Barak summoned the descendant of Sabulun and Naptali to go_there to Kidis. Ten thousand (10,000) soldiers accompanied him, and Dibura accompanied him also.

11 Te seeye ne timpu, migpariyu si Hibir te me karumaan din ne me Kinihanen ne me kabuhalan ni Hubab ne uyang ni Muwisis. Impasasindeg din ka balungbalung din diye te lenged te kayu ne uk diye te Saananim ne marani te Kidis.

11 At that time, Hibir distanced from his Kinihanons relatives who were descendants of Hubab the brother-in-law of Muwisis. He erected his tent there the near of the uk tree in Saananim which was near Kidis.

12 Te natahaan ni Sisira ne migtakereg si Barak ne anak ni Abinuam diye te bubungan te Tabur, 13 inlibulung din e ka siyam ne gatus (900) ne karwahi rin ne putew wey ka langun ne sundalu rin. Migligkat sikandan puun te Harusit-Ha-Guwim peendiye te Weyig ne Kisun.

12 When Sisira knew that Barak the child of Abinuam went_up the mountain of Tabur, 13 he gathered his nine hundred (900) iron chariots and all his soldiers. They departed from Harusit-Ha-Guwim going to Kisun River.

14 Ne migkahiyan ni Dibura si Barak, “Hipanew kad! Seini ka aldew ne igpatalu te Magbebaye ne Manama si Sisira keykew. Eggun-a iya keykew ka Magbebaye ne Manama!” Purisu migtupang e si Barak puun te Bubungan ne Tabur duma te sapulu ne libu (10,000) ne sundalu rin. 15 Te peglusud ni Barak wey te me sundalu rin, inlibeg e te Magbebaye ne Manama si Sisira wey ka langun ne nanguntud te me karwahi, wey ka me sundalu. Ne migpamaneug si Sisira te karwahi rin wey migpallahuy. 16 Ne intalukunan enni Barak ka me sundalu lagkes ka migmanguntud te me karwahi taman diye te Harusit-Ha-Guwim. Impangimatayan dan ka me sundalu ni Sisira wey warad iya minsan sabeka ne nasame.

14 And Dibura told Barak, “Go_now! This is the day that the Lord God cause_ Sisira _to_be_defeated by you(sg). The Lord God will_ really _go_ahead of you(sg)!” That's why Barak went_down from the mountains of Tabur together with his ten thousand (10,000) soldiers. 15 On Barak's attacking and his soldiers, the Lord God confused Sisira and all the riders of chariots, and the soldiers. And Sisira stepped_down of his chariot and ran_away. 16 And Barak and_company chased the soldiers including the ones_riding the chariots until there at Harusit-Ha-Guwim. They killed the soldiers of Sisira and no_(one) indeed even one was left.

17 Piru migpallahuy si Sisira peendiye te balungbalung ni Hail ne asawa te Kinihanen ne si Hibir. Inggimu seeye ni Sisira tenged su talag-alukuy ma si Habin ne Hari te Hasur ki Hibir. 18 Ne miglihawang si Hail ka egsinug-ung ki Sisira wey migkahi, “Hendini ka ahalen, seled ka kayi te balungbalung ku. Kene ka kaaldek.” Sikan naa ka migseled e sikandin diye te balungbalung te malitan, wey impules e sikandin ni Hail te ulesen eyew iggeles.

17 But Sisira ran_away going_to the tent of Hail the spouse of the Kinihanon who was Hibir. Sisira did it because Habin the king of Hasur and Hibir were friends. 18 And Hail went_out to meet Sisira nd said, “Come_here master, get_inside my tent. Don't(sg) be_afraid.” That's why he entered there in the tent of the woman, and Hail covered him with a blanket in_order to hide (him).

19 Ne migkahiyan sikandin ni Sisira, “Behayi a ubag te weyig ne egkeinum su nammaraan a.” Ne impuwasan ni Hail ka laplap ne tahuanan te gatas wey impeinum din e sikandin. Ne impules din e man-e sikandin te ulesen. 20 Ne migkahiyan e man-e sikandin ni Sisira, “Sasindeg ka due te gumawan te balungbalung. Ne emun ke due etew ne egginguma wey eg-inse keykew ne eggenendue, ‘Due etew kayi?’ Tabaka nu, ‘Ware.’ ”

19 And she was_told by Sisira, “Please give me a water to drink because I am thirsty.” And Hail opened the skin container of milk and she caused_ him _to_drink. And she covered him again with blanket. 20 And she was_told again by Sisira, “Stand(sg) there at the entrance of the tent. And if there's a person comes and asks you(pl) saying, ‘Is there a person here?’ Answer(sg)_him, ‘None.’ ”

21 Piru migkuwa mule si Hail te dunsul wey pes-ek te balungbalung, wey migpahanad-ganad sikandin migparani ki Sisira taheed te newulep-hulep su nabeley amana. Ne impalpal din ka pes-ek te balungbalung diye te ulu ni Sisira taman te mig-abas seini diye te tane wey napatey e si Sisira. 22 Te miggingume e si Barak ka egpanalukun ki Sisira, miglihawang e si Hail ka egsinug-ung kandin wey migkahi, “Hendini ka, igpakita ku keykew ka etew ne impamitew nu.” Sikan naa ka miglasud e si Barak. Ne iyan din e nakita si Sisira ne nakabahed de ne napatey e. Ne ka pes-ek te balungbalung nakapalpal pad diye te ulu rin.

21 But Hail on_the_contrary took a hammer and peg of the tent, and she drew_near to Sisira slowly while he was asleep because (he's) very tired. And she pierced the peg of the tent on the head of Sisira until it went_through_over the soil and Sisira died. 22 On the arrival of Barak to chase Sisira, Hail went_out to meet him and said, “Come_here, I will_show you(sg) the person that you're(sg) looking_for.” That's why Barak entered. And what he saw was Sisira lying_down and dead. And the peg of the tent still pierced_through his head.

23 Te seeye ne aldew, impepanalu te Manama ka me Israilita ki Habin ne Hari te Kanaan. 24 Ne wey e migpenek-penek ka me Israilita ne egkuntere ki Habin ne Hari te Kanaan taman te neyimatayan dan e sikandin.

23 On that day, God caused_ the Israilitas _to_win_over Habin the king of Kanaan. 24 And the Israilitas stopped only in fighting (against) Habin the king of Kanaan until they killed him.

Ka peg-ulahing ni Dibura wey ni Barak

The singing by Dibura and by Barak

51 Te seeye ne aldew, mig-ulahing si Dibura wey si Barak ne anak ni Abinuam te seini ne ulahingen:

51 On that day, Dibura and Barak the child of Abinuam sang this song:

2 Egdayanen ka Magbebaye ne Manama!

2 Praise the Lord God!

Su ka me pangulu te Israil ka miggun-a te pegpakiggira wey nabbagget ne migsinundul ka keet-etawan.

Because the leaders of Israil who went_first of_the warring and the ones following them were inspired.

3 Pammineg kew me Hari!

3 Listen(pl) kings!

Panalinga kew me pangulu!

Pay_attention(pl) leaders!

61 Ne miggimu e man-e ka me Israilita te mareet diye te tangkaan te Magbebaye ne Manama, sikan naa ka intuhutan sikandan te Magbebaye ne egkeuripen te matig-Midiya te pitu ne leg-un. 2 Ne natalu te me matig-Midiya ka me Israilita. Ne tenged due, diyad miggeles ka me Israilita te me bubungan wey diye te me sulung, wey diye te me inged ne egkeelesan. 3 Ne emun egpamula ka me Israilita, egpanlusuran sikandan te me matig-Midiyan, me matig-Amalik, wey te seeye se nangugpe diye te igsile. 4 Egmangekampu sikandan diye te Israil wey egdereetan dan ka me pinamula te me Israilita taman te Gasa. Ne egpanguen dan ka me karniru, me baka, wey me asnu wey ware egsameen dan ne keuyahan te me Israilita. 5 Eglusud sikandan ne egpanguyan te me baka wey te me balungbalung dan. Amana ne masulug sikandan iling kasulug te me talangas. Kenad e degma egkaseel ka kasuluhan dan wey te me kamil ran. Purisu te pegginguma ran, impangahew ran e ka langun-langun de iya ne egpuun te tane. 6 Ne amana miglised ka me Israilita tenged te me matig-Midiya. Sikan naa ka migpangananey sikandan te Magbebaye ne Manama.

61 And the Israilitas did bad_thing again there in front of the Lord God, that's why the Lord allowed them to be_enslaved by the (ones) from_Midiyan for seven years. 2 And the (ones) from_Midiyan defeated the Israilitas. And due to that, the Israilitas hid there in the mountains and there in the caves, and there in the places that could_be_hiding_place. 3 And when the Israilitas plant, the (ones) from_Midiyan, (ones) from_Amalik, and the residents of the east attacked them. 4 They camp there in Israil and destroy the plants of the Israilitas until Gasa. And they take_away the sheep, cows, and donkeys and they leave nothing of Israilitas' source_of_survival. 5 They attack bringing cattle and their tents. They are so many like the number of the locusts. Their number can't be counted also and their camels. Therefore when they arrived, they grabbed/snatched everything that land produced. 6 The Israilitas suffered very_much because of the (ones) from_Midiyan. That's why they asked_help from the Lord God.

7 Te migpangananey e ka me Israilita te Magbebaye ne Manama tenged te me matig-Midiyan, 8 impeuyanan sikandan te Magbebaye te prupita eyew te peglalag kandan te seini, “Impaawe ku sikaniyu te pegkeuripen diye te Ihiptu. 9 Inluwas ku sikaniyu puun te me matig-Ihiptu wey te langun ne migbayad-bayad kaniyu. Indeldel ku sikandan wey imbehey ku kaniyu ka tane dan. 10 Ne ingkahiyan ku sikaniyu, ‘Sikeddiey ka Magbebaye ne Manama niyu, wey keilangan ne kene kew egsimba te me diyus-diyus te me Amurihanen ne iyan kamuney te tane ne in-ugpaan niyu kuntee. Piru ware kew migtuman keddi.’ ”

7 When the Israilitas asked_help from the Lord God because of the (ones) from_Midiyan, 8 the Lord sent a prophet in_order to tell them this, “I caused_ you(pl) _to_be_free (LIT let_go) on your(pl) being_slaves there in Ihiptu. 9 I saved you(pl) from the (ones) from_Ihiptu and all who hardshipped you(pl). I sent_ them _away and I gave you(pl) their land. 10 And I told you(pl), ‘I (am) the Lord your(pl) God, and it's_necessary that you(pl) won't worship the false_gods of Amurihanons who owned the land that you(pl) live_on today. But you(pl) didn't obey me.’ ”

11 Ne migginguma ka panalihan te Magbebaye ne Manama wey migpinnuu diye te diralem te uk ne kayu ne diye te Upra, ne iyan kamuney si Huwas ne kabuhalan ni Abisir. Ne due anak ni Huwas ne egngaranan ki Gidyun ne migdiriek te trigu diye te kelesanan te behas te paras, ne diye te migbangbangalug eyew kene sikandin egkiteen te me matig-Midiyan. 12 Ne migpakita ka panalihan te Manama ki Gidyun wey migkahi, “Indumaan ka te Manama, mabulut ne bahani.”

11 And the angel of the Lord God arrived and sat there at the uk tree there at Upra, who owned by Huwas a descendant of Abisir. And Huwas had a child named Gidyun that was_treading wheat there in the squeezing_place of_the fruit of grapevine, which is there in a gully_form_place so_that he would not be_seen by the (ones) from_Midiyan. 12 And the angel of God appeared to Gidyun and said, “God accompanies you(sg), brave warrior.”

13 Ne migtabak si Gidyun, “Piru ahalen, emun ke indumaan key te Magbebaye ne Manama, mania te neyitabu seini langun kayi te kanami? Hendeid naan e ka kein-inuwan ne ingkahi ran meyitenged kandin ne migpaawe kun kandan puun te Ihiptu? Piru kuntee, imbalahad key te Manama wey intuhutan din ne egkatalu key te me matig-Midiya.”

13 And Gidyun answered, “But master, if the Lord God accompanied us(excl), why all this happened to us(excl)? Where is the amazing_thing that they told about him who caused_ them _to_leave from Ihiptu? But now, God abandoned us(excl) already and allowed us(excl) to be_defeated by the (ones) from_Midiyan.”

14 Ne migtangke ka panalihan te Manama wey migkahi, “Hipanew ka wey ipapitew nu ka kabulut nu wey luwasa nu ka Israil puun te me matig-Midiya. Sikeddi ka migsuhu keykew!”

14 And the angel of the Lord faced_front and said, “Walk(sg) and show(sg) your(sg) bravery and save(sg) Israil from the (ones) from_Midiyan. I (am) the one_commanded!”

15 Ne migtabak si Gidyun, “Piru Magbebaye ne Manama, egmenuwen ku te egluwas ka Israil te egkaayu-ayu ma ka pamilya ku te intiru ne kabuhalan ni Manasis. Ne sikeddi ka egkaleig-leig te kanami ne pamilya!”

15 And Gidyun answered, “But Lord God, how could I save Israil when my family is poorest of the entire descendant of Manasis. And I (am) the (ones) who taken_advantage_of our(excl) family!”

16 Migtabak ka Magbebaye ne Manama, “Egkaluwas nu ka Israil su egdumaan ku sikeykew. Egguleen nu ka me matig-Midiyan ne iling de te miggimatey ka te sabeka ne etew.”

16 The Lord God answered, “You(sg) can_save Israil because I will_accompany you(sg). Kill_all(sg) the (ones) from_Midiyan just like you(sg) are killing one person.”

17 Ne migtabak si Gidyun, “Emun ke malehet iya ne egdumaan a nikeykew, papitawa a te palinneu ne iyan pamalehet te sikeykew iya seini se Magbebaye ne Manama ka migpakiglalag keddi. 18 Kene ke naan pa ubag awe kayi taman te egpakalibed a su eg-angey e pad te ighalad ku keykew.” Migtabak sikandin, “Egtetahad a kayi taman te egpakalibed ka.”

17 And Gidyun answered, “If it's really true that I am accompanied by you(sg), show(sg) me a sign that testifies that you(sg) are really the Lord God who talked to me. 18 Please don't go_away (from) here until I can_return because I am taking something_to_offer you(sg).” He replied, “I will_wait here until you(sg) are able_to_return.”

19 Purisu, migdagdahew mig-uli si Gidyun diye te baley rin. Miggilutu sikandin te nati pad ne kambing, wey miggilutu sikandin te paan ne ware patulin ne puun te harina ne diye itahu te nihu. Ne intahu din te nihu ka sere wey intahu din te kuren ka sabew. Ne in-uyan din ka langun ne inggilutu din diye te panalihan ne diye te lenged te uk ne kayu. 20 Ne migkahiyan sikandin te panalihan te Manama, “Iuntud nu kayi te batu ka sere wey ka paan ne ware patulin wey itisi nu seini te sabew.” Ne inggimu seeye ni Gidyun. 21 Ne indagketan te panalihan te Magbebaye ne Manama te pupul te tuked din ka sere wey paan. Ne sahuhune ne due migsiha ne hapuy puun te batu wey natutung ka sere wey ka paan, wey naawe e ka panalihan te Magbebaye ne Manama. 22 Te nakamaan-maan e si Gidyun ne panalihan bes seeye te Magbebaye ne Manama, migkahi sikandin, “Ekeyey Magbebaye ne Manama! Nakita ku ka panalihan nu wey nekegtangke key pad iya!” 23 Piru ingkahiyan sikandin te Magbebaye ne Manama, “Ka keupianan egduma keykew! Kene ka kaaldek. Kene ka egpatey.” 24 Ne miggimu si Gidyun te altar diye para te Magbebaye ne Manama wey ingngaranan din seini te, “Keupianan ka Magbebaye ne Manama.” Ne minsan kuntee, diye ded ka altar te Upra ne iyan kamuney ka me kabuhalan ni Abisir.

19 Therefore, Gidyun went_ his _home quickly. He cooked a young goat, and he cooked a bread with no leaven from the flour put on a winnowing_tray. And he put the viand on a winnowing_tray and he put the soup in the pot. And he brought all that he cooked there to the angel who was there near the uk tree. 20 And the angel of God said to him, “Put_ the viand and the bread without leaven _on this stone and pour it with soup.” And Gidyun did it. 21 And the angel of the Lord God touched with his staff the viand and the bread. And suddenly there's a fire sparkled from the stone and the viand and the bread was_burned, and the angel of the Lord God was gone. 22 And when Gidyun found_out that it was the angel of the Lord God, he said, “Oh no Lord God! I saw your(sg) angel and we(excl) indeed face_each_one!” 23 But the Lord God said to him, “Goodness will_accompany you(sg)! Don't(sg) be_afraid. You(sg) won't die.” 24 And Gidyun made an altar there for the Lord God and he called it, “The Lord God is goodness.” And even today, the altar was still there in Upra which owned by the descendants of Abinisir.

25 Te seeye ne marusilem, ingkahiyan te Magbebaye ne Manama si Gidyun, “Kua nu ka igkarangeb ne turu ne baka te amey nu, ka baka ne pitu e ne leg-un. Ne guhusa nu ka altar te amey nu ne para ki Baal, wey pelera nu ka diyus-diyus ne sungkaleg ne si Asira ne diye te dangdang te altar. 26 Pegkeimpus, himu ka te meupiya ne altar kayi te ampew te bubungan para keddi te Magbebaye ne Manama nu, ay-ayari nu peg-ampawa ka me batu te altar. Ne ipanubad nu ka igkarangeb ne turu ne baka dutu ne altar wey iyan nu itemeg ka diyus-diyus ne sungkaleg ne si Asira.” 27 Seeye naa, migduruma si Gidyun te sapulu ne suluhuanen din, wey intuman din ka ingkahi te Magbebaye ne Manama. Piru marusilem din seeye himuwa su naaldek sikandin te duma ne karumaan te pamilya te amey rin wey te me mahinged te lungsud.

25 On that evening, the Lord God told Gidyun, “Get(sg) the second bull of cow of your(sg) father, the cow that's seven years_old. And destroy(sg) the altar for Baal of your(sg) father, and put_down(sg) the post false_god Asira which was there beside the altar. 26 Afterwards, make(sg) a good altar here on this mountain for me the Lord God of yours(sg), put_ the stones of the altar _over_each_other properly. And sacrifice(sg) the second male cow there on the altar and use_as_firewood the pole false_god Asira.” 27 And so, Gidyun brought his ten slaves, and fulfill what_ the Lord God _said. But he did it in the evening because he was afraid with other relatives of his father and of the residents of the town.

28 Te pegpangimata te me mahinged te lungsud te egkasi-si e ka kaliwaswasan, nakita ran ne nahuhus e ka altar ni Baal wey napeled e ka dangdang ne diyus-diyus ne sungkaleg ne si Asira. Ne dutu, duen e neyimu ne iyam ne altar ne due nasame ne intutung ne impanubad ne turu ne baka. 29 Ne migmein-inseey sikandan, “Hentew-a ka miggimu kayi?” Ne mig-ay-ayaran dan seeye te eg-ugsi-ugsi, wey nanengnengan dan ne iyan miggimu dutu si Gidyun ne anak ni Huwas. 30 Ne migkahiyan dan si Huwas, “Ipalihawang nu ka anak nu. Eggimatayan ney sikandin su ingguhus din ka altar ni Baal wey impeled din ka manama ta ne sungkaleg ne si Asira.”

28 When the residents of the town woke up at dawn, they saw that the altar of Baal was torn_down and the post false_god Asira fell already. And there, there_was a new made altar and there_was remainder of burned sacrifice of bull cow. 29 And they asked_one_another, “Who did this?” And they researched it properly, and they knew that it was Gidyun the child of Huwas who did it. 30 And they told Huwas, “Cause_ your(sg) child _to_come_out(sg). We(excl) will_kill him because he torn_down the altar of Baal and put_down our(incl) god which is the pole Asira.”

31 Piru intabak ni Huwas ka me mabbulut ne me etew ne nakalingut kandin, “Mania te egpangabang kew ki Baal? Ka minsan hentew ne egpangabang kandin, eggimatayan te kene pad egkapawe. Ke malehet pa ne manama si Baal, nakasukul perem sikandin su altar din ma ka nahuhus.” 32 Puun dutu ne aldew, inggenalan e si Gidyun ki Hirub-Baal, ne iyan igpasabut ka, “Egsukul ki Baal” su ingguhus din ma ka altar ni Baal.

31 But Huwas answered the brave people around him, “Why are you(pl) fight_for Baal? Whoever fights_for him, be_killed before the next_day. If Baal is indeed true, he could_have_resisted because it's his altar what's_broken.” 32 From that day, Gidyun was called_as_a_title Hirub-Baal, which means, “One_who_fights with Baal” because he torn_down the altar of Baal.

33 Ne miglibulung ka langun ne matig-Midiyan, me matig-Amalik, wey ka me keet-etawan ne egpuun te igsile. Miglapas sikandan diye te Weyig ne Hurdan, wey nangekampu diye te bangalug ne egngaranan te Hisril. 34 Ne in-umaan si Gidyun te Panisingan te Magbebaye ne Manama. Imparahing din ka trumpita te pegpangumew te kabuhalan ni Abisir eyew egduma kandin. 35 Migsuhu sikandin te seeye se egmahuhuren diye te intiru ne kabuhalan ni Manasis eyew te peg-inniyat kandan ne egduma kandin. Ne migsuhu man-e sikandin te seeye se egmahuhuren diye te intiru ne kabuhalan ni Asir, ni Sabulun, wey ni Naptali. Ne migtakereg sikandan ka egduma ki Gidyun.

33 And all the (ones) from_Midiyan, (ones) from_Amalik, and the people from east gathered. They crossed_over the River Hurdan, and camped there in the valley that's named Hisriil. 34 And Gidyun was controlled by the Spirit of the Lord God. He sounded the trumpet in calling for the descendants of Abisir in_order to accompany him. 35 He sent those someone_to_tell(pl) the entire descendant of Manasis in_order to attract them to go_with him. He also sent those someone_to_tell(pl) to the entire descendant of Asir, Sabulun, and Naptali. And they went_up to accompany Gidyun.

36 Ne ingkahiyan ni Gidyun ka Manama, “Ke malehet iya ne eggamiten a nikeykew eyew te pegluwas te Israil sumale te insaad nu, 37 pamaleheti nu naa ne malehet iya. Egtahu a te bulbul te karniru diye te diekanan te trigu. Ne emun ke egkaremmuhan ka bulbul ne mammara ka tane, ne egkatahaan ku ne egbulihan a iya nikeykew te egluwas te Israil sumale te insaad nu keddi.” 38 Ne neyitabu iya ka igkeupii ni Gidyun. Migselem-selem si Gidyun ka mig-enew, wey inggulipisan din ka bulbul te karniru, wey napenu ka yahung te migtihis ne demmug. 39 Ne ingkahiyan e man-e ni Gidyun ka Manama, “Kene ka ubag keubil keddiey. Pahangyue e pa ubag te kasabeka ne eg-el-elehan te pad man-e ka bulbul te karniru. Eg-ilingen tad man-e kayi, himaraa nu ka bulbul wey empeta nu te demmug ka nakalingut ne tane.” 40 Ne inggimu seeye te Manama te seeye ne marusilem. Iyan de nammara ka bulbul, piru nasubid te demmug ka tane ne nakalingut te bulbul.

36 And Gidyun told God, “If it's indeed true that you(sg) are using me in_order to save Israil as you(sg) promised, 37 prove(sg) that's really true. I will_put a wool of sheep there in the threshing_place of wheat. And if the wool has dew and the ground is dry, then I will_know that you(sg) will_help me indeed in saving Israil as you(sg) promised to me.” 38 And what_ Gidyun _desired really happened. Gidyun got up early, and he squeezed the wool of the sheep, and a bowl was full of dripping dew. 39 And Gidyun told God again, “Please don't get_annoyed of me. Please allow me once_more to test again the wool of the sheep. We(incl) will_do it like this again, dry_up(sg) the wool and occupy(sg) the surrounding ground with dew.” 40 And God did it in the evening. What_dried_up was the wool, but the ground surrounding the wool was wet with dew.

Ka pegtalu ni Gidyun te me matig-Midiyan

The defeating of Gidyun with the (ones) from_Midiyan

71 Migselem-selem nangenew ensi Hirub-Baal (ne iyan si Gidyun) wey ka me sundalu rin. Ne nangekampu sikandan diye te dangdang te sebseb te Harud. Ne diye ka kampu te me matig-Midiyan te napu dapit te igkahibang ne balabahan dan, ne marani te bubungan te Muri.

71 Hirub-Baal (that is Gidyun) and his soldiers woke_up early. And they camped there beside the spring of Harud. And the camp of the (ones) from_Midiyas was there at the valley on their north (LIT left_side), that's near mountain of Muri.

2 Ne ingkahiyan te Magbebaye ne Manama si Gidyun, “Masulug de amana ka me sundalu nu eyew igpatalu ku kaniyu ka me matig-Midiyan. Kema ke egpaambug sikandan ne natalu ran ka me matig-Midiyan tenged te kanekal ran wey kene ne tenged keddi. 3 [xr]Sikan naa, nangeni nu ka keet-etawan, ‘Hentew seeye se egkaaldek wey egpangelkelen e te liyas, awe kew e kayi te bubungan wey uli kew e.’ ” Purisu, nanguli e diye te ugpaan dan ka daruwa ne pulu wey daruwa ne libu ne me etew (22,000), wey sapulu ne libu (10,000) naan de ka nasame.

2 And Gidyun was_told by the Lord God, “Your(sg) soldiers are just too many in_order for me to make_ you(pl) _defeat the (ones) from_Midiyan. They might boast that they defeated the (ones) from_Midiyan because of their strength and not because of me. 3 [xr]So then, tell(sg) the people, ‘Who are those afraid and tremble with fear, leave(pl) here in the mountain and go_home(pl).’ ” Therefore, the twenty-two thousand (22,000) people went to their home_place, and only ten thousand (10,000) were left.

4 Piru ingkahiyan pad iya man-e te Magbebaye ne Manama si Gidyun, “Amana pad ne masulug sikandan! Uyana nu sikandan diye te weyig su eggeraman ku sikandan eyew eg-alamen ku ke hentew ka igparuma ku keykew wey hentew ka kene egpakaruma.” 5 Purisu in-uyan ni Gidyun ka me sundalu diye te weyig. Ne ingkahiyan sikandin te Magbebaye ne Manama, “Ilein nu seeye se eg-inum ne eg-iling te asu ne egdilaan de ka weyig, wey ilein nu degma seeye se eg-inum ne egpanimbuel.” 6 Ne duen de tatelu ne gatus (300) ne etew ne egsakuhen te belad ka weyig. Piru migmanimbuel ne eg-inum te weyig ka langun ne nasame. 7 Ne ingkahiyan te Magbebaye ne Manama si Gidyun, “Seini se tatelu ne gatus (300) ne migsakug te belad dan te weyig, sikandan ka egpaluwasen ku kaniyu wey egkatalu ran ka me matig-Midiyan.” 8 Sikan naa, impeuli e ni Gidyun ka duma ne me Israilita diye te me ugpaan dan,[fn] piru inggaat din ka me inuyanan dan[fn] wey ka me trumpita ran. Ne tatelu ne gatus (300) naan de ka me etew ne migduma kandin. Ne ka kampu te me matig-Midiya diye te napu ne diralem dan.

4 But Gidyun was_told moreover by the Lord God, “They are still too many! Take them there at the river because I will_test them so_that I will_choose whoever I will_cause_to_accompany you(sg) and whoever won't be_able_to_accompany.” 5 So then Gidyun took the soldiers to the river. And he was_told by the Lord God, “Separate(sg) those who drink like a dog that just laps the water, and separate(sg) also those who drink that kneel.” 6 And there were only three hundred (300) people that scoop the water with the hand. But all the remainder kneeled in drinking the water. 7 And Gidyun was_told by the Lord God, “These three hundred (300) that scooped their hands with water, I'll cause_them to_save you(pl) and they will_defeat the (ones) from_Midiyan.” 8 So then, Gidyun caused_ other Israilitas _to_go_home there in their home_place,[fn] but he retained their supplies (LIT what_they_bring)[fn] and their trumpets. And only three hundred (300) people accompanied him. And the camp of the (ones) from_Midiyan was there in the valley below them.

9 Te nasagkup e, ingkahiyan te Magbebaye ne Manama si Gidyun, “Pangandam kew, lusuri niyu ka kampu ran su igtuhut kud ne egkatalu niyu sikandan. 10 Piru ke egkaaldek ka ne eglusud, tupang ke naan pa diye te kampu ran. Dumaa nu ka suluhuanen nu ne si Pura. 11 Ne pammineha niyu ka me guhuren dan. Egkataman, egkabagget kad amana ka eglusud.” Purisu migtupang e si Gidyun wey si Pura ne suluhuanen din diye te marani te kampu te me etew ne kuntere dan. 12 Ne nanlibulung diye te napu ka me matig-Midiyan, me matig-Amalik, wey ka langun ne keet-etawan te igsile, egpekeiling sikandan kasulug te me talangas. Ne ka kasulug te me kamil ran iling kasulug te pantad te dahat.

9 When the sun_set, Gidyun was_told by the Lord God, “Get_ready(pl), attack(pl) their camp because I caused_ them _to_be_defeated by you(pl). 10 But if you(sg) are afraid to attack, just go_down to their camp. Accompany your(sg) servant Pura. 11 And listen to their stories. Then, you(sg) will_be_ very _inspired to attack.” Therefore Gidyun and Pura his servant went_downhill there at near of the camp of the men who were their enemies. 12 And the (ones) from_Midiyan, (ones) from_Amalik, and all the people of east gathered at the valley, they were as_many_as the locusts. And the number of their camels was like the number of the sand of the sea.

13 Te pegginguma enni Gidyun, due narineg dan ne etew ne migpangguhud te taheinep diye te senge-etew. Migkahi ka etew, “Nakataheinep a ne due sabeka ne paan ne sibada ne nalilid kayi te kampu ta. Nenasuhat ka me balungbalung ta wey napeled e seini wey nahuhus e.”

13 On Gidyun and_company's arrival, there's a person that they heard telling his dream to other person. The person said, “I dreamed that there's one bread of barley that rolled_down to our(incl) camp. And our(incl) tents was hit by it and it fell and broke.”

14 Ne migtabak ka senge-etew, “Warad e duma ne igpasabut due ke kene, iyan e si Gidyun ne Israilita ne anak ni Huwas. Igpatalu kandin te Manama ka me matig-Midiya wey ka langun ne kayi te kampu ta.”

14 And the other person answered, “No other meaning of that but rather, that is Gidyun the Israilita who_was_the child of Huwas. God cause_ the (ones) from_Midiyan and all who (are) here in our(incl) camp _to_be_defeated by him.”

15 Te pegkarineg ni Gidyun te taheinep wey te kaluwasan dutu, mig-usengul sikandin ka migsimba te Manama. Pegkeimpus, miglibed e sikandin diye te kampu te me Israilita wey migkahi sikandin, “Taggel kew! Igpatalu e kanta te Manama ka me matig-Midiya.” 16 Ne impunduk-punduk din ka tatelu ne gatus (300) ne etew te tatelu ne punduk. Ne imbehayan din ka tagse sabeka kandan te trumpita wey sulu ne intahu te banga.[fn] 17 Ne migkahiyan din sikandan, “Emun ke egginguma kid diye te kampu ran, tengtengi a nikaniyu wey ilingi niyu ke nekey ka eggimuwen ku. 18 Ke igparahing ku wey te me duma ku ka me trumpita ney, sikaniyu degma langun ne nakalingut te kampu iparahing niyu degma ka me trumpita niyu wey panguleyi kew te, ‘Egpakiggira ki para te Magbebaye ne Manama wey ki Gidyun!’ ”

15 When Gidyun heard the dream and the meaning of it, he bowed_down worshiping God. Afterwards, he returned to the camp of the Israilitas and he said, “Get_ready(pl)! God cause_ the (ones) from_Midiyan _to_be_defeated already by us(incl).” 16 He grouped the three hundred (300) people into three groups. And he gave each person a trumpet and torch that put inside the jars.[fn] 17 And he said to them, “When we(incl) arrive there at their camp, look(pl) at me and imitate(pl) what_ I _will_do. 18 If I sound and my company our(excl) trumpets, you(pl) also who surrounded the camp also sound(pl) your(pl) trumpets and shout(pl), ‘We(incl) fight for the Lord God and for Gidyun!’ ”

19 Te egliware e te marusilem seeye, wey te sikan pad iya egpasubaley ka talagtameng, miggingume e si Gidyun diye te ilis te kampu wey ka mahatus (100) ne etew ne duma rin. Ne imparahing dan e ka me trumpita ran wey impamese dan e ka me banga ne in-uyan dan. 20 Ne iling ded ka inggimu te daruwa ne punduk, imparahing dan degma ka me trumpita ran wey impamese dan degma ka me banga dan. Ingkemkem dan te gibang ne belad dan ka me sulu wey inggen-genan dan te kawanan ne belad dan ka me trumpita ne imparahing dan, wey migpanguleyi sikandan, “Egpakiggira ki para te Magbebaye ne Manama wey ki Gidyun!” 21 Migsasindeg ka tagse etew ne duma ni Gidyun diye te nalengeran dan lingut te kampu, wey namallahuy ka langun ne kuntere dan ne me sundalu, wey migmanguleyi ka egmanlungkesu. 22 Taheed te migparahing te me trumpita ka tatelu ne gatus (300), impeg-uney te Magbebaye ne Manama megtibbasa ka me etew ne diye te kampu. Namallahuy sikandan diye te Bit-Sita peendiye te Sirira, taman diye te eletanan te Abil-Mihula ne marani te Tabat.

19 At the middle of the night, when the guards were newly shifting, Gidyun arrived there at the edge of the camp and the one hundred (100) persons who were with him. And they sounded their trumpets and broke the jars that they brought. 20 And the two groups did the same, they sounded their trumpets and broke their jars also. They held the lamps/torches by their left hands and they held the trumpets that they sounded by their right hands, and they shouted, “We(incl) will_go_for_war for the Lord God and for Gidyun!” 21 Each person who accompanied Gidyun stood there at their mark around the camp, and all their soldier enemies ran, and shouted running. 22 While the three hundred (300) were sounding the trumpets, the Lord God caused_to struck_by_sword_(reciprocally) the people in the camp. They ran to Bit-Sita toward Sirira, up_to the boundary of Abil-Mihula which was near Tabat.

23 Ne impeumew ni Gidyun ka me Israilita ne puun te kabuhalan ni Naptali, Asir, wey Manasis, wey impatalukunan din kandan ka me matig-Midiya. 24 Migsuhu si Gidyun te egpahuhuren diye te intiru ne bubungan ne inged te me kabuhalan ni Ipraim ne egpakahiyen, “Tupang kew ka egpakiggira te me matig-Midiyan. Bantayi niyu ka Weyig ne Hurdan wey ka me weyig diye te Bit-Bara eyew kene sikandan egpakalapas diye.” Sikan naa, miglibulung ka langun ne etew te kabuhalan ni Ipraim wey imbantayan dan ka Weyig ne Hurdan wey ka me weyig diye te Bit-Bara. 25 Ne narakep dan ka daruwa ne pangulu ne matig-Midiya ne si Urib wey si Siib. Inggimatayan dan si Urib diye te Batu te Urib, wey diye dan himatayi si Siib te Kelesanan te Behas te Paras ni Siib. Ne impanalukunan dan ka me matig-Midiyan, wey in-uyan dan ka ulu ni Urib wey ni Siib diye ki Gidyun ne diye te talipag te Hurdan.

23 And Gidyun summoned the Israilitas from the descendant of Naptali, Asir, and Manasis, and he caused_ them _to_chase the (ones) from_Midiyan. 24 Gidyun sent someone_to_tell to the entire mountains which were the place of the descendant of Ipraim to say, “Go_down to fight with the (ones) from_Midiyan. Guard(pl) the River Hurdan and the rivers there in Bit-Bara so_that they can't cross there.” That's why, all the people of the descendant of Ipraim gathered and they guarded the River Hurdan and the rivers there in Bit-Bara. 25 And they captured the two leaders of the (ones) from_Midiyan who was Urib and Sib. They killed Urib there at the Stone of Urib, and they killed Siib there at the Pressing of the Fruits of Grapevines of Siib. And they chased the (ones) from_Midiyan, and they brought the heads of Urib and Siib there to Gidyun who was there at the other_side of Hurdan.

Ka pegkatalu te me matig-Midiyan

The defeat of (ones) from_Midiyan

81 Ne mig-inse ki Gidyun ka keet-etawan te Ipraim, “Mania te inggimu niyu seini kanami? Mania te ware key nikaniyu ipeumew te peggira niyu te me matig-Midiyan?” Amana ka pegsagsahukul dan ki Gidyun.

81 And the people of Ipraim asked Gidyun, “Why did you(pl) do this to us(excl)? Why you(pl) didn't summoned us(excl) on your(pl) warring with the (ones) from_Midiyan?” And their complaining with Gidyun was vehement (LIT much).

2 Ne migtabak sikandin kandan, “Kene de egpakalepeng ka neyimu ku te neyimu niyu. Minsan ka deisek ne neyimu niyu kenad egkeilingan te neyimu te pamilya ku. 3 [xr]Impatalu te Manama kaniyu ka me pangulu te matig-Midiya ne si Urib wey si Siib. Na, nekey-a ka neyimu ku ne egpakalepeng te neyimu niyu?” Te pegkarineg te keet-etawan te Ipraim te tabak ni Gidyun, nenabewu e ka langet dan.

2 And he answered to them, “What_ I _did won't match_up with what_ you(pl) _have_done. Even the small_thing that you(pl) do can't be_matched by what_ my family _has_done. 3 [xr]God caused_ you(pl) _to_defeat the leaders of (ones) from_Midiyan who were Urib and Siib. Now_then, what did I do that can match_up with what you(pl) have done?” Upon hearing of this by the people of Ipraim of Gidyun's answer, they were relieved with their anger.

4 Ne miglapas si Gidyun diye te Weyig ne Hurdan duma te tatelu ne gatus (300) ne etew rin, wey minsan nenabeley e sikandan, migpabulus pad man-e sikandan ka egpanlupug te me kuntere dan. 5 Te pegginguma ran diye te lungsud te Sukut, mighangyu si Gidyun te me mahinged diye ne migkahi, “Behayi niyu ubag ka me sakup ku te egkakeen. Nenabeley e sikandan, wey egpabulus key pad ka egtalukun ki Siba wey ki Salmuna ne me Hari te Midiyan.”

4 And Gidyun and his three hundred (300) men crossed River Hurdan, and even they were tired, they still continued chasing their enemies. 5 On their arrival there at the town of Sukut, Gidyun plead to the residents there and said, “Please give my men_under_(me) something_to_eat. They are tired, and we(excl) still continue to chase Siba and Salmuna the kings of Midiyan.”

6 Piru migkahi ka me upisyal te Sukut, “Egbehayan ney re iya te paan ka me sakup nu ke narakep niyud si Siba wey Salmuna.”

6 But the officers at Sukut said, “Will we(excl) give your(pl) men_under_with if you(pl) have_captured_already Siba and Salmuna.”

7 Ne migtabak si Gidyun, “Ke iling due, emun igpatalu e keddi te Magbebaye ne Manama si Siba wey si Salmuna, eglibed a kayi wey egpamarasan ku sikaniyu te duhi wey me sapinit ne puun te disirtu eyew egkalundisan kew.” 8 Ne puun diye, migtakereg ensi Gidyun diye te Pinuil wey mighangyu e man-e te mahinged diye, piru ka intabak dan iling ded te intabak te me etew ne diye te Sukut. 9 Ne ingkahiyan din ka me etew te Pinuil, “Ke egpakalibed a kayi ne meupiya wey ware egkeyitabu keddi, egguhusen ku seini se titikangi ne baley niyu.”

7 And Gidyun answered, “If it's like that, when the Lord God caused_ Siba and Salmuna _to_be_defeated by me, I will_return here and I will_strike you(pl) with thorns and briers from desert so_that you(pl) will_be_skinned_off.” 8 And from there, Gidyun and_company went_uphill there at Pinuil and pleaded at the residents there, but their answer was same with what_ the people of Sukut _have_answered. 9 And he said to the people of Pinuil, “If I can return here in good_state and nothing happens to me, I will_tear_down this very_high house of yours(pl).”

10 Te seeye ne timpu, diye si Siba wey si Salmuna te Karhur duma te me sundalu ran. Duen naan de sapulu wey lalimma ne libu (15,000) ne me sundalu ran ne egpuun te igsile ne migbulig kandan su me sabeka ne gatus wey daruwa ne pulu man e ne libu (120,000) ka nammatey. 11 Ne migpabulus ensi Gidyun ka egtalukun te me kuntere dan, ne diye migbaye sikandan te lenged te ugpaan te me etew ne nangugpe te me balungbalung ne diye dapit te egkatangkaan te Nuba wey Hugbiha. Ne intigkew ran lusuri ka me kuntere dan. 12 Ne namallahuy ensi Siba wey si Salmuna, piru inlupug sikandan ni Gidyun wey narakep din sikandan, wey nenewukag ka langun ne sundalu ran.

10 At that time, Siba and Salmuna were there at Karhur with their soldiers. There were only fifteen thousand (15,000) of their soldiers from east who helped them because the ones_died was about one hundred twenty thousand (120,000) already. 11 And Gidyun and_company continued chasing their enemies, and they went there near the home_place of the people who lived in tents which there to the place_facing Nuba and Hugbiha. And they attacked their enemies surprisingly. 12 And Siba and Salmuna ran_away, but Gidyun chased them and he captured them, and all their soldiers were panicked.

13 Nataman, miglibed e ensi Gidyun ne anak ni Huwas puun te gira wey diye sikandan migbaye te takerehen te Hiris. 14 Ne due narakep dan ne sabeka ne kanakan ne matig-Sukut, wey impasulat din te kanakan ka pitu ne pulu wey pitu (77) ne me upisyal wey me igbuyag te lungsud te Sukut. 15 Ne miglibed e ensi Gidyun diye te Sukut wey migkahiyan din ka me upisyal, “Nasuman-suman niyu naan pad ka pegdali-di niyu keddi te pegkahi niyu te, ‘Egbehayan ney re iya te paan ka me sakup nu ke narakep niyud si Siba wey Salmuna?’ ” 16 Ne in-uyan ni Gidyun ka me igbuyag te lungsud, wey impamarasan din sikandan eyew egkapanulu. Me duhi wey me sapinit ka imbaras din kandan puun te disirtu. 17 Ingguhus din degma ka titikangi ne baley diye te Pinuil, wey impangimatayan din ka me lukes te seeye ne lungsud.

13 Then, Gidyun the child of Huwas and_company returned from war and they passed there at the ascent of Hiris. 14 And there_was a young_man from_Sukut that they captured, and he caused_ the young_man _to_write the seventy-seven (77) officers and leaders of the town of Sukut. 15 And Gidyun and_company returned there at Sukut and he said to the officers, “Do you(pl) still remember your(pl) taunting of me on your(pl) saying, ‘Will we(excl) give your(pl) men_under_with if you(pl) have_captured_already Siba and Salmuna?’ ” 16 And Gidyun brought_away the leaders of the town, and he struck them in_order to be_disciplined. He struck them with thorns and briers from desert. 17 He also torn_down the very_high house there at Pinuil, and he killed the men in that town.

18 Nataman, mig-insaan din si Siba wey si Salmuna, “Mamenu ka me lukes ne impangimatayan niyu diye te Tabur?”

18 Then, he asked Siba and Salmuna, “How_ the men _look_like whom you(pl) killed there in Tabur?”

Migtabak sikandan, “Egpekeiling sikandan keykew, ne egpekeiling te anak te Hari.”

They answered, “They look_like you(sg), who look_like child of a king.”

19 Ne migtabak si Gidyun, “Me suled ku sikandan, migpahibeey key pad iya te iney ney. Mengeyibet te Magbebaye ne Manama ne emun ke ware niyu sikandan pangimatayi, kene ku degma perem sikaniyu eggimatayan.” 20 Ne migkahiyan din ka kinakakayan ne anak din ne egngaranan ki Hitir, “Himatayi nu sikandan!” Piru naaldek si Hitir su bate-bate pad sikandin, wey ware sikandin miggulabut te kampilan din.

19 And Gidyun answered, “They (are) my siblings, we(excl) indeed are siblings (LIT to_sit_on_each_others_lap) from our(excl) mother. (I) swear to the Lord God that if you(pl) did not kill them, I won't kill you(pl) also.” 20 And he said to his eldest child named Hitir, “Kill(sg) them!” But Hitir was afraid because he was youngish yet, and he didn't draw his sword.

21 Ne migkahiyan si Gidyun ni Siba wey ni Salmuna, “Apas ka, sikeykew en iya himatey kanami su kene ne himu seini te bate.”[fn] Sikan naa ka inggimatayan e ni Gidyun si Siba wey si Salmuna wey impanguwa rin e ka me dayan-dayan diye te lieg te me kamil ran.

21 And Gidyun was_told by Siba and Salmuna, “Hurry(sg), you_yourself(emph) the one to kill us(excl) because this isn't the work of a child.”[fn] So then Gidyun killed Siba and Salmuna and he took the decorations of the neck of their camels.

22 Ne ingkahiyan si Gidyun te me Israilita, “Tenged su inluwas key ma nikeykew puun te me matig-Midiya, sikeykew e wey ka me kabuhalan nu ka egpangulu kanami.”

22 And the Israilitas told Gidyun, “Since you(sg) saved us(incl) from the (ones) from_Midiyan, you(sg) and your(sg) descendants who will_lead us(excl).”

23 Migkahiyan sikandan ni Gidyun, “Kene ne sikeddi wey ka me kabuhalan ku ka egpangulu kaniyu, iyan de egpangulu kaniyu ka Magbebaye ne Manama.” 24 Ne migkahiyan din pad man-e sikandan, “Due ighangyu ku kaniyu, ibehey niyu keddi ka me eritis ne naahew niyu diye te me matig-Midiyan.” (Su due me eritis ne bulawan te me matig-Midiyan tenged su nabatasan dan nahud.)
