23 Gidyun told them, “Not me and my descendants who will_lead you(pl), only the Lord God the one to lead you(pl).” 24 And he told them again, “I have something_to_plead with you(pl), give me your(pl) earrings that you(pl) snatched_away from the (ones) from_Midiyan.” (For the (ones) from_Midiyan had golden earrings because they used to_it indeed.)

25 Ne migtabak sikandan, “Uya, igbehey ney keykew ka me eritis.” Ne migbelat sikandan te hinabel wey diye dan ipanahu ka nenaahew ran ne me eritis. 26 Me daruwa ne pulu (20) ne kilu[fn] ka me eritis ne bulawan, ware pad labet te me dayan-dayan, me balieg ne bulawan, wey malugtem ne me manggad ne insaluub te me Hari te Midiyan wey te me dayan-dayan te lieg te me kamil ran. 27 Ne inggimu ni Gidyun ne ipud[fn] ka me bulawan wey intahu din seini diye te Upra ne lungsud din. Piru insimba mule seeye te me Israilita wey seeye ka nakasahilut ki Gidyun wey te pamilya rin.

25 And they answered, “Yes, I will_give you(sg) the earrings.” And they spread a cloth and they put there the earrings that they snatched_away. 26 About twenty (20) kilograms[fn] the earrings of gold, not including the decorations, golden necklaces, and purple cloths that were_clothed by the king of Midiyan and the decorations of the neck of their camels. 27 And Gidyun made an ipud[fn] of gold and he put it there in Upra his town. But the Israilitas worshiped it on_the_contrary and it was the_thing that snared Gidyun and his family.

28 Natalu te me Israilita ka me matig-Midiya wey warad e migpakigbunu kandan ka me matig-Midiyan. Ne ware samuk te Israil te hep-at ne pulu (40) ne leg-un, taheed te neuyag pad si Gidyun.

28 The Israilitas defeated the (ones) from_Midiyan and the (ones) from_Midiyan didn't fight with them any_longer. And there_was_no commotion in Israil for forty (40) years, while Gidyun was still alive.

Ka pegpatey ni Gidyun

The dying of Gidyun

29 Ne mig-uli e si Gidyun[fn] ne anak ni Huwas diye te baley rin wey diyad sikandin mig-uugpe. 30 Due pitu ne pulu (70) ne me anak din ne me lukes tenged su masulug ka asawa rin. 31 Due duwey rin ne diye mig-ugpe te Sikim wey due anak dan ne lukes, ne iyan ngaran si Abimilik. 32 Nataman, migpatey e si Gidyun. Ne diye ded degma sikandin ilebeng te inlebengan te amey rin ne si Huwas diye te Upra ne inged te kabuhalan ni Abisir.

29 Gidyun[fn] the child of Huwas went_home to his house and he stayed_long there. 30 He had seventy (70) male children because his spouses were many. 31 He had a junior_wife who lived there in Sikim and they had a male child, whose name was Abimilik. 32 Then, Gidyun died. And he also buried there where_ his father Huwas _was_buried there in Upra the place of the descendant of Abisir.

33 Te migpatey re iya si Gidyun, warad migmatinumanen te Manama ka me Israilita, wey migsimbe e man-e sikandan te me larawan ni Baal, wey inliwanan dan e ka Manama ki Baal-Birit wey iyan dan e insimba. 34 Nalingawan dan e ka Magbebaye ne Manama ran, ne iyan migluwas kandan puun te langun ne me kuntere dan ne nakalingut kandan. 35 Minsan meupiya ka neyimu ni Gidyun te Israil, piru warad iya meupiya ne impapitew ran te pamilya rin.

33 As soon as Gidyun died, the Israilitas disobeyed God, and they worshiped again the images of Baal, and they replaced God with Baal-Birit and they worshiped it. 34 They forgot_about the Lord their God, the (one who) saved them from all their enemies who surrounded them. 35 Even if what_ Gidyun _did in Israil was good, but they showed nothing good to his family.

Ka pangulu ne si Abimilik

The leader Abimilik

91 Ne miggendiye te Sikim si Abimilik ne anak ni Gidyun,[fn] diye te karumaan te iney rin wey ingkahiyan din sikandan, 2 “Insei niyu ka langun ne me pangulu te Sikim ke nekey ka igkeupii ran: ka egpanguluwan sikandan te pitu ne pulu (70) ne anak ni Gidyun, wey ke sabeka re ne etew? Sumsumana niyu ne karumaan e pad iya nikaniyu.”[fn] 3 Purisu migpakiglalag ka me karumaan ni Abimilik diye te langun ne me pangulu te Sikim. Ne mig-uyun ka me pangulu te Sikim ne eg-ikul ki Abimilik tenged su nakakahi sikandan, “Suled te ma sikandin.” 4 Ne imbehayan dan si Abimilik te pitu ne pulu (70) ne pelata puun te baley te diyus-diyus dan ne si Baal-Birit. Ne inggamit seini ni Abimilik te egpamayad te me lalung wey talaggimu te samuk eyew eg-ikul kandin. 5 Miggendiye si Abimilik te Upra ne ugpaan te amey rin, wey indumaan sikandin te me sundalu rin wey induma rin degma ka me suled din ne pitu ne pulu (70) diye te ampew te sabeka ne batu wey impangimatayan din sikandan langun diye. Piru nakapallahuy wey nekeeles si Hutam ka kinaarian ne anak ni Gidyun. 6 Ne miglibulung ka langun ne me pangulu te Sikim wey Bit-Milu diye te lenged te uk ne kayu ne marani te sungkaleg ne batu diye te Sikim eyew eggimuwen dan e ne Hari si Abimilik.

91 And Abimilik the child of Gidyun[fn] went to Sikim, there at the relatives of his mother and he told them, 2 “Ask(pl) all the leaders of Sikim what they want: they want to be led by seventy (70) children of Gidyun, or just one person? Remember that I (am) a close (LIT very) relative of you(pl).”[fn] 3 Therefore the relatives of Abimilik spoke to all the leaders of Sikim. And the leaders of Sikim agreed to follow Abimilik because they were able_to_say, “He is our(incl) brother.” 4 And they gave Abimilik seventy (70) silvers from the house of their false_god Baal-Birit. And Abimilik used it to pay for the behaviorally_immoral_people and ones_who_make commotions in_order to follow him. 5 Abimilik went to Upra the home_place of his father, and his soldiers accompanied him and he also brought his seventy (70) brothers there at the top of ones stone and he killed them all there. But Hutam the youngest child of Gidyun was_able_to_run and hid. 6 And all the leaders of Sikim and Bit-Milu gathered there near the uk tree that's near the stone post there in Sikim in_order that they make Abimilik king.

Ka panunggilingan ni Hutam

The example by Hutam

7 Te pegkarineg dutu ni Hutam, migtakereg sikandin diye te puntul te bubungan te Girisim wey migpanguleyi, “Pammineg kew keddi me pangulu te Sikim eyew egpamminehen kew te Manama! 8 Sabeka ne timpu, miglihawang ka me kayu ne eg-alam te eghari kandan. Migkahiyan dan ka kayu ne ulibu, ‘Sikeykew ka eghari kanami.’ 9 Piru migtabak ka kayu ne ulibu, ‘Kene ku eg-inniyuhan ka lana ku ne inggamit te pegpabantug te me etew wey te me manama, eyew re eghari kaniyu.’ 10 Ne migkahi ka me kayu diye te kayu ne iggira, ‘Sikeykew ka eghari kanami.’ 11 Piru migtabak ka kayu ne iggira, ‘Kene ku eginniyuhan ka memeemis ne behas ku, eyew re eghari kaniyu.’ 12 Ne migkahi ka me kayu diye te paras, ‘Sikeykew ka eghari kanami.’ 13 Piru migtabak ka paras, ‘Kene ku eg-inniyuhan ka binu ku ne egpakapahale te me etew wey te me manama, eyew re eghari kaniyu.’ 14 Te katammanan, migkahiyan te langun ne kayu ka sapinit, ‘Hengkayi ka wey sikeykew ka eghari kanami.’ 15 Ne migtabak ka sapinit te me kayu, ‘Emun ke igkeupii niyu iya ne eghari a kaniyu, aput kew keddi eyew egkaralungan ku sikaniyu. Piru ke kene kew eg-aput keddi, egpalihawang a te hapuy ne eghugmas te kayu ne me sidar diye te Libanun.’ ”

7 When Hutam heard it, he went_uphill there at the peak of the mountain of Girisim and shouted, “Listen(pl) to me leaders of Sikim in_order that God will_listen to you(pl)! 8 One time, the trees went_out to choose one_who_rules them. They said to the olive tree, ‘You(sg) (are) the one to rule us(excl).’ 9 But the olive tree answered, ‘I won't turn_away_from my oil that can make people and gods famous, just to reign_over_you(pl).’ 10 And the trees said to the fig tree, ‘You(sg) (are) the one to reign_over us(excl).’ 11 But the fig tree answered, ‘I won't turn_away_from my sweet fruits, just to reign_over you(pl).’ 12 And the trees said to the grapevine, ‘You(sg) (are) the one to reign_over us(excl).’ 13 But the grapevine answered, ‘I won't turn_away_from my wine that can make people and gods happy, just to reign_over you(pl).’ 14 At the end, all the trees said to the thorn_tree, ‘Come_here(sg) and you(sg) (are) the one to rule us(incl).’ 15 And the thorn_tree answered, ‘If you(pl) like me indeed to rule with you(pl), run_for_protection to me so_that I can shade_over you(pl). But if you(pl) won't run_for_protection to me, I will_cause_ fire _to_come_out that will_burn_totally the cedar trees there in Libanun.’ ”

16 “Kuntee, meupiya naa wey eleg ka inggimu niyu ki Abimilik ne eggimuwen ne Hari? Ne ka sika se inggimu niyu, meupiya naa ki Gidyun wey te me pamilya rin? Insulian niyu naa ka meupiya ne neyimu rin kaniyu? 17 Sumsumana niyu ne migpakiggira sikandin eyew egkapangabangan kew. Mig-antus sikandin ka egluwas kaniyu puun te me matig-Midiya. 18 Piru kuntee, migsukul kew te pamilya te amey ku. Inggule niyu te egpangimatey ka pitu ne pulu (70) ne anak din diye te sabeka re ne batu. Ne in-alam niyu si Abimilik ka anak te duwey ne uripen din ne malitan ne egkeyimu ne Hari te Sikim tenged su karumaan niyu sikandin. 19 Emun ke sika ka intuuwan niyu ne igpakasuli niyu te keupiya ni Gidyun wey te pamilya rin, ipabulus niyud sika. Ne gale-gale kew duma ki Abimilik. 20 Piru ke kene, egdereetan kew perem ni Abimilik se me pangulu te Sikim wey Bitmilu. Ne egkareetan degma perem si Abimilik!” 21 Nataman, migpallahuy e si Hutam wey miglenus peendiye te Biir wey diyad sikandin mig-ugpe tenged su naaldek sikandin ki Abimilik ne suled din.

16 “Now, is what_ you(pl) _did to Abimilik that you(pl) made king good and correct? And that what_ you(pl) _did, is it good for Gidyun and to his family? Did you(pl) pay the good_thing that he made to you(pl)? 17 Remember(pl) that he fought_war in_order to_help you(pl). He suffered to save you(pl) from the (ones) from_Midiyan. 18 But now, you(pl) fought_against the family of my father. You(pl) killed_all his seventy (70) children there on one stone only. And you(pl) chose Abimilik the child of his female slave junior_wife to become king in Sikim because he is your(sg) relative. 19 If that's what you(pl) believed_in that you(pl) can repay the goodness of Gidyun and his family, continue(pl) that. And rejoice(pl) with Abimilik. 20 But if not, may Abimelech destroy you(pl) leaders of Shechem and from Beth-millo. And may Abimelech be destroyed too!” 21 Afterwards, Hutam ran_away and escape going to Biir and he lived there because he was afraid with his brother Abimilik.

22 Mighari si Abimilik te Israil te tatelu ne leg-un. 23 Ne immeg-uney e meg-eheta te Manama si Abimilik wey ka me pangulu te Sikim. Ne migsupak e ka me pangulu te Sikim ki Abimilik. 24 Neyitabu seini eyew egkalegparan si Abimilik wey ka me pangulu te Sikim ne migbulig kandin ne egpangimatey te pitu ne pulu (70) ne anak ni Gidyun. 25 Ne warad e neupii ki Abimilik ka me pangulu te Sikim. Ne migsuhu sikandan te me etew ne egpahepasen diye te me puntul te me bubungan, eyew egpepanulisen te langun ne egmanlihad diye. Ne nanengnengan seeye ni Abimilik.

22 Abimilik reigned_over Israil in three years. 23 And God caused Abimilik and the leaders of Sikim to_fight_each_other. And the leaders of Sikim disobeyed Abimilik. 24 This happened in_order that Abimilik and the leaders of Sikim be_punished who helped him to kill the seventy (70) children of Gidyun. 25 And the leaders of Sikim did not like Abimilik any_more. And they commanded men on the hilltops to ambush, in_order_to rob(pl) everyone who went_by there. And that was found out by Abimelech.

26 Ne due etew ne egngaranan ki Gaal ne anak ni Ibid ne miggendiye te Sikim ne migduma te me suled din. Ne ware nabantali ka me pangulu te Sikim kandan. 27 Ne miggingume e ka timpu te pegpamupu te behas te paras wey immamupu te me pangulu te Sikim seini. Ne ingkeles dan seini wey migsahakeen sikandan diye te baley te diyus-diyus dan. Te egmangekeen e sikandan wey egmangiinum, indilus dan e si Abimilik. 28 Ne migkahi si Gaal, “Si Abimilik, iyan din amey si Gidyun ne kene ta ne karumaan. Ne mania te egparuma-ruma ki kandin? Si Hamur ma mule ka amey ta kayi te Sikim, ne mania te iyan ta egpaharien si Abimilik kanta wey mania te egpalintutuu ki ki Sibul ne sinalihan din? 29 Emun ke sikeddi ka pangulu niyu, egkatalu ta iya si Abimilik. Egkahiyan ku sikandin, ‘Timuli nu pa ka me sundalu nu eyew egmasalig kew, wey egpabunuey ki.’ ”

26 And there's a person named Gaal that was the child of Ibid who went to Sikim and accompanied his brothers. And the leaders of Sikim didn't worry about them. 27 And the time of picking the fruits of grapevines came and the leaders of Sikim picked it. And they squeezed it and they feasted in the house of their false_god. When they were eating and drinking, they cursed Abimilik. 28 And Gaal said, “Abimilik, his father was Gidyun who was not our(incl) relative. And why are we(incl) submitting to him? It's Hamur on_the_contrary who was our(incl) father here in Sikim, and why are we(incl) making_ Abimilik _reign_over us(incl) and why are we(incl) obeying his trusted (one) Sibul? 29 If I'm your(pl) leader, we(incl) will_ indeed _defeat Abimilik. I will_tell him, ‘Add more of your(pl) soldiers so_that you(pl) become_many, and we(incl) will_fight.’ ”

30 Te pegkarineg ni Sibul ne pangulu te lungsud te ingkahi ni Gaal ne anak ni Ibid, nangebel-ebel ka langet din. 31 Sikan naa ka migsuhu sikandin te seeye se egmahuhuran peendiye ki Abimilik diye te Aruma eyew te pegkahi, “Bantey ka su kayi te Sikim si Gaal ne anak ni Ibid duma te me suled din wey imbanasalan dan ka me etew ne egsupak keykew. 32 Purisu keilangan ne eggipanew ka duma te me etew nu wey gepas kew te marusilem diye te me kamet ne diye te lihawangan te siyudad. 33 Te egkaliwaswas pad, selem-selem ka enew wey lusuri niyu ka siyudad. Emun ke eglihawang e si Gaal duma te me etew rin eyew egkuntere keykew, himuwa nud ka igkeupii nu ne eggimuwen kandan.”

30 Upon hearing of Sibul the leader of the city on what_ Gaal the child of Ibid _said, his anger smoked. 31 That's why he sent those someone_to_tell going_to Abimilik there to Aruma in_order to say, “Beware(sg) because Gaal the child of Ibid is here in Sikim with his brothers/cousins and they encouraged the people to disobey you(sg). 32 Therefore it's_necessary that you(sg) go with your(sg) people and make_an_ambush in the fields outside the city at night. 33 Before dawn, get_up(sg) early and attack the city. If Gaal comes_out with his people in_order to fight with you(sg), do(sg) what you(sg) desire to do to them.”

34 Purisu te sabeka ne marusilem, nangipanew si Abimilik wey ka langun ne me etew rin. Migpasuwayey sikandan te hep-at ne punduk ne nanggepas diye te lihawangan te Sikim. 35 Te maselem e, miglihawang si Gaal ne anak ni Ibid wey migsasindeg sikandin diye te gumawan te siyudad. Ne nanlihawang ensi Abimilik wey ka me etew rin diye te inggelesan dan. 36 Te pegkakita ni Gaal kandan, migkahiyan din si Sibul, “Tengteng ka! Due me etew ne nanupang puun te me bubungan!”

34 Therefore in one night, Abimilik and all his people went. He separated four groups that make_an_ambush there at the outside of Sikim. 35 In the morning, Gaal the child of Ibid and he stood there at the entrance of the city. And Abimilik and his people came_out there where_ they _hid. 36 When Gaal saw them, he said to Sibul, “Look(sg)! There are people who went_down the mountains!”

Migtabak si Sibul, “Me alung de sika te me bubungan, kene ne me etew.”

Sibul answered, “Those are just shadows of the mountains, not people.”

37 Ne migkahi e man-e si Gaal, “Pitew ka iya! Due me etew ne nanupang seeye te bangalug, wey due man-e lein ne punduk ne egpuun diye te uk ne kayu te egpahehane.”

37 And Gaal said again, “Look(sg) really! There are people who went_down there in the valley, and there are other group also_that come_from there to the uk tree of the sorcerer.”

38 Ne ingkahiyan ni Sibul sikandin, “Hendei naan e ka impeggasal nu ubag te pegkahi nu te hentew naan de iya si Abimilik ne eggimuwen ta ne pangulu? Seini iya ka me etew ne inlemetan nu! Ne lihawang ka wey pakigkuntere ka kandan.” 39 Purisu, impanguluwan ni Gaal ka me pangulu te Sikim ne egpakigkuntere ki Abimilik. 40 Piru natalu si Gaal ni Abimilik wey nakapallahuy sikandin. Indel-as sikandin ni Abimilik wey masulug ka me matig-Sikim ne nenakabahed ne tahapali, taman diye te bayaanan te gumawan te siyudad. 41 Ne miglibed si Abimilik diye te Aruma. Ne indelrel ni Sibul si Gaal duma te me suled din eyew kenad egpekeugpe te Sikim.

38 And Sibul said to him, “Where is something_ you(sg) _boasted when you(sg) said who is indeed (sarcastic) Abimilik that we(incl) will_make (our) leader? This is the person that you(sg) mocked! And come_out and fight(sg) with them.” 39 Therefore, Gaal lead the leaders of Sikim to fight Abimilik. 40 But Gaal was defeated by Abimilik and he was_able to_run. Abimilik chased him and many from_Sikim lying_ wounded _in_the_ground, until there at the pathway of the entrance of the city. 41 And Abimilik returned there to Aruma. And Sibul sent_away Gaal with his brothers so_that they won't be_able_to_live in Sikim.

42 Te seup ne aldew, nahuhuran si Abimilik ne nangendiye ka me matig-Sikim te me kamet dan. 43 Sikan naa ka induma rin ka me etew rin wey imbaad-baad din te tatelu ne punduk, wey nanggepas sikandan diye te me kamet. Te pegkakita ni Abimilik ne nanlihawang e ka me etew te siyudad, miglihawang e degma sikandin wey ka me duma rin diye te inggelesan dan wey impangimatayan dan ka me etew. 44 Ne mig-apas si Abimilik wey ka punduk din ne egparani diye te gumawan te siyudad eyew egbantayan dan seini, wey kalihet degma ne impangimatayan te daruwa ne punduk ka langun ne diye te me kamet. 45 Naapunan de iya si Abimilik ka migpakigkuntere te me mahinged te siyudad. Te katammanan, naahew rin seini wey impangimatayan din ka me etew. Ne ingguhus din ka siyudad wey impanaweran din te asin ka tane.[fn]

42 On the following day, Abimilik was_informed that the (ones) from_Sikim went to their fields. 43 So then he accompanied his people and he divided (them) in three groups, and they made_ambush there in the fields. Upon seeing of Abimilik that the people of the city were going_out, he and his companions also went_out where_ they _hid and they killed the people. 44 And Abimilik and his group hurried to get_near the entrance of the city in_order to guard it, while the two groups were killing also all there in the fields. 45 And Abimilik was_fighting with the residents of the city until_the_afternoon. At the end, he won_ it _over and he killed the people. And he destroyed the city and he spread salt on the ground/soil.[fn]

46 Napasayuwan nahuhuri ka langun ne pangulu te Sikim te miglusuran sikandan, purisu nangeles sikandan diye te maresen ne sinabeng te baley ni Baal-Birit. 47 Natahaan ni Abimilik ne diye nanlibulung te baley ne titikangi ka langun ne pangulu te Sikim. 48 Purisu, induma rin ka me etew rin diye te bubungan te Salmun. Migkuwa sikandan te wasey wey migpannempug sikandan te me sugpang te kayu, impamagkes dan wey intiang dan e. Ne ingkahiyan din ka me etew rin ne duma rin, “Apas kew! ilingi niyu ka eggimuwen ku.” 49 Sikan naa ka mig-atul-atul sikandan migpanempug te me sugpang te kayu. Ne insinundul ran si Abimilik peendiye te siyudad wey intambu dan seini diye te selib te malig-en ne sinabeng te baley wey insilaban dan seini. Seeye naa ka migpatey degma ka langun ne diye te baley ne titikangi; me sabeka ne libu (1,000) ka me lukes wey me malitan ka nammatey.

46 All the leaders of Sikim were_told_early that they were attacked, therefore they hid there in strong room in the house of Baal-Birit. 47 Abimilik made_known that all the leaders of Sikim gathered there in the high house. 48 Therefore, he brought his people there on the mountains of Salmun. They took an axe and they cut some branches of a tree, they bound and carry_ (them) _on_shoulders. And he told the people who were his companions, “Hurry(pl)! follow(pl) what_ I _did.” 49 That is why they individually cut branches of a tree. And they followed Abimilik going to the city and they put_ (them) _together there under the strong room of the house and they burned them. That's why all there in the high house died; about one thousand (1,000) men and women died.

50 Pegkeimpus dutu, miggipanew e ensi Abimilik eyew eglusuran dan ka Tibis, wey naahew ran ded man-e seini. 51 Piru due malig-en ne baley ne titikangi ne in-aputan te langun ne etew diye te seled te siyudad. Miglelekeb sikandan wey migmamaneyik diye te atep te baley ne titikangi. 52 Ne migparani si Abimilik ka egguhus te baley ne titikangi wey egsilaban din e perem seini. 53 [xr]Piru due malitan ne mig-ulug te galingan ne batu te ulu ni Abimilik wey nabagbag ka pulu din. 54 Te sikan de, in-umew rin e ka kanakan ne talag-uyan te panganiban din wey ingkahiyan din, “Hulabuta nu ka kampilan nu wey himatayi a su kena a egkeupian ne due egkahi te malitan de ka nakapatey keddiey.” Sikan naa ka insundang e sikandin te kanakan wey napatey e sikandin. 55 Te pegkakita te me Israilita ne napatey e si Abimilik, nanguli e sikandan diye te ugpaan dan.

50 After that, Abimilik and_company went in_order to attack Tibis, and they won_ it _over also. 51 But there_is a high strong house that all the people took_refuge_in inside the city. They closed_ the _doors and climbed_up there on the roof of the high house. 52 And Abimilik came near to destroy the high house and he was about to burn it. 53 [xr]But there's a woman who dropped a millstone on Abimilik's head and his head cracked. 54 Suddenly, he called the young_man who was his weapon bearer and he told (him), “Draw_out(sg) your(sg) sword and kill(sg) me because I don't want that there's someone_who_says that only a woman who killed me.” That's why he stabbed by the young_man and he died. 55 Upon seeing of the Israilitas that Abimilik was dead, they went_home to their home_place.

56 Purisu, insulian ded te Manama si Abimilik te neyimu rin te amey rin su impangimatayan din ma ka pitu ne pulu (70) ne suled din. 57 Inlegparan degma te Manama ka me matig-Sikim tenged te langun ne mareet ne inggimu ran. Purisu, natuman ka pegdilus kandan ni Hutam ne anak ni Gidyun.

56 Therefore, God still revenged with Abimilik on what_ he _did to his father because he killed this seventy (70) brothers. 57 God also punished the (ones) from_Sikim because of all the evil_acts that they did. Therefore, the cursing of Hutam the child of Gidyun was fulfilled.

Ka pangulu ne si Tula

The leader Tula

101 Te migpatey e si Abimilik, duen e man-e migpangulu te Israil eyew egpangabangan ka me etew. Iyan migsubal si Tula ne anak ni Puwa. Ne si Puwa anak ni Dudu. Migpuun si Tula te kabuhalan ni Isakar, wey diye sikandin mig-ugpe te Samir te bubungan te Ipraim. 2 Neyimu sikandin ne pangulu[fn] te Israil te daruwa ne pulu wey tatelu (23) ne leg-un. Te migpatey e sikandin, diye ded sikandin ilebeng te Samir.

101 When Abimilik died, there's again someone_who_led Israil in_order to protect the people. The one who_replaced was Tula the child of Puwa. And Puwa was child of Dudu. Tula was from the descendant of Isakar, and he lived there in Samir on the mountain of Ipraim. 2 He became leader[fn] in Israil for twenty-three (23) years. When he died, he was_buried also there in Samir.

Ka pangulu ne si Hair

The leader Hair

3 Te migpatey e si Tula, iyan nakasinundul si Hair ne matig-Gilyad ne migpangulu te Israil. Migdaruwa ne pulu wey daruwa (22) ne leg-un ka pegpangulu rin. 4 Due tatelu ne pulu (30) ne anak din ne me lukes ne tigsalimbeka te asnu. In-angken dan ka tatelu ne pulu (30) ne siyudad ne diye te Gilyad, ne ingngaranan ded kuntee te ugpaan ni Hair. 5 Te migpatey e si Hair, diye ded sikandin ilebeng te Kamun.

3 When Tula died, the one who_followed was Hair from_Gilyad who led Israil. His leading was about twenty-two (22) years. 4 He had thirty (30) male children who had_ donkey _each. They possessed the thirty (30) cities there in Gilyad, and it's called home_place of Hair today. 5 When Hair died, he was_buried also in Kamun.

Ka peggimu man-e te mareet te me Israilita

The making of bad_thing by Israilitas again

6 Ne miggimu e man-e te mareet ka me Israilita diye te tangkaan te Magbebaye ne Manama. Mig-inniyuhan dan ka Manama wey warad sikandan migpamakey kandin. Nasi migsimba sikandan te me diyus-diyus ne Baal, me Astarut, me diyus-diyus te me matig-Sirya, matig-Sidun, matig-Muwab, matig-Amun wey te me matig-Pilistiya. 7 Sikan naa ka mig-ebel-ebel ka langet te Magbebaye ne Manama te me Israilita, wey intuhut din ne egkatalu sikandan te me Pilistihanen wey me Amunihanen. 8 Te seeye ne me leg-un, imbaybayaran te me Amunihanen wey me Pilistihanen ka langun ne Israilita. Ne imbaybayaran te me Amunihanen te sapulu wey walu (18) ne leg-un ka me Israilita ne diye mig-ugpe te dapit te igsile te Weyig ne Hurdan ne diye te Gilyad. 9 Ne inlusuran degma te me Amunihanen ka me kabuhalan ni Huda, Binhamin, wey ni Ipraim ne diye nangugpe te talipag te Weyig ne Hurdan. Sikan naa ka amana mig-antus ka me Israilita.

6 And the Israilitas did a bad (thing) again there in front of the Lord God. They turned_ their _back from God and they didn't serve God any_longer. Instead they worshiped false_gods such as Baals, Astarut, false_gods of the (ones) from_Sirya, of the (ones) from_Sidun, of the (ones) from_Muwab, of the (ones) from_Amun and of the (ones) from_Pilistiya. 7 That's why the anger of the Lord God smoked to the Israilitas, and he caused_ them _to_be_defeated by the Pilistihanons and Amunihanons. 8 In that years, all the Israilitas were oppressed by the Amunihanons and Pilistihanons. The Israilitas who live there to the east of the Hurdan River that's in Gilyad were oppressed by the Amunihanons for eighteen (18) years. 9 And the Amunihanons were attacked also the descendants of Huda, Binhamin, and of Ipraim who lived there across the River Hurdan. That's why the Israilitas suffered very_much.

10 Seeye naa, migpangananey ka me Israilita te Magbebaye ne Manama te migkahi, “Nakasale key keykew su in-engkeran ney sikeykew ne Manama ney, wey nasi key migsimba te me Baal.”

10 So then, the Israilitas asked_help to the Lord God saying, “We(excl) sinned to you(sg) because we(excl) left you(sg) our(excl) God, and instead we(excl) worshiped the Baals.”

11 Ne ingkahiyan te Magbebaye ne Manama ka me Israilita, “Te imbaybayaran kew te me matig-Ihiptu, me Amurihanen, me Amunihanen, me Pilistihanen, 12 me Sidunihanen, me Amalikanen, wey te me Maunihanen, migpangananey kew keddi, wey impangabangan ku sikaniyu. 13 Piru in-engkeran a nikaniyu wey migsimba kew te me diyus-diyus, sikan naa ka kene kud e sikaniyu egpangabangan. 14 Hipanew kew wey pangananey kew te me diyus-diyus ne in-alam niyu, pepangabang kew kandan.”

11 And the Lord God said to the Israilitas, “When the (ones) from_Ihiptu harshipped you(pl), the Amurihanons, Amunihanons, Pilistihanons, 12 Sidunihanons, Amalikanons, and Maunihanons, you(pl) asked_help from me, and I helped you(pl). 13 But I was left by you(pl) and you(pl) worshiped false_gods, that's why I won't help you(pl) anymore. 14 Go(pl) and ask_help(pl) to the false_gods whom you(pl) chose, ask_ them _to_help you(pl).”

15 Piru migpeyid-u-hid-u ka me Israilita te Magbebaye ne Manama ne migkahi, “Nakasale key keykew, purisu, himuwa nu ke nekey ka igkeupii nu ne eggimuwen kanami. Piru ikeyid-u key red ubag nikeykew, wey pangabangi key kuntee nikeykew.” 16 Seeye naa ka in-engkeran dan e ka me diyus-diyus wey migpamakey e sikandan te Magbebaye ne Manama. Nataman, neyid-u red ka Magbebaye kandan.

15 But the Israilitas pleaded to the Lord God that said, “We(excl) sinned you(sg), therefore, do(sg) what you(sg) like to do with us(excl). But have pity(sg) on us(excl), and help us(excl) today.” 16 So then they left their false_gods and they worshiped the Lord God. Then, the Lord still had pity on them.

17 Ne migpangandam ka me Amunihanen wey migkekampu diye te Gilyad. Nanlibulung degma ka me Israilita wey nangekampu diye te Mispa. 18 Ne migpalalahey ka me pangulu te Gilyad ne migkahi, “Emun ke hentew ka egpekewun-a ne egkuntere te me Amunihanen, iyan egkeyimu ne pangulu te langun ne mahinged te Gilyad.”

17 And the Amunihanons got ready and camped there to Gilyad. The Israilitas gathered also and camped there in Mispa. 18 And the leaders of Gilyad talked_to_each_other and said, “If whoever fights first with Amunihanons, will_become leader of all the residents in Gilyad.”

Ka pangulu ne si Hipta

The leader Hipta

111 Ne due mabulut ne bahani ne egngaranan ki Hipta ne matig-Gilyad. Iyan din amey si Gilyad piru iyan din iney ka malitan ne egpamelegye te lawa. 2 Ne due duma ne anak ni Gilyad te asawa rin. Te nanulin e sikandan, indelrel dan e ka suled dan ne si Hipta wey ingkahiyan, “Ware baad nu te karatuan te amey ta su anak ke ma te egpamelegye te lawa.” 3 Sikan naa ka migpariyu si Hipta te me suled din wey diyad sikandin mig-ugpe te inged te Tub. Nataman, due me etew ne me lalung ne miglibulung diye ki Hipta wey mig-ikul e kandin.

111 And there's a brave warrior called Hipta from_Gilyad. And his father was Gilyad but his mother was a prostitute (LIT woman who sells a body). 2 And Gilyad had another children with his spouse. When they grew_up, they sent_away their brother Hipta and told, “You(sg) have_no share of our(incl) father because you(sg) (are) a child of a prostitute.” 3 That's why Hipta distanced from his brothers and he lived there at the place of Tub. Then, there were people who were worthless (LIT fool) who gathered there in Hipta and followed/imitated him.

4 Te ware naluhey, inggira te me Amunihanen ka me Israilita. 5 Seeye naa, impaangey te me igbuyag te Gilyad si Hipta diye te inged te Tub. 6 Migkahi sikandan, “Kuwa kid, sikeykew ka egpangulu kanami te egpakiggira te me Amunihanen.”

4 It was not long, the Amunihanons attacked the Israilitas. 5 That's why, the elders of Gilyad summoned Hipta there in the place of Tub. 6 They said, “Come with us(incl), you(sg) (are) the one to lead us(excl) in attacking the Amunihanons.”

7 Piru migtabak si Hipta, “Ware e bes naa dumuti nikaniyu wey ware e bes naa delrela nikaniyu puun te baley te amey ku? Ne kuntee te nasamuk kew e human kew pad egpabulig keddi?”

7 But Hipta answered, “Have you(pl) not hated me and have you(pl) not sent_ me _away from the house of my father? And now that you(pl) are in commotion and_then you(pl) ask_help from me?”

8 Ne migtabak ka me igbuyag kandin, “Tenged su keilangan ney sikeykew. Ne emun ke egpangulu ka kanami te egpakiggira te me Amunihanen, eggimuwen ney sikeykew ne pangulu te Gilyad.”

8 And the elders answered him, “Because we(excl) need you(sg). And if you(sg) lead us(excl) in fighting the Amunihanons, we(excl) will_make you(sg) leader of Gilyad.”

9 Ne migtabak si Hipta, “Emun ke egdumeen a nikaniyu eyew egpakigbunu te me Amunihanen wey egpepanaluwen a te Magbebaye ne Manama, sikeddi naan en iya ka pangulu niyu?”

9 And Hipta answered, “If you(pl) are to accompany me in_order to fight with the Amunihanons and God will_cause_ me _to_win, will I be indeed your(pl) leader?”

10 Migtabak ka me igbuyag, “Uya, egtumanen ney ka ingkahi nu, wey iyan talagpamalehet kayi ka Magbebaye ne Manama.” 11 Purisu, migduma si Hipta te me igbuyag te Gilyad, wey inggimu sikandin te me etew ne pangulu wey talagmandu dan. Ne diye te Mispa, diye te tangkaan te Magbebaye ne Manama, migsaad si Hipta diye te me igbuyag.

10 The elder answered, “Yes, we(excl) will_fulfill what_ you(sg) _said, and the one_testifying it is the Lord God.” 11 Therefore, Hipta accompanied the elders of Gilyad, and the people made him leader and their ruler. And there in Mispa, there in front of the Lord God, Hipta promised there to the elders.

12 Ne migsuhu si Hipta te seeye se egmahuhuran diye te Hari te me Amunihanen te pegkahi, “Nekey ka ig-ehet niyu kanami? Mania te eglusuran niyu ka inged ney?”

12 And Hipta sent those someone_to_tell to the king of the Amunihanons to say, “What do you(pl) fight_for with us(excl)? Why are you(pl) attacking our(excl) place?”

13 Ne intabak te Hari te me Amunihanen seeye se insuhu ne egpahuhuren ni Hipta, “Uya su in-ahew te me Israilita ka tane ney te pegginguma ran puun te Ihiptu. In-amin dan ka tane ney puun te Arnun peendiye te Habuk wey taman te Weyig ne Hurdan. Ne kuntee, iuli niyud e seini wey kene key e egpakiggira kaniyu.”

13 And the king of Amunihanon answered those someone_sent_to_tell(pl) by Hipta, “Yes because the Israilitas snatched_away our(excl) land on their arrival from Ihiptu. They took_all our(excl) land from Arnun up_to Habuk and until the River Hurdan. And now, return it and we(excl) won't fight you(pl) any_more.”

14 Ne migsuhu e man-e si Hipta te seeye se egmahuhuren din diye te Hari te me Amunihanen, 15 wey impakahiyan din, “Ware ahawa te me Israilita ka tane te me Muwabihanen wey ke tane naa te me Amunihanen. 16 Te peg-awe te me kabuybuyahan ney te Ihiptu, miggendiye sikandan te disirtu wey miglapas sikandan diye te Malalab ne Dahat wey taman diye te Kadis. 17 [xr]Ne migsuhu sikandan te seeye se egmahuhuren ne impeendiye te Hari te inged ne Idum ne egpakahiyen, ‘Eglihad key ubag te tane niyu.’ Piru ware migpammineg ka Hari. Seeye ded degma ka inggimu te Hari te Muwab kandan. Sikan naa ka ware mig-awe sikandan te Kadis. 18 [xr]Ne migpabulus sikandan diye te disirtu. Ne mig-alibed sikandan diye te inged ne Idum wey Muwab taman te nekeuma sikandan diye te kewun-aan te Muwab ne dapit te igsile ne diye te talipag te Weyig ne Arnun. Ne migkekampu sikandan diye, piru ware sikandan miglapas te weyig tenged su eletanan ma seeye te Muwab. 19 [xr]Ne migsuhu ka me Israilita te seeye se egmahuhuren diye ki Sihun ne Hari te Amurihanen diye te Hisbun eyew te pegkahi, ‘Palihara key ubag te tane niyu.’ 20 Piru ware migsalig si Sihun te me Israilita ne eglihad te tane din. Nasi din libulunga ka langun ne sundalu rin wey nangekampu diye te Hahas wey inlusuran dan ka me Israilita. 21 Piru impatalu te Magbebaye ne Manama te Israil ensi Sihun. Sikan naa ka naahew e te me Israilita ka tane te me Amunihanen ne mahinged te seeye ne inged. 22 Naahew ran ka langun ne in-ugpaan te me Amurihanen puun te Weyig ne Arnun taman te Weyig ne Habuk, wey puun man-e te disirtu peendiye te Weyig ne Hurdan. 23 Purisu ka Magbebaye ne Manama te Israil ka migdelrel te me Amurihanen eyew egkeugpaan ka inged dan te me Israilita. Nekey naa ka katenged niyu ne eggawi kayi? 24 Iyan niyu angkena ke nekey ka imbehey kaniyu te diyus-diyus niyu ne si Kimus, wey ke nekey degma ka imbehey te Magbebaye ne Manama ney, iyan ney degma eg-angkenen. 25 [xr]Migpalintutuu kew naa ne meupiya kew pad te Hari te Muwab ne si Balak ne anak ni Sipur? Ware de due sikandin miglelalis ne eg-ehet te Israil, wey warad iya migbul-ug migpakiggira kandan. 26 Me tatelu ne gatus (300) ne leg-un ka me Israilita ne nangugpe diye te Hisbun, Aruwir, wey te me lungsud ne nakalingut kayi, wey te langun ne lungsud ne diye te ilis te Weyig ne Arnun. Ne mania te kunteen niyu pad nasuman-suman ne eggawien seini? 27 Ware neyimu ku ne seyyup kaniyu, piru sikaniyu ka miggimu te seyyup keddi tenged su egpakigbunu kew keddi. Ne iyan eggukum ka Magbebaye ne Manama ke hentew ka due sale; ka me Israilita wey ke me Amunihanen naa.” 28 Piru ware linglingaa te Hari te me Amunihanen ka impanaha ni Hipta.

14 And Hipta again sent those someone_to_tell(pl) there to the king of Amunihanons, 15 and he caused_ (him) _to_be_told, “The land of the Muwabihanons or the land of the Amunihanons was not snatched_away by the Israilitas. 16 Upon leaving of our(excl) elders from Ihiptu, they went to the desert and they crossed_the_water there in the Red Sea and up_to there in Kadis. 17 [xr]And they sent those someone_to_tell(pl) to_go to king of place of Idum to say, ‘We(excl) will_pass_by on your(pl) land please.’ But the king didn't listed. That was also what_ the king of Muwab _did to them. That's why they didn't leave Kadis. 18 [xr]And they continued there in the desert. And they returned there at the place of Idum and Muwab until they arrived there beyond Muwab on the east side there to the across of the Arnun River. And they camped there, but they didn't cross the river because it was a boundary of Muwab. 19 [xr]And the Israilitas sent those someone_to_tell(pl) to Sihun king of Amurihanon there at Hisbun in_order to say, ‘Let us(excl) pass_by in your(pl) land.’ 20 But Sihun did not trust the Israilitas to pass their land. Instead he gathered all his soldiers and camped there at Hahas and they attacked the Israilitas. 21 But the Lord caused_ Sihun and_company _to_be_defeated by the Lord God. That's why that the Israilitas snatched_away the land of the Amunihanons who are residents of that place. 22 They won_over all the all the places resided by the Amurihanons from the Arnun River up_to the Habuk River, and from the desert also up_to the River Hurdan. 23 Therefore the Lord God of Israil sent_away the Amurihanons in_order that their place will_be_resided_over by the Israilitas. What is your(pl) right to take_ it _back? 24 Own(pl) what_ your(pl) false_god Kimus _gave to you(pl), and what's_ the Lord our(excl) God _has_given, that's what_ we(excl) _own. 25 [xr]Did you(pl) believe that you(pl) are better than the king of Muwab that's (particularly) Balak the child of Sipur? He never tried_to_initiate a fight with Israil, and nobody tried to fight with them. 26 About three hundred (300) years that the Israilitas lived there in Hisbun, Aruwir, and towns around them, and all the towns there at the edge of Arnun River. And why do you(pl) remember it now to take_ it _back? 27 There's_no mistake that I did to you(pl), but you(pl) (are) the (one who) made wrong me because you(pl) fight with me. And the Lord God will_judge who has a fault; the Israilitas or the Amunihanons.” 28 But the king of the Amunihanons did not pay_attention to what_ Hipta _caused_ him(excl) _to_make_understood.

29 Ne in-umaan si Hipta te Panisingan te Magbebaye ne Manama. Ne miggendiye sikandin te Gilyad wey te Manasis, wey nataman miglibed e sikandin diye te Mispa ne sakup te Gilyad. Ne puun diye, inlusuran din ka me Amunihanen. 30 Ne migsaad si Hipta diye te Magbebaye ne Manama te migkahi, “Emun ke egpepanaluwen a nikeykew te me Amunihanen, 31 ka an-anayan ne eglihawang te baley ku eyew egsinug-ung keddi te peg-uli ku ne migpanalu, igbehey ku keykew sikandin wey ke igpanubad ku naa keykew ne egtutungen.” 32 Ne inlusuran ni Hipta ka me Amunihanen, wey impepanalu sikandin te Magbebaye ne Manama. 33 Natalu rin ka me Amunihanen wey nasakup din ka daruwa ne pulu (20) ne siyudad puun te Aruwir peendiye te inged ne nakalingut te Mimit, taman diye te Abil-Kiramim. Masulug amana ka me Amunihanen ne neyimatayan te me Israilita.

29 And the Spirit of the Lord God came to Hipta. And he went to Gilyad and Manasis, and then he returned there in Mispa under_the_jurisdiction of Gilyad. And from there, he attacked the Amunihanons. 30 And Hipta promised to the Lord God and said, “If you(sg) cause_ me _to_win_over the Amunihanons, 31 the first one_to_come_out my house in_order to meet me on my returning from winning, I will_give him/her to you(sg) or I will_sacrificed to you(sg) that will_be_burned.” 32 And Hipta attacked the Amunihanons, and the Lord God caused_ him _to_win. 33 He defeated the Amunihanons and won_over (LIT put_under) the twenty (20) cities from Aruwir up_to the place around the Mimit, up_to there in Abil-kiramim. The Israilitas killed many Amurihanons.

Ka mengebay ne anak ni Hipta

The unmarried_woman of Hipta

34 Te peg-uli e ni Hipta diye te baley rin te Mispa, migsinug-ung kandin ka anak din ne mengebay ne migsayew ka migtetagpi te tamburin. Sabsabeka seeye ne anak din wey warad duma ne anak din ne lukes wey ke malitan naa. 35 Te pegkakita ni Hipta kandin, inggisi din ka kumbale din tenged te pegkalange din wey migkahi sikandin, “Keyey, anak ku! Ka pegtemu nu keddi iyan egpuunan ne egkenenduenan a wey egkasakitan a amana. Nakasaad a te Magbebaye ne Manama wey kene ku seini egkasupak.”

34 On the returning of Hipta there in his house in Mispa, his unmarried_woman child met him who danced tapping a tambourine(s). She's his only child and he had no other male children or female. 35 When Hipta saw her, he torn his clothing because of his sorrow and he said, “Oh no, my child! Your(sg) meeting of me is the reason that I will_be_offended and hurt very much. I promised to the Lord God and I can't revoke_it.”

36 Ne migkahi ka anak din, “Ame, puun su migsaad ka te Magbebaye ne Manama, tumana nu ke nekey ka insaad nu kandin su migpanalu ke ma te inggira nu ka me Amunihanen.” 37 Migkahi pad man-e sikandin, “Piru duen pad ighangyu ku keykew. Kaayun ubag ne egbehayan a nikeykew te daruwa ne bulan eyew egleug-leug wey eglungku diye te me bubungan duma te me alukuy ku su kena ad ma egpakaasawa.” 38 Ne migkahi si Hipta, “Uya, egkaayun ka ne eggipanew.” Seeye naa ka impaleleug din ka anak din duma te me alukuy rin te daruwa ne bulan wey miglungku sikandan tenged su kenad sikandin egpakaasawa.[fn] 39 Pegkeimpus te daruwa ne bulan, mig-uli e sikandin diye te amey rin. Ne intuman ni Hipta ka insaad din te Magbebaye ne Manama wey warad nakaasawa[fn] ka anak din.

36 And her child said, “Dad, since you(sg) promised to the Lord God, fulfill(sg) what_ you(sg) _promised to him because you(sg) won_over in warring with Amunihanons.” 37 She said again, “But I have something_to_ask you(sg). Can you(sg) possibly give me two months in_order to wander and mourn there in the mountains with my friends because I could no_longer marry.” 38 And Hipta said, “Yes, you(sg) can go.” So then he let_ his child _wandered with his friends for two months and they mourned because she can't marry any_longer.[fn] 39 After two months, she returned there to her father. And Hipta fulfilled what_ he _promised to the Lord God and his child never married.[fn]

Puun dutu, nabatasan e seeye te me Israilita,40 ne tagse leg-un, eglungku te hep-at ne aldew ka me malitan tenged te anak ni Hipta.

From there, that became_a_custom by Israilitas,40 that every year, the women will_mourn for four days because of Hipta's child.

Si Hipta wey ka matig-Ipraim

Hipta and the (ones) from_Ipraim

121 Ne nanlibulung ka me lukes te kabuhalan ni Ipraim ka egpakigbunu. Nanlapas sikandan peendiye te Sapun wey ingkahiyan dan si Hipta, “Mania te inggira ka te me Amunihanen ne ware mignangen kanami eyew egduma keykew? Tenged te inggimu nu, iglagkes ney sikeykew te egsilab te baley nu.”

121 And the males from the descendant of Ipraim gathered for fighting. They crossed to Sapun and they told Hipta, “Why did you(sg) fight with the Amunihanons and not telling us(excl) in_order to accompany you(sg)? Because of what you've(sg) done, we(excl) will_burn you(sg) together_with your(sg) house.”

2 Piru ingkahiyan sikandan ni Hipta, “Due samuk ney wey te me Amunihanen. Migpangananey a kaniyu, piru ware key nikaniyu bulihi. 3 Te natahaan ku ne kene kew egbulig keddi, ware kud sumsumana ka egsahapan ku te miglusud te me Amunihanen wey impepanalu a te Magbebaye ne Manama. Ne kuntee, mania te nangengkayi kew ka egpakig-ehet keddi?” 4 Piru migkahi ka me matig-Ipraim, “Sikaniyu se me matig-Gilyad, kene kew ne mahinged kayi te Ipraim wey te Manasis. Miglapu kew re kayi te kanami.” Purisu, inlibulung ni Hipta ka langun ne mahinged te Gilyad wey inggira ran ka me matig-Ipraim wey natalu ran ka me matig-Ipraim. 5 Ne imbantayan te me matig-Gilyad ka me lapasanan te Hurdan eyew kenad egpakalapas ka me matig-Ipraim. Emun ke due egpakalapas ne matig-Ipraim, eg-insaan sikandin te matig-Gilyad, “Matig-Ipraim ka?” Emun ke egkahi sikandin, “Kene,” 6 egpalalahen dan sikandin te Sibulit.[fn] Ne emun ke egkeuney sikandin wey kene egkatuenan te eglalag ka Sibulit, ne egdakepen e sikandin wey eggimatayan diye. Te seeye ne timpu, due hep-at ne pulu wey daruwa ne libu (42,000) ne me matig-Ipraim ne neyimatayan.

2 But they were_told by Hipta, “We(excl) have a fight with Amunihanons. I asked_for_help from you(pl), but you(pl) didn't help us(excl). 3 When I knew that you(pl) won't help me, I didn't think of my risk to fight with the Amunihanons and the Lord God allowed me to win. And today, why did you(pl) come_here to fight with me?” 4 But the (ones) from_Ipraim said, “You(pl) (ones) from_Gilyad, you(pl) are not residents here in Ipraim and Manasis. You(pl) just sojourned here with us(excl).” Therefore, Hipta gathered all the residents of Gilyad and they fought with the (ones) from_Israil and they defeated the (ones) from_Ipraim. 5 The (ones) from_Gilyad guarded the fords of Hurdan in_order that the (one) from_Ipraim won't be_able_to_cross. If there's one from_Ipraim can cross, the (ones) from_Gilyad will_ask him, “Are you(sg) from_Ipraim?” If he will_say, “No,” 6 they asked_ him _to_say Sibulit.[fn] And if he can't_pronounce_it and won't be_able_to_say Sibulit correctly, he will_be_caught and be_killed there. At that time, there were forty-two thousand (42,000) people_of_Ipraim who died.

7 Neyimu ne pangulu[fn] si Hipta ne matig-Gilyad te Israil te hen-em ne leg-un. Te migpatey e si Hipta, diye sikandin ilebeng te Gilyad ne lungsud din.

7 Hipta from_Gilyad became leader[fn] in Israil for six years. When Hipta died, he was_buried there in his town Gilyad.

Ka me pangulu ne ensi Ibsan, si Ilun wey si Abdun

The leaders Ibsan, Ilun and Abdun

8 Pegkeimpus ni Hipta, iyan neyimu ne pangulu te Israil si Ibsan ne matig-Bitlihim. 9 Due tatelu ne pulu (30) ne anak din ne lukes wey due degma tatelu ne pulu (30) ne anak din ne malitan. Ne impaasawaan din ka langun ne anak din te kene ne karumaan din. Migpangulu si Ibsan te Israil te pitu ne leg-un. 10 Te migpatey e si Ibsan, diye sikandin ilebeng te Bitlihim.

8 After Hipta, Ibsan from_Bitlihim became the leader in Israil. 9 He had thirty (30) male children and he had thirty (30) female children also. He caused_ his all children _to_marry ones_ who were not _relatives. Ibsan led Israil for seven years. 10 When Ibsan died, he was_buried in Bitlihim.

11 Pegkeimpus ni Ibsan, iyan neyimu ne pangulu te Israil si Ilun ne matig-Sabulun. Migpangulu si Ilun te sapulu (10) ne leg-un te Israil. 12 Te migpatey e si Ilun, diye sikandin ilebeng te Ahalun ne sakup te Sabulun. 13 Pegkeimpus ni Ilun, iyan neyimu ne pangulu te Israil si Abdun ne anak ni Hilil ne matig-Piratun. 14 Due hep-at ne pulu (40) ne anak din ne lukes wey due tatelu ne pulu (30) ne apu din ne lukes. Langun dan ne due asnu ne unturanan. Migwalu ne leg-un si Abdun ka migpangulu te Israil. 15 Te migpatey e sikandin, inlebeng sikandin diye te Piratun ne sakup te Ipraim ne diye te bubungan ne inged te me matig-Amalik.

11 After Ibsan, Ilun from_Sabulun became leader in Israil. Ilun led Israil for ten (10) years. 12 When Ilun died, he was_buried there in Ahalun under_the_jurisdiction of Sabulun. 13 After Ilun, Abdun the child of Hilil from_Piratun became leader in Israil. 14 He had forty (40) male children and he had thirty (30) male grandchildren. All of them had donkey to ride. Abdun led Israil for eight years. 15 When he died, he was_buried there in Piratun under_the_jurisdiction of Ipraim that's there on the mountain the place of the (ones) from_Amalik.

Ka pegkeetew ni Samsun

The birthing of Samsun

131 Ne miggimu e man-e te mareet ka me Israilita diye te tangkaan te Magbebaye ne Manama. Purisu impeuripen din e man-e sikandan te me Pilistihanen te hep-at ne pulu (40) ne leg-un. 2 Ne due etew ne matig-Sura ne egngaranan ki Manuwa ne kabuhalan ni Dan. Ne kene eg-anak ka asawa rin. 3 Sabeka ne aldew, migpakita ka panalihan te Magbebaye ne Manama diye te asawa ni Manuwa wey migkahi, “Malehet ne ware me anak nu. Piru egkaberes ka wey eg-anak ka te lukes. 4 Purisu puun kuntee, kene ka inum te binu wey minsan nekey ne egpekewubug ne inumen, wey kene ka keen te egkakeen ne in-isip ne malindit. 5 [xr]Emun ke eglesut e ka anak nu, kene nu patempuhi ka bulbul rin su inhalad e sikandin diye te Manama eyew egkeyimu ne Nasariyu[fn] puun te peglesut din pad. Sikandin ka egbunsud ne egluwas te Israil puun te me Pilistihanen.”

131 And the Israilitas did bad_things again there in front of the Lord God. Therefore he caused_ them _to_be_slaves again of Pilistihanons for forty (40) years. 2 And there was a person from_Sura who was_named Manuwa from the descendant of Dan. And his spouse could not give_birth. 3 One day, the angel of the Lord God appeared there to the spouse of Manuwa and said, “It's true that you(sg) have no children. But you(sg) will_become_pregnant and you(sg) will_give_birth to a male. 4 Therefore from now, don't(sg) drink wine and whatever liquor (LIT able_to_get_drunk_on drinks), and don't(sg) eat foods that are_considered dirty. 5 [xr]When your(sg) child is born, don't(sg) cut his hair because he is offered to God to become a Nasariyu[fn] from his birth. He (is) the one to start saving Israil from the Pilistihanons.”

6 Ne miggendiye ka malitan te asawa rin wey ingkahiyan din, “Due migpakita keddi ne impeuyan te Manama. Egpekeiling sikandin te panalihan te Manama. Naaldek a amana. Wara a mig-inse ke hendei sikandin migpuun wey ware degma sikandin migpanugtul keddi. 7 Piru ingkahiyan a nikandin, ‘Egkaberes kad e wey lukes ka igkaberes nu. Purisu puun kuntee, kene ka inum te binu wey minsan nekey ne egpekewubug ne inumen, wey kene ka keen te egkakeen ne in-isip ne malindit. Su inhalad e diye Manama ka bate eyew egkeyimu ne Nasariyu puun pad te peglesut din taman te egpatey sikandin.’ ”

6 And the woman went to her spouse and told him, “There's one who appeared to me sent by God. He was like an angel of God. I was so afraid. I didn't ask where he came from and he didn't tell me also. 7 But I was_told by him, ‘You(sg) will_be_pregnant already and you(sg) conceive a male. Therefore from now, don't(sg) drink wine and whatever liquor (LIT able_to_get_drank drink), and don't(sg) eat food that's considered dirty. Because the child is offered to God to become a Nazirite from his birth until he dies.’ ”

8 Ne tenged kayi, mig-ampu si Manuwa diye te Magbebaye ne Manama ne migkahi, “He Magbebaye ne Manama, egpeyid-u-hid-u a keykew, palibera nu pa ubag ka etew ne impeendini nu eyew egpanuluen key ke nekey ka eggimuwen ney ke eglesut e ka bate.” 9 Ne intabak te Manama ka peg-ampu ni Manuwa. Mig-abey migpakita ka panalihan te Manama diye te asawa ni Manuwa taheed te migpinnuu sikandin diye te kamet; piru te seeye ne timpu, ware si Manuwa ne iglukes din. 10 Purisu, miglambunus sikandin miggendiye te iglukes din wey ingkahiyan din, “Kayi kuntee ka etew ne migpakita keddi te miglihad ne aldew.” 11 Ne migsasindeg si Manuwa wey migsinundul te asawa rin. Te pegkakita rin te etew, mig-inse sikandin, “Sikeykew ka migpakiglalag te asawa ku?”

8 And due to it, Manuwa prayed there to the Lord God and said, “He Lord God, I plead to you(sg), please cause_ the person _to_return that you(sg) sent_here so_that we(excl) will_be_taught on what we(excl) will_do when the child is born.” 9 And God answered the prayer of Manuwa. The angel of God appeared again there to the spouse of Manuwa while she sat there in the field; but on that time, her husband Manuwa was not_there. 10 Therefore, she hurriedly went to her husband and told him, “The man who appeared to me on the other day is here now.” 11 And Manuwa stood and followed his spouse. When he saw the person, he asked, “Are you(sg) the (one who) spoke to my spouse?”

Migtabak ka etew, “Uya, sikeddi.”

The person answered, “Yes, I am.”

12 Ne migkahi si Manuwa, “Ke egkatuman e ka inlalag nu, nekey ka egkeula-ula te bate wey nekey ka eleg ne eggimuwen din?”

12 And Manuwa, “When what_ you(sg) _said is fulfilled, what will_be_the_fate of the child and what the correct (things) that he will_do?”

13 Ne migtabak ka panalihan te Magbebaye ne Manama ki Manuwa, “Keilangan ne egtantanuran te asawa nu ka langun ne ingkahi ku kandin. 14 Keilangan ne kene sikandin egkeen te minsan nekey ne egpuun te paras. Kene man-e sikandin eg-inum te minsan nekey ne binu wey ke inumen naa ne egpekewubug, wey ke egkeen naa te minsan nekey ne egkakeen ne in-isip ne malindit. Ipatuman nu kandin ka langun ne ingkahi ku kandin.”

13 And the angel of the Lord God answered Manuwa, “Your(sg) spouse must remember all that I told her. 14 She must not eat whatever that's from the grapevines. She must not drink any wine or liquor (LIT able_to_get_drank drink), or eat whatever that's considered dirty. Cause_ her _to_fulfill all that I told her.”

15-16 Ne ingkahiyan ni Manuwa ka panalihan te Magbebaye ne Manama, “Kaayun ne kene ke pa hipanew su eggilangan ney pad sikeykew te nati te kambing?”

15-16 And Manuwa told the angel of the Lord God, “Is it possible that you(sg) won't go yet because we(excl) will_slaughter a kid of goat for you(sg)?”

Ne migtabak ka panalihan, “Minsan ke eghawiran a nikaniyu, kena a egkeen te minsan nekey ne keenen. Piru egkaayun ne eg-andam ka te igpanubad ne egtutungen para te Magbebaye ne Manama.” (Ware nataheyi ni Manuwa ne panalihan bes seeye te Magbebaye ne Manama.)

And the angel answered, “Even if you(pl) stop me, I won't eat whatever food. But it's_possible that you(sg) prepare a burnt offering for the Lord God.” (Manuwa didn't know that he was an angel of the Lord God.)

17 Ne ingkahiyan ni Manuwa ka panalihan, “Hentew-a ka ngaran nu? Su egbantuhen ney sikeykew emun ke egkatuman e ka inlalag nu.”

17 And Manuwa told the angel, “What's (LIT Who's) your(sg) name? Because we(excl) will_make_ you(sg) _great if what you(sg) said will_be_fulfilled.”

18 Ne migtabak ka panalihan, “Mania te eg-inse ka te ngaran ku? Kene nu egkasabut ka ngaran ku.”

18 And the angel answered, “Why are you(sg) asking my name? You(sg) won't understand my name.”

19 Ne mig-angey e si Manuwa te nati ne kambing wey keenen, ne inhalad din seini diye te batu ne altar te Magbebaye ne Manama. Taheed te migtengteng si Manuwa wey ka asawa rin, due kein-inuwan ne inggimu te panalihan te Magbebaye ne Manama. 20 Te migkanlabkanlab e ka hapuy peendiye te langit, nabatun e ka panalihan te Magbebaye ne Manama duma te hapuy. Te pegkakita dutu te alunggun, miglangkeb sikandan diye te tane. 21 Ne warad mig-abey migpakita kandan ka panalihan. Ne dutu, nanengnengan ni Manuwa ne panalihan bes seeye te Magbebaye ne Manama.

19 And Manuwa took a kid of goat and food, and he offered it there on the stone altar of the Lord God. While Manuwa and his spouse were watching, there's a miracle that the angel of the Lord God did. 20 When the fire was blazing up_to the heaven, the angel of the Lord God was_brought up with the fire. When the couple saw it, they fell_down on the ground. 21 And the angel didn't appear to them again. And there, Manuwa knew that he was an angel of the Lord God.

22 Ne migkahiyan ni Manuwa ka asawa rin, “Egkapatey kid iya tenged su nakakita ki te Manama!”

22 And Manuwa said to his spouse, “We(incl) surely die because we(incl) saw God!”

23 Piru migtabak ka asawa rin, “Emun ke eggimatayan ki pa te Magbebaye ne Manama, ware din e perem dawata ka impanubad ta. Ne ware din e perem ipakita ka me kein-inuwan, wey ware din perem ihuhud seini kanta kuntee.”

23 But his spouse answered, “If the Lord God wants to kill us(excl), he would not have accepted our(excl) sacrifice. And he would not have shown the miracles, and he would not have told this to us(excl).”

24 Nataman, inlesutan en iya ka asawa ni Manuwa te lukes ne bate wey ingngaranan dan ki Samsun. Migtulin ka bate ne impanalanginan te Magbebaye ne Manama. 25 Ne migbunsud ka Panisingan te Magbebaye ne Manama ne migweil kandin taheed te diye sikandin mig-ugpe te Mahani-Dan, ne diye te elat-elat te Sura wey Istaul.

24 Later, the spouse of Manuwa truly gave_birth to a male boy and they called (him) Samsun. The child grew and blessed by the Lord God. 25 And the Spirit of the Lord God moved in him while he was living there in Mahani-dan, which was in between Sura ang Istaul.

Si Samsun wey ka malitan ne matig-Timna

Samsun and the woman from_Timna

141 Sabeka ne aldew, miggendiye si Samsun te Timna. Ne diye, due nakita rin ne mengebay ne Pilistihanen. 2 Te peg-uli din, ingkahiyan din ka amey rin wey iney rin, “Due nakita ku ne mengebay ne Pilistihanen diye te Timna; angaya niyu sikandin su eg-asaween ku.”

141 One day, Samsun went to Timna. And there, there's a unmarried_ Pilistihanon _woman that he saw. 2 On his going_home, he told his father and his mother, “There's an unmarried_ Pilistihanon _woman that I saw there in Timna; get(pl) her because I will_marry her.”

3 Piru ingkahiyan sikandin te amey rin wey iney rin, “Mania te egpangasawa ka te kabuhalan te me Pilistihanen ne ware migpalintutuu te Manama?[fn] Masulug ka malitan kayi ne karumaan ta wey minsan diye te lein ne kabuhalan te Israil.” Piru migtabak si Samsun, “Sikandin de iya angaya niyu su sikandin de ka igkeupii ku te eg-asawa.”

3 But he was_told by his father and his mother, “Why are you(sg) marrying a the descendant of the Pilistihanons that did not believe in God?[fn] There are many woman here who are our(incl) relatives and even there in other descendants of Israil.” But Samsun answered, “Just get(pl) her because she's the only_one I want to marry.”

4 Ne ware nakataha ka amey rin wey iney rin ne igkeupii bes te Magbebaye ne Manama seeye ne egkeyitabu. Su egpamitew ka Manama te etew ne egsesamuk te me Pilistihanen. Te seeye ne timpu iyan migmandu te Israil ka me Pilistihanen.

4 And his father and his mother didn't know that the Lord God wanted it to happen. Because God was looking for someone to make_trouble with the Pilistihanons. At that time the one ruling in Israil were the Pilistihanons.

5 Ne migparumeey e ensi Samsun te amey rin wey te iney rin diye te Timna. Te diyad sikandan te dalan diye te parasan te Timna, due nati pad ne liyun ne egdula ki Samsun. 6 Ne in-umaan sikandin te Panisingan te Magbebaye ne Manama minsan ware panganiban din, inggimatayan din ka liyun ne para kandin, iling de kahuye te nati te kambing. Piru ware din seini ipangguhud te amey rin wey iney rin.

5 And Samsun and his father and his mother went_together there in Timna. When they were on the way there at the grapevines in Timna, there_was a young lion that attacked Samsun. 6 And the Spirit of the Lord God moved in him and even he had no weapon, he killed the lion that for him, it seemed as weak as a young goat. But he didn't tell it to his father and his mother.

7 Ne miggendiyaan ni Samsun ka malitan wey migpakiglalag kandin. Amana ingkatelesi ni Samsun ka malitan. 8 Te ware naluhey, miglibed sikandin ka egpangasawa te malitan. Ne migtulanan din pad ka liyun ne inggimatayan din. Pegpitew rin, iyan din en iya se patiyukan wey due teneb diye te lawa te liyun. 9 Ne migkuwa sikandin te teneb wey ingkeen din seini te sasangan sikandin ne eggipanew. Te nakita rin ka amey rin wey iney rin, imbehayan din sikandan wey migkeen degma sikandan. Piru ware din ipangguhud kandan ne diye din kua ka teneb te lawa te napatey ne liyun. 10 Ne migtupang ka amey ni Samsun diye te baley te eg-asaween ni Samsun. Ne migpasahakeen si Samsun diye su iling iya rue ka nabatasan ne eggimuwen te me kanakan ne egpangasawa. 11 Te diyad si Samsun, nakita te me Pilistihanen ne ware duma rin, sikan naa ka imparumaan dan e sikandin te tatelu ne pulu (30) ne kanakan. 12 Ne migkahiyan sikandan ni Samsun, “Due egpaantukan ku kaniyu. Emun ke egkaantukan niyu seini te kene pad egkeimpusan ka pitu ne aldew ne sahakeen, egbehayan ku sikaniyu te tatelu ne pulu (30) ne hinabel, wey tatelu ne pulu (30) ne lukut ne manggad. 13 Piru emun ke kene niyu egkaantukan seini, sikaniyu ka egbehey keddi te tatelu ne pulu (30) ne hinabel, wey tatelu ne pulu (30) ne lukut ne manggad.”

7 And Samsun went to the woman and spoke to her. Samsun liked the woman very much. 8 Not long enough, he returned to marry the woman. And he stopped_by with the lion that he killed. When he looked_at (it), he saw (emph) a bees and there's a honey there at the body of the lion. 9 He took a honey and he ate it while he was walking. When he saw his father and mother, he gave them and they also ate. But he didn't tell them that he took the honey from the body of the lion. 10 And the father of Samsun went_downhill to the house of fiancèe of Samsun. And Samsun made_a_feast there because the unmarried_men accustomed to do like that when marrying. 11 When Samsun was there already, the Pilistihanons saw that he had no companion, that's why they caused_ him _to_be_accompanied by thirty (30) unmarried_men. 12 And Samsun said to them, “I have a riddle for you(pl). If you(pl) are able_to_tell it before the seven days of feast ends, I will_give you(pl) thirty (30) cloths, and thirty (30) pieces of garments. 13 But if you(pl) are_ not _able_to_tell it, you(pl) (are) the one to give me thirty (30) cloths, and thirty (30) pieces of garments.”

Ne migtabak sikandan, “Uya. Ne ihuhud nu lad ke nekey ka egpaantukan nu kanami.”

And they answered, “Yes. And now tell what is your(sg) riddle to us(excl).”

14 Migkahi si Samsun,

14 And Samsun said,

“Puun te talagkeen, miglihawang ka egkakeen;

“From the eater, came_out something_to_eat;

puun te manekal, miglihawang ka meemis.”

from the strong, came_out something_sweet.”

Ne natateluwan e ne ware dan de due natabak ka impaantukan din.

And it_took_three_days that they were_ not _able_to_tell what his riddle was.

15 Te igkeep-at e ne aldew, ingkahiyan dan ka asawa ni Samsun, “Ginaliha nu ka asawa nu eyew egpangguhud ke nekey ka tabak te impaantukan din. Su emun ke kene nu egginalihen, egsilaban ney sikeykew lagkes ka pamilya te amey nu. Ingnginggat key naan de nikaniyu kayi eyew egpaneleppian?”

15 On the fourth day, they told the wife of Samsun, “Entice your(sg) husband in_order that he will_tell the answer of his riddle. Because if you(sg) don't entice (him), we(excl) will_burn you(sg) including the family of your(sg) father. Were_ we(excl) _invited here by_you(pl) in_order to_get_money (from_us)?”

16 Purisu miggendiye ki Samsun ka asawa rin ne migsinehew wey migkahi, “Ware e bes nikeykew geyinawei! Igkeepes e bes nikeykew! Due impaantukan nu te me karumaan ku, piru wara a nikeykew guhuri ke nekey ka tabak.”

16 Therefore the spouse of Samsun went to him crying and saying, “You(sg) don't love me! You(sg) don't like me! You(sg) have a riddle for my relatives, but you(sg) didn't tell me what's the answered.”

Migtabak si Samsun, “Ware ku ma gani pangguhuri ka amey wey iney ku, iyan ku naan pa iya guhuri sikeykew?”17 Ne puun dutu, layun e egsinsinehew ka asawa ni Samsun te intiru ne sahakeen te pitu ne aldew. Purisu, te igkapitu e ne aldew, ingguhuran din e ka asawa rin su egpamehes ma. Ne ingguhud e degma seini te asawa rin diye te me karumaan din. 18 Purisu, te ware pad nasagkup te igkapitu ne aldew, intabak dan e ka impaantukan din kandan.

Samsun answered, “I didn't tell (it) to my father and mother, should I tell you(sg) even more than (them)?”17 And from there, Samsun's spouse always cried the entire feast in seven days. Therefore, on the seventh day, he told (it) to his spouse because (she's) forced (him). And his spouse told it also there to her relatives. 18 Therefore, before the sun_sets on the seventh day, they answered his riddle to them.

Kahi ran, “Liyun ka subla ne manekal.

They said, “A lion is the strongest.

Teneb ka subla ne meemis.”

Honey is the sweetest.”

Ne migtabak si Samsun,

And Samsun answered,

“Emun ke ware niyu pehesa ka asawa ku,[fn]

“If you(pl) didn't force my spouse,[fn]

ware kew perem nakaantuk.”

you(pl) weren't able_to_tell.”

19 Ne in-umaan e man-e si Samsun te Panisingan te Magbebaye ne Manama. Ne miggendiye sikandin te Askalun wey impangimatayan din diye ka tatelu ne pulu (30) ne etew. Impangahew rin ka mateles ne me hinabel ran, wey imbehey rin seini te me etew ne nakatabak ne impaantukan din. Nataman, mig-uli e sikandin diye te baley te amey rin ne nangebel-ebel se langet. 20 Ne iyan e impaasawa te eg-asaween ni Samsun ka lukes ne migbulig kandin te kasal.

19 And the Spirit of the Lord God was on Samsun. And he went to Askalun and he killed thirty (30) people there. He snatched_away their good cloths, and he gave them to the people who were able_to_answer of his riddle. Then, he went home there at the house of his father after with smoking anger. 20 And the (one who) caused_to_marry the fiancèe of Samsun was the man who helped him with the wedding.

151 Te ware naluhey, te tinggaani te trigu, inleuy ni Samsun ka eg-asaween din wey mig-uyan sikandin te nati pad ne kambing. Ne ingkahiyan din ka anuhang din ne lukes, “Egkeupian a ne egseled diye te sinabeng te eg-asaween ku.” Piru ware sikandin paselera te anuhang din. 2 Migkahi ka anuhang din, “Kahiyen ku naa ne nabelu-belu ka kandin, sikan naa ka impaasawaan kud sikandin te lukes ne migbulig keykew. Piru due hari rin ne mateles pad kandin. Sikandin e asawaa nu.”

151 Not long enough, at harvesting of wheat, Samsun visited his fiancèe and he brought a kid of goat. And he said to his father-in-law, “I want to enter there at the room of my fiancèe.” But he was not allowed to enter by his father-in-law. 2 His father-in-law said, “I thought that you(sg) were so_angry with her, that's why I caused_ her _to_be_married with a man who helped you(sg). But he has a younger_sister who is more beautiful than her. Marry her instead.”

3 Piru migkahi si Samsun, “Ke iling ma rue, kena a senditi nikaniyu te mareet ne eggimuwen ku kaniyu te me Pilistihanen!” 4 Sikan naa ka miggipanew sikandin wey migpandakep te tatelu ne gatus (300) ne laku.
