5 Mikiyas has a prayer place. He also made an ipud and a false_gods. And one of his children he made into a sacrificer. 6 There was not king at that time, that's why they did whatever_things that they thought that (it) correct indeed.

7 Ne due kanakan ne egpuun te Bitlihim ne sakup te Huda. Sabeka sikandin ne Libita[fn] ne migtaheed mig-ugpe diye te me kabuhalan ni Huda. 8 Sabeka ne aldew, mig-awe sikandin diye te Bitlihim ka egpamitew te duma ne inged ne egkeugpaan din. Te peggipanew rin, nakabaye sikandin diye te baley ni Mikiyas diye te bubungan te Ipraim. 9 Ne mig-insaan sikandin ni Mikiyas, “Hendei ka migpuun?”

7 And there_was a young_man from Bitlihim under_the_jurisdiction of Huda. He was a Libita[fn] who lived temporarily there with the descendants of Huda. 8 One day, he left Bitlihim to seek other place he could live. On his journey, he passed_through there at the house of Mikiyas there on the mountains of Ipraim. 9 And Mikiyas asked him, “Where do you(sg) from?”

Ne migtabak sikandin, “Diya a migpuun te Bitlihim ne sakup te Huda, wey Libita a. Egpamitew a te inged ne eg-ugpaan ku.”

And he answered, “I came from Bitlihim under_the_jurisdiction of Huda, and I am Libita. I am looking for a place I could live.”

10 Ne ingkahiyan sikandin ni Mikiyas, “Lemung kad keddi. Eggimuwen ku sikeykew ne talagpanubad wey talagtambag[fn] ku. Ne tagse leg-un, egbehayan ku sikeykew te sapulu ne pelata, me kumbale, wey egkekeen.” 11 Ne nabennalan ka kanakan ne Libita ne eglemung kandin wey in-isip din seini ne iling te anak din. 12 Ne inggimu sikandin ni Mikiyas ne talagpanubad wey impeugpe din te baley rin. 13 Ne migkahi si Mikiyas, “Nakataha a kuntee ne ka Magbebaye ne Manama egpanalangin keddi, su ka talagpanubad ku, Libita ma.”

10 And he was_told by Mikiyas, “Live(sg) with me. I will_make you(sg) my sacrificer and advisor.[fn] And every year, I will_give you(sg) ten silver, clothing, and something_to_eat.” 11 And the young Libita was convinced to live with him and he considered him as his child. 12 And Mikiyas made him a sacrificer and let him lived in his house. 13 And Mikiyas said, “I know today that the Lord God will_bless me, because my sacrificer, is a Libita.”

Si Mikiyas wey ka me kabuhalan ni Dan

Mikiyas and the descendants of Dan

181 Te seeye ne timpu, ware Hari te Israil. Ne ka me kabuhalan ni Dan egpamitew degma te egkeugpaan dan, su te seeye ne timpu sikandan naan de ka kabuhalan te Israil ne ware pad tane. 2 Sikan naa ka mig-alam ka me kabuhalan ni Dan te lalimma ne etew ne bahani ne egpuun te lungsud te Sura wey te Istaul. In-alam sikandan te langun ne etew eyew egpepamitawen wey egpepanleuyen te tane ne eg-angkenen dan. Ne nangendiyad sikandan wey migginguma diye te bubungan te Ipraim, wey diyad sikandan nakaaran te baley ni Mikiyas. 3 Te diyad sikandan te baley ni Mikiyas, neilaan dan ka peglalag-lalag te kanakan ne Libita. Sikan naa ka migtulan sikandan wey mig-insaan dan sikandin, “Mania te nekeendini ka? Hentew-a ka mig-uyan keykew kayi? Nekey ka egkuen nu kayi?”

181 At that time, Israil has no king. And the descendants of Dan was seeking also for the place_ they _could_live, because at that time they were only the descendant of Israil that had no land. 2 So then the descendants of Dan chose five persons who were warriors from the town of Sura and Istaul. They were_chosen by all people in_order to search and look_out a land that they will_possess. And they went and reached the mountain of Ipraim, and they stayed_overnight in the house of Mikiyas. 3 When they were at the house of Mikiyas, they recognized the speaking/accent of the young Libita. That's why they stopped_by and they asked him, “Why do you(sg) able_to_come_here? Who brought you(sg) here? What are you(sg) going_to_get here?”

4 Ne migtabak ka Libita, “Ingkuwa a ni Mikiyas ne talagpanubad din wey egbayaran a nikandin.”

4 And the Libita answered, “Mikiyas took me as his sacrificer and he pays me.”

5 Ingkahiyan dan sikandin, “Insei nu ubag ka Manama ke meupiya red ka egpabulusan te hipanew ney.”

5 They told him, “Please ask God if the result of our(excl) trip is good.”

6 Ne migtabak ka Libita, “Kene kew kalaggew. Egtantanuran kew te Magbebaye ne Manama te hipanew niyu.”

6 And the Libita answered, “Don't(pl) worry. The Lord God will_be_mindful of you(pl) on your(pl) trip.”

7 Purisu, migpabulus ka lalimma ne etew wey nekeyinguma sikandan diye te lungsud te Lais. Nakita ran ne meupiya ka peg-ugpe te me etew ne ware gubut wey ware igkabantali iling te peg-ugpe te me Sidunihanen. Matubung sikandan wey due ka langun ne egkeilanganen dan. Mariyu de ka Lais te ugpaan te me Sidunihanen wey ware egpakabulig kandan. 8 Te peglibed te lalimma ne etew diye te Sura wey te Istaul, mig-insaan sikandan te me karumaan dan, “Nekey-a ka nakita niyu?” 9 Migtabak sikandan, “Nakita ney ne meupiya ka tane diye. Purisu kene kid e eglamu-lamu ka eglusud eyew egkaahew ta ka seeye ne tane wey eg-ugpaan tad.

7 Therefore, the five persons continued and they reached there to the town of Lais. They saw that the people have good living without war and nothing to worry like the living of the Sidunihanons. They were abundant and they had all that they needed. Lais is far from the home_place of Sidunihanons and nobody can help them. 8 When the people returned there in Sura and Istaul, they were asked by their relatives, “What did you(pl) see?” 9 They answered, “We(excl) saw that the land there_is good. Therefore we(incl) won't idle in attacking so_that we(incl) can win_over that land and we(incl) reside in it.

10 “Emun ke diye kid e, kene sikandan egsuman-suman ne eglusuran ta sikandan. Maluag ka tane dan, wey matubung pad iya man-e. Imbehey seini te Manama kanta.”

10 “And when we(incl) get there, they won't think that we(incl) will_attack them. Their land is vast, and also abundant. God gave this to us(incl).”

11 Sikan naa ka migtaggel e ne eglusud ka hen-em ne gatus (600) ne etew ne kabuhalan ni Dan ne egpuun te lungsud te Sura wey te Istaul. 12 Migpanakereg sikandan wey nangekampu diye te lenged te Kiryat-Hiyarim ne sakup te Huda. Sikan naa, minsan kuntee ingngaranan ka seeye ne inged te Kampu ni Dan. 13 Nataman, migpabulus sikandan taman te nekeyinguma sikandan diye te baley ni Mikiyas ne diye te bubungan te Ipraim.

11 That's why the six hundred (600) people who were descendants of Dan from the town of Sura and Istaul prepared to attack. 12 They went_uphill and camped at the near of Kiryat-Hirayim which was under_the_jurisdiction of Huda. That's why, even today that place is called Camp of Dan. 13 Then, they continued until they reached the house of Mikiyas there on the mountain of Ipraim.

14 Ne ingkahiyan te lalimma ne etew ne mig-iipat diye te Lais ka me karumaan dan, “Nakataha kew naa ne due me ipud[fn] kayi te seini ne baley, wey larawan? Ne kuntee, nekey ka meupiya ne eggimuwen ta?” 15 Sikan naa ka miggendiye sikandan te kanakan ne Libita diye te baley ni Mikiyas, wey mig-insaan dan ka Libita ke nekey e se peg-ugpe din. 16-17 Taheed mule te migsasindeg ka Libita wey ka hen-em ne gatus (600) ne sundalu diye te gumawan ne andam e ne egpakiggira, migseled ka lalimma ne talag-iipat diye te baley ni Mikiyas, wey ingkuwa ran e ka me ipud, wey ka larawan.

14 And the five persons who spied_out Lais said to their relatives, “Do you(pl) know that there are ipuds[fn] in this house, and a statue? And now/today, what's the good (thing) that we(incl) do?” 15 So then they went to the young Libita in the house of Mikiyas, and they inquired Libita about his situation (LIT if what's already his situation.) 16-17 While the Libita and the six hundred (600) soldiers who were ready to fight stood at the entrance, the five spies entered the house of Mikiyas, and they took ipuds, and the statue.

18 Te pegkakita te talagpanubad ne impanguwa te lalimma ne etew ka larawan, ka me ipud, mig-inse sikandin, “Mania te impanguwa niyu sika?”

18 When the sacrificer saw that the ipuds, and the statue were_taken by the five people, he asked, “Why are you(pl) taking those?”

19 Migtabak sikandan, “Peeneng-eneng kad due! Duma ke re kanami su eggimuwen ney sikeykew ne talagtambag ney wey talagpanubad ney. Hendei bes ka meupiya: ka egkeyimu ka ne talagpanubad te senge-pamilya re, wey ke talagpanubad te intiru ne tribu ni Dan?” 20 Nebennalan ka talagpanubad te ingkahi ran. Purisu, impanguwa rin ka me kumbale ne ipud, ingkulit ne larawan, wey inggimu ne larawan. Ne migdume e sikandin kandan.

19 They answered, “Shut_up(sg)! Just come(sg) with us(excl) because we(excl) will_make you(sg) as our(excl) advisor and our(excl) sacrificer. Which one is better: you(sg) become a sacrificer of just one family, or be a sacrificer for the entire tribe of Dan?” 20 The sacrificer was convinced of what_ they _said. Therefore, he took the ipud cloths, carved image, and created image. And he came with them.

21 Te peggipanew ran duma te me pamilya ran, impewun-a ran ka me bate wey me ayam. Impewun-a ran man-e ipeuyan ka me kasangkapan dan. 22 Te bayew e mariyu sikandan te baley ni Mikiyas, human pad nalibulung ka me sumbaley rin eyew eglupug ka egpakigkuntere te kabuhalan ni Dan. 23 Ne imbalukanan dan ka kabuhalan ni Dan eyew egpekeengked ka eggipanew. Ne miglilingey sikandan wey ingkahiyan ensi Mikiyas, “Nekey-a ka igkeupii niyu, mania te miglupug kew kanami?” 24 Ne migtabak si Mikiyas, “Mania te eg-inse kew pad? Ingkuwa niyu ka inggimu ku ne me diyus-diyus, wey ka talagpanubad ku? Ne warad nasame kayi te keddi.”

21 On their traveling along_with their family, they sent_ahead the children and the animals. They also sent_ahead their possessions. 22 When they were a bit distant from the house of Mikiyas, that's when his neighbors were able_to_assemble in_order to chase and fight with the descendants of Dan. 23 And they shouted to the descendants of Dan in_order to stop from walking. And they turned_around and told Mikiyas and others, “What do you(pl) want, why did you(pl) chase us(excl)?” 24 And Mikiyas answered, “Why are you(pl) still asking? You(pl) took_away the gods that I made, and my sacrificer? And nothing is left in me.”

25 Ingkahiyan sikandin te kabuhalan ni Dan, “Kene ka lalag te iling due su kema ke due egkabelu ne duma ney, wey eggimatayan ka nikandan lagkes ka pamilya nu!” 26 Ne migpabulus e miggipanew ka me kabuhalan ni Dan. Nakita ni Mikiyas ne kene din egkatalu sikandan, sikan naa ka mig-uli naan de sikandin.

25 And he was_told by the descendants of Dan, “Don't speak like that because some of our(excl) companions might be angry, and they will_kill you(sg) including your(sg) family!” 26 And the descendants of Dan continued traveling. Mikiyas saw that he could not defeat them, so then he just went_home.

27 Ne migpabulus ka me kabuhalan ni Dan diye te Lais. Ne in-uyan dan ka immangimu ni Mikiyas wey ka talagpanubad din. Inlusuran dan ka Lais, ka inged ne ware igkabantali wey ware gubut. Impangimatayan dan ka me mahinged diye, wey insilaban dan ka intiru ne siyudad. 28 Ne ware nakapangabang te me matig-Lais su mariyu ma sikandan te Sidun, wey ware sikandan migpakigsabeka te lein ne me etew. Diye seini ne inged te napu te Bit-Rihub. Ne imbalbalawan ipasasindeg te me kabuhalan ni Dan ka siyudad, wey diyad sikandan nangugpe. 29 Ingngaranan dan seini ne siyudad te Dan su impasangey te ngaran te kaapuan dan ne si Dan ne sabeka te me anak ni Hakub. Piru Lais dengan ka ngaran te sika ne siyudad. 30 Impasasindeg dan ka larawan ne inggimu ni Mikiyas wey insimba ran seeye. Si Diyunatan ne anak ni Hirsun ne apu ni Muwisis ka talagpanubad dan. Puun te seeye ne timpu, ka kabuhalan e ni Diyunatan ka talagpanubad dan taman te narakep e ka me Israilita. 31 Taheed te diye ka timplu te Manama te Silu, ka diyus-diyus degma ni Mikiyas ka insimba diye te Dan.

27 And the descendants of Dan continued there to Lais. They brought what_ Mikiyas _made and his sacrificer. They attacked Lais, the place without worries and without fighting. They killed the residents there, and they burned the entire city. 28 And nobody was_able_to_help the (ones) from_Lais because it was far from Sidun, and they won't unite with other people. This place was there in the valley of Bit-Rihub. And the city was erected again by the descendants of Dan, they lived there. 29 They called it a city of Dan because they named (it) after the name of their ancestor Dan who was one of the children of Hakub. But Lais was the former name of that city. 30 They erected the image that Mikiyas made and they worshiped it. Their sacrificer was Diyunatan the child of Hirsun who was a grandchild of Muwisis. From that time, the descendants of Diyunatan were their sacrificers until the Israilita's were_captured. 31 While the temple of God was in Silu, the god of Mikiyas was the one being_worshiped there in Dan.

Ka Libita wey ka duwey rin

The Libita and his junior_wife

191 Te timpu ne ware pad Hari te Israil, due Libita ne mig-ugpe diye te bubungan te Ipraim. Due duwey rin ne matig-Bitlihim ne sakup te Huda. 2 Kene eglayam ka duwey te Libita wey mig-uli e diye te amey rin diye te Bitlihim. Mig-uugpe sikandin diye te hep-at ne bulan. 3 Nataman, inlupug te Libita ka duwey rin eyew eg-inniyaten din ne eg-uli. Migduruma sikandin te suluhuanen din wey mig-uyan te daruwa ne asnu. Te pegginguma rin e diye, impalasud sikandin te duwey rin, wey te pegkakita te anuhang din kandin, in-alumama amana sikandin. 4 Ne inggawiran ka Libita te anuhang din ne lukes ne egpeuugpeen pad. Sikan naa ka migpalunggaat pad ka Libita te tatelu ne aldew. Nangeen sikandan, nangiinum, wey nanlipereng. 5 Te igkeep-at e ne aldew, migselem-selem sikandan ka mig-enew su egligkat e ka eg-uli. Piru ingkahiyan te amey te malitan ka mekaamung din, “Keen kew pa eyew kene kew eggutasan diye te deralanen; ne human kew naan pa hipanew.”

191 At the time when there_was_no king yet in Israil, there_was a Libita who lived there in the mountain of Ipraim. He had a junior_wife from_Bitlihim under_the_jurisdiction of Huda. 2 But the junior_wife of the Libita was not intimate (with him) and returned to his father there in Bitlihim. She lived there for four months. 3 Then, the Libita went after his junior_wife in_order to attract her to go_home. He caused_ his servant _to_come_along and he brought two donkeys. When he arrived there, his junior_wife caused_ him _to_enter_the_house, and when his parent-in-law saw him, he greeted him very_much. 4 And the father-in-law of the Libita asked_ him _to_stay. That is why the Libita remained for three days. They ate, drank, and slept. 5 On the fourth day, they rose_up early because they prepared to go_home. But the father of the woman said to his son-in-law, “Eat(pl) first so_that you(pl) won't be hungry there on the road; then it's time you(pl) go.”

6 Sikan naa ka nangekeen wey nangiinum sikandan. Ne migkahi ka anuhang din, “Girehe kew pa man-e wey gale-gale kew pa man-e.”

6 So then they ate and drank. And his parent-in-law said, “Stay_overnight(pl) again and have fun(pl) again.”

7 Nataman, te egligkat e man-e perem ka Libita, inggawiran man-e sikandin te anuhang din. Purisu, nekeyirehe pad man-e sikandin. 8 Te igkalalimme e ne aldew, migselem-selem sikandin mig-enew su egligkat e. Piru ingkahiyan e man-e sikandin te anuhang din, “Keen kew pa wey maapun kew e ligkat.” Sikan naa ka nangeen e man-e sikandan.

7 Then, when the Libita decided to go again, his parent-in-law asked_ him _to_stay again. Therefore, he stayed_overnight again. 8 On the fifth day, he rose_up early because (he) was ready_to_go. But he was_told again by his parent-in-law, “Eat(pl) first and go(pl) in the afternoon.” So then they ate again.

9 Te egligkat e perem ka Libita, ka duwey rin wey ka suluhuanen din, migkahi e man-e ka amey te duwey rin, “Maapun e amana wey mahaan e egkasagkup. Meupiya pad keg girehe kew pad man-e kayi wey gale-gale kew. Selem-selem kew e uli kaaselem.”

9 When the Libita, his junior_wife and his servant were prepared_to_go, the father of his junior_wife said, “It's late in the afternoon already and the sun will_set soon. It's better if you(pl) stay_overnight again here and have fun(pl). Go_home(pl) early tomorrow.”

10-11 Piru warad migpahawid ka Libita wey migligkat e sikandan ka mig-untud te daruwa ne asnu. Eglineb e ka aldew ne migginguma sikandan te Hibus (Hirusalim e kuntee seini). Sikan naa ka migkahi ka suluhuanen, “Kayi ki bu re eg-aran te siyudad te me matig-Hibus.”

10-11 But the Libita refused_to_stay and they left riding two donkeys. The sun was setting when they reached Hibus (this is Hirusalim now). So the servant said, “Perhaps we(incl) can stay_overnight here in the city of the (ones) from_Hibus.”

12 Piru migtabak ka Libita, “Kene egkaayun ne eg-aran ki kayi te kene ne inged te me Israilita. Egleus ki diye te Gibiya.” 13 Ne migkahiyan din pad man-e ka suluhuanen din, “Egpabulus ki diye te kewun-aan wey diye kid eg-aran te Gibiya wey ke Rama naa.” 14 Sikan naa ka migpabulus pad sikandan. Ne diyad sikandan nasagkupi te Gibiya ne sakup te tane ni Binhamin. 15 Migtulan sikandan diye te Gibiya eyew diyad sikandan eggirehe. Piru ware egpeyirehe kandan sikan naa ka naminpinnuu re sikandan diye te plasa te siyudad.

12 But the Libita answered, “It's_ not _possible that we(incl) stay_overnight here in the place not by the Israilitas. We(incl) will_continue there in Gibiya.” 13 And he said to his servant again, “We(incl) will_continue there ahead and we(incl) will_stay_overnight there in Gibiya or Rama.” 14 So then they continued. And they were caught_by_night in Gibiya under_the_jurisdiction of the land of Binhamin. 15 They dropped_by there in Gibiya so_that they will_stay_overnight there. But nobody was allowing_ them _to_stay_overnight that's why they just sat there in the courtyard of the city.

16 Te egkasagkup e, due buyag ne lukes ne migpuun diye te kamet din. Matig-Ipraim sikandin, piru miggalin e sikandin mig-ugpe te Gibiya ne in-ugpaan te me kabuhalan ni Binhamin. 17 Nasil-apan te buyag ne due me etew diye te plasa te siyudad, wey mig-insaan din sikandan, “Hendei kew migpuun, wey hendei kew egpabulus?”

16 When the sun_set, there_was an old man who came_from there in the field. He was from_Ipraim, but he moved to live in Gibiya the home_place of the descendants of Binhamin. 17 The old_man glanced_accidentally the people there in the courtyard of the city, and he asked them, “Where are you(pl) from, and where do you(pl) go?”

18 Ne migtabak ka Libita, “Diye key migpuun te Bitlihim ne sakup te Huda, wey eggendiye key te bubungan te Ipraim ne ugpaan ney. Miggendiye key te Bitlihim ne sakup te Huda wey eg-uli key e kuntee diye te baley ku.[fn] Kayi key pad perem eg-aran, piru ware egpeyirehe kanami. 19 Iyan ney re iya prublima ka eggirehaan su duen ma lahami ney ne igpakeen ney te me asnu ney. Ne due man-e paan ney wey binu.”

18 And the Libita answered, “We(excl) came_from Bitlihim under_the_jurisdiction of Huda, and we(excl) will_go at the mountain of Ipraim which is our(excl) home_place. We(excl) went to Bitlihim under_the_jurisdiction of Huda and we(excl) will_go_home now there in my house.[fn] We(excl) think of staying_overnight here, but no_(one) is allowing_ us(excl) _to_stay_overnight. 19 Our(excl) only problem is a place_where_to_stay because we(excl) have stalk that we(excl) feed to our(excl) donkeys. And we(excl) have bread and wine.”

20 Ne migkahi ka buyag, “Meupiya. Egpekeyirehe kew diye te baley ku. Egbehayan ku sikaniyu te minsan nekey ne keilanganen niyu, kene kew re lipereng kayi te plasa.” 21 Sikan naa ka migduma sikandan te buyag. Te pegginguma ran, impakeen te buyag ka me asnu ran. Inlu-luan dan ka me paa ran, ne nataman nangeen sikandan wey nanginum. 22 [xr]Taheed te miggale-gale sikandan, due lalung ne me etew ne sahuhune ne migginguma. Inlingutan dan ka baley te buyag wey impandukduk dan ka gumawan. Ne ingkahiyan dan ka buyag, “Palihawanga nu ka mahaliyug nu ne lukes su egguliran[fn] ney.” 23 Ne miglihawang ka buyag te baley rin wey migkahi, “Me alukuy ku, kene egkaayun. Kene kew himu te maligsem su mahaliyug ku ka seini ne lukes. 24 Due anak ku ne mengebay, wey due duwey te mahaliyug ku ne lukes. Igpalihawang ku sikandan kuntee, wey himuwa niyu ke nekey ka igkeupii niyu ne eggimuwen kandan. Piru kene niyu himuwa seini se maligsem te mahaliyug ku.” 25 Piru ware migpammineg kandin ka me lalung. Sikan naa ka impalihawang e te Libita ka duwey rin wey imbehey e kandan. Impehes dan te egleheng ka malitan wey inggilabetan dan taman te napawaan. Ne wey ran e peen-enengi ke egpamalat-palat e.

20 And the old_man said, “Good. You(pl) can stay_overnight in my house. I will_give you(pl) anything that you(pl) need, just don't(pl) sleep here in the courtyard.” 21 That's why they accompanied with the old_man. When they arrived, the old_man fed their donkeys. They washed their feet, and then they ate and drank. 22 [xr]While they were enjoying, there were crazy people who suddenly came. They surrounded the house of the old_man and the pounded the door. And they said to the old_man, “Send_out your(sg) male visitor because we(excl) will_sleep_with_him.”[fn] 23 The old_man went_out of his house and said, “My friends, not possible. Don't(pl) do dirty_thing because this man is my visitor. 24 I have a maiden child, and there's a junior_wife of my male visitor. I will_send_ them _out now, and do(pl) what you(pl) like to do with them. But don't(pl) do this dirty_thing to my visitor.” 25 But the crazy (ones) didn't listen to him. That's why the Libita sent_out his junior_wife and gave to them. They forced to rape the woman and they used_ her _sexually until the morning. And they stopped when the dawn_came.

26 Egkaliwaswas e ne nakalibed ka malitan, wey diye de iya nakabahed sikandin te gumawan te baley te buyag ne intuenan te asawa rin. Ne diyad sikandin napawei. 27 Te inlukatan e te Libita ka gumawan, su egligkat e sikandin, iyan din e nakita se duwey rin ne nakabahed de wey nakahen-gen naan de te gumawan. 28 Ne migkahi ka Libita, “Enew kad su eggipanew kid.” Piru napatey bes e ka duwey rin. Purisu, indulan din e ka duwey rin te asnu, wey migpabulus sikandin ka mig-uli. 29 Te pegginguma rin diye te baley rin, migkuwa sikandin te ugpit wey insapu din ka lawa te duwey rin te sapulu wey daruwa ne sapu, wey impamehey rin seini diye intiru ne inged ne sakup te Israil. 30 Nakakahi ka langun ne nakakita, “Keyey, ware de due nakita ta, wey ke neyitabu naa ne iling kayi puun pad te peg-awe ta te Ihiptu. Egmalalahey ki wey egmasabsabutey ki ke nekey-a ka eleg ne eggimuwen ta!”

26 The woman returned at daybreak, and she fell_down at the door of the old_man's house where her spouse stayed. And she was there until_the_morning_came. 27 When the Libita opened the door, for he was ready_to_go, what he saw was his junior_wife lying_down and just holding the door. 28 And the Libita said, “Rise_up because we(incl) are_going.” But his junior_wife [surprise] dead already. Therefore, he loaded his junior_wife on his donkey, and he continued going_home. 29 On his arrival in his house, he took a knife and he cut the body of his junior_wife into twelve pieces, and he gave it to the entire places under_the_jurisdiction of Israil. 30 All who saw (it) said, “Oh my, we(incl) haven't seen, or anything_happened like this since we(incl) left from Ihiptu. We(incl) will_take_to_each_other and we(incl) will_discuss_with_each_other what's the right_thing that we(incl) will_do!”

Ka pegpangandam te me Israilita te gira

The preparing of the Israilitas to fight

201 Ne miglibulung ka langun ne kabuhalan ni Israil diye te tangkaan te Magbebaye ne Manama diye te Mispa. Ka duma kandan egpuun te Dan ne dapit te igkahibang ne balabahan, wey Biir-Siba ne dapit te igkakawanan ne balabahan, lagkes seeye se diye nangugpe te talipag te Weyig ne Hurdan diye te Gilyad ne dapit te igsile. 2 Mig-apil degma ka me pangulu te langun ne kabuhalan ni Israil te peglibulung te keet-etawan te Manama. Migginguma te hep-at ne gatus ne libu (400,000) ka me sundalu ne iyan panganiban se kampilan.

201 And all the descendants of Israil gathered together there in front of the Lord there in Mispa. Some of them were from Dan which was in the north (LIT on the left_side), and Biir-Siba which was in the south (LIT on the right_side), including those(pl) who lived there in the opposite_bank of the Hurdan Water which was in Gilyad in the east. 2 The leaders of all the descendants of Israil gathered also with the people of God. The soldiers armed with swords numbered four hundred thousand (400,000).

3 (Nakataha ka me kabuhalan ni Binhamin ne miglibulung ka me Israilita diye te Mispa.)

3 (The descendants of Binhamin knew that the Israilitas gathered in Mispa.)

Ne mig-inse ka me Israilita, “Nangeni key mania te neyitabu ka seini se mareet ne himu?”

And the Israilitas asked, “Tell(pl) us(excl) why this evil action happened?”

4 Ne migtabak ka Libita ne asawa te malitan ne inggimatayan, “Migtulan key te duwey ku diye te Gibiya ne sakup te tane ni Binhamin eyew eg-aran key pad diye. 5 Te marusilem e, due migginguma ne lalung ne me pangulu te Gibiya wey inlingutan dan ka baley ne intuenan ney. Eggimatayan a perem nikandan wey impehes te eggilabet ka duwey ku taman te napatey sikandin. 6 Ne in-uyan ku ka lawa rin wey insapu ku seini te sapulu wey daruwa[fn] (12) wey indulung ku seini diye te intiru ne inged ne sakup te Israil, tenged su subla ne dereeti ka inggimu ran wey lilinditi seini. 7 Ne kuntee, sikaniyu se me Israilita, lalag kew naan e ke nekey ka eleg ne eggimuwen ta.”

4 And the Libita who was the spouse of the murdered woman, “My junior_wife and I stopped_by in Gibiya under_the_jurisdiction of the land of Binhamin in_order for us(excl) stay_overnight there. 5 When evening came, there were crazy leaders of Gibiya and they surrounded the house that we(excl) stayed_in. I was about to be_killed by them and they raped my junior_wife until she died. 6 I brought her body and I cut it in twelve[fn] (12) and I delivered it to the entire place under_the_jurisdiction of Israil, because what_ they _did was very evil and it was very_dirty. 7 And now, you(pl) Israilitas, speak(pl) what's the right_thing that we(excl) will_do.”

8 Ne miglegse ka langun ne etew migsasindeg wey migkahi, “Ware sabeka kanta ne eg-uli diye te balungbalung ta wey ke baley te naa. 9 Na, seini ka eggimuwen ta te Gibiya: eglusuran ta sikandan wey egpintut-pintut ke hentew kanta ka eglusud. 10 Eg-angey ki te me etew te langun ne kabuhalan ni Israil eyew iyan egbehey te egkakeen te me sundalu ta. Ke due mahatus (100) ne etew te sabeka ne kabuhalan, ne sapulu ka egkuen ta kandan. Ne emun ke sapulu ne libu (10,000) sikandan, ne mahatus ka egkuen ta kandan. Ne ka egkasame iyan egparusa te Gibiya tenged te maligsem ne inggimu ran te Israil.” 11 Sikan naa ka nekeg-uyun ka langun ne Israilita ne eglibulung eyew eglusud te Gibiya.

8 And all the people stood together and said, “No (one) among us(incl) will_go_home to our(incl) tent or house. 9 Now_then, this is what we(incl) do with Gibiya: we(incl) will_attack them and cast_lot who among us(excl) will_attack. 10 We(incl) will_take men from all the descendants of Israil who will_give good to our(excl) soldiers. And if there's one hundred (100) men of one descendant, then they we(incl) will_take ten from them. And if they are ten thousand (10,000), then we(incl) will_take one hundred of them. And the remainder will_be the one to punish Gibiya because of their dirty action in Israil.” 11 That's why all the Israilitas agreed to gather in_order to attack Gibiya.

12 Ne due me etew ne insuhu te me kabuhalan ne Israil, wey impakahiyan dan ka kabuhalan ni Binhamin, “Amana ne dereeti ka inggimu niyu due. 13 Ne kuntee, ibehey niyud kanami ka lalung ne me etew ne miggimu te mareet due te kaniyu eyew eggimatayan ney eyew egkaawe e ka dereeti ne neyitabu te Israil.” Piru ware linglingaa te me kabuhalan ni Binhamin ka karumaan dan ne me Israilita. 14 Nasi de iya sikandan migsaamul te me matig-Gibiya eyew egpakiggira te me karumaan dan ne me Israilita. 15 Te seeye ne aldew, nalibulung ka me kabuhalan ni Binhamin wey due daruwa ne pulu wey hen-em ne libu (26,000) ne sundalu ran, ware pad labet te pitu ne gatus (700) ne bahani ne me sundalu te Gibiya. 16 Ne due nakasewug ne gibang ne me bahani ne me sundalu, wey me tummawan sikandan ne eglambuyug te batu su egkasuhat dan minsan ka bulbul ne deisek. Me tummawan iya sikandan. 17 Ne nakaalam degma ka me Israilita te hep-at ne gatus ne libu (400,000) ne me sundalu wey neelin sikandan langun ne me bahani. Ne ware dan pad ilagkes te egseel ka me sundalu ne me kabuhalan ni Binhamin.

12 And there were people that were commanded_to_go by the descendants of Israil, and caused_ them _to_tell the descendants of Binhamin, “What_ you(pl) _did was very evil. 13 Now then, give(pl) us(excl) the crazy people among you(pl) who did evil so_that we(excl) will_kill_them in_order that the very_bad_thing that happened in Israil will_be_removed.” But the descendants of Binhamin didn't pay_attention to their relatives Israilitas. 14 On_the_contrary they just joined with the (ones) from_Gibiya in_order to fight against their relatives the Israilitas. 15 On that day, the descendants of Binhamin gathered and their soldiers were twenty-six thousand (26,000), not including the seven hundred (700) warrior soldiers of Gibiya. 16 And among were left-handed warrior soldiers, and they were trained_to_hit_the_target by swinging_a_sling with stone because they can hit even the small hair. They were indeed shooter. 17 And the Israilitas also chose four hundred thousand (400,000) soldiers who were all warriors. And they didn't include in counting the soldiers who were descendants of Binhamin.

Ka peggira te me Israilita te kabuhalan ni Binhamin

The warring of the Isrealites and the descendants of Binhamin

18 Ne nangendiye ka me Israilita te Bitil eyew eg-inse te Manama. Migkahi sikandan, “Hentew ne kabuhalan ka eggun-a ne egpakiggira te me kabuhalan ni Binhamin?”

18 And the Israilitas went to Bitil in_order to ask God. They said, “Whose descendant will_go first to fight with the descendants of Binhamin?”

Migtabak ka Magbebaye ne Manama, “Iyan eggun-a ka kabuhalan ni Huda.”

The Lord God said, “The descendant of Huda will_go first.”

19 Te maselem e, migselem-selem ka me Israilita ne nangekampu diye te marani te Gibiya. 20 Nangendiye sikandan eyew egpakigkuntere te kabuhalan ni Binhamin wey migpangandam e sikandan ka eglusud te Gibiya.

19 On the morning, the Israilitas rose_early and camped there near Gibiya. 20 They went_there in_order to fight against the descendants of Binhamin and they prepared to attack Gibiya.

21 Ne migligkat e diye te Gibiya ka me sundalu te me kabuhalan ni Binhamin wey migpabunbunuey e te me Israilita. Te seeye ne aldew, daruwa ne pulu wey daruwa ne libu (22,000) ne me Israilita ka neyimatayan te kabuhalan ni Binhamin. 22-23 Ne nangendiyad e man-e ka me Israilita te Bitil, wey naninehew sikandan diye taman te marusilem. Ne mig-insaan dan ka Manama, “Egpakigbunu key naan pad te me karumaan ney ne me kabuhalan ni Binhamin?”

21 And the soldiers of the descendants of Binhamin left Gibiya and they fought with Israilitas. On that day, twenty-two thousand (22,000) Israilitas were_killed by the descendants of Binhamin. 22-23 And the Israilitas went to Bitil again, and they cried there until the evening. And they asked God, “Are we(excl) going to fight yet with our(excl) relatives the descendants of Binhamin?”

Ne migtabak ka Manama, “Uya.”

And God answered, “Yes.”

Sikan naa ka nabagget ka me Israilita. Ne migpangandam e man-e sikandan diye te inged ne inggiraan dan te miglihad ne aldew.24 Te seup ne aldew, inlusuran dan e man-e ka kabuhalan ni Binhamin. 25 Te seini ne timpu, insinug-ung sikandan te kabuhalan ni Binhamin puun te Gibiya. Ne napatayan e man-e sikandan te sapulu wey walu ne libu (18,000) ne iyan panganiban se kampilan. 26 Ne nangendiyad e man-e ka langun ne Israilita te Bitil ka eglungku. Migpinnuu sikandan ka egsinehew diye te tangkaan te Manama. Migpuasa sikandan taman te marusilem wey nanguyan te egmanutungen ne igpanubad, wey me halad eyew egpekeg-uli ka meupiya ne geyinawa ran te Manama. 27 Ne mig-inse ka me Israilita diye te Magbebaye ne Manama. Te seeye ne timpu, diye te Bitil ka Tahuanan te Kasabutan te Magbebaye. 28 Iyan migtalipun dutu si Pinihas ne anak ni Iliyasar ne anak ni Aarun. Ne mig-inse e man-e ka me Israilita te Magbebaye ne Manama, “Egpakigkuntere key naan pad man-e te karumaan ney ne me kabuhalan ni Binhamin, wey ke kenad e?”

So then the Israilitas were encouraged. And they prepared again there in the place where_ they _fought_with on the previous day.24 On the following day, they attack again the descendants of Binhamin. 25 In this time, they were met by the descendants of Binhamin from Gibiya. And eighteen thousand (18,000) died among them whose weapon were swords. 26 And all the Israilitas went to Bitil again in_order to mourn. They were seated crying there in front of God. They fasted until the evening and brought for burning sacrifices, and offerings in_order to restore their good breath/love with God. 27 And the Israilitas asked there to the Lord God. At that time, the Container of the Agreement of the Lord was in Bitil. 28 The one who took_care of it was Pinihas the child of Iliyasar the child of Aarun. And the Israilitas asked the Lord God again, “Are we(excl) going to fight yet against our(excl) relatives the descendants of Binhamin, or not anymore?”

Migtabak ka Manama, “Lusuri niyu sikandan, su kaaselem igpepanalu ku sikaniyu kandan.”

God answered, “Attack(pl) them, because tomorrow I will_cause_ you(pl) _to_win_over them.”

29 Purisu, impalingutan te me Israilita te me sundalu ne eggepas ka Gibiya. 30 Te igkatelu ne aldew, inlusuran dan ka kabuhalan ni Binhamin diye te seeye ded ne inged. 31 Ne nanlihawang ka me kabuhalan ni Binhamin ka egkuntere te me Israilita taman te nakapariyu e sikandan te siyudad. Ne due tatelu ne pulu (30) ne me Israilita ne neyimatayan dan diye te me deralanen te Bitil wey Gibiya. 32 Migkahi ka me kabuhalan ni Binhamin, “Natalu te red man-e sikandan.”

29 Therefore, the Israilitas caused_ the soldiers in ambush _to_surround Gibiya. 30 On the third day, they attacked the descendants of Binhamin there on the same place. 31 And the descendants of Binhamin came_out to fight against the Israilitas until they were drawn_away from the city. And there were thirty (30) Israilitas who were_killed by them there in the roads of Bitil and Gibiya. 32 The descendants of Binhamin said, “We(incl) defeated them again.”

Piru migkahi ka me Israilita, “Eg-isues ki wey egpalupuhen ta sikandan kanta diye te deralanen eyew egpakapariyu sikandan te siyudad dan.”33 Ne mig-isues ka me sundalu te Israil wey nanlibulung sikandan diye te Baal-Tamar taheed te nanlihawang e ka duma ne me Israilita ne miglingut miggepas diye te Gibiya. 34 Migginguma te sapulu ne libu (10,000) ka in-alam ne me bahani ne miggun-a miglusud te Gibiya. Ne amana ne makaalat-halat ka gira ran wey ware nataheyi te me kabuhalan ni Binhamin ne mahaan e sikandan egkatalu. 35 Ne imbulihan te Magbebaye ne Manama ne egkatalu te me sundalu te me kabuhalan ni Israil ka me sundalu te me kabuhalan ni Binhamin. Te seeye ne aldew nekeyimatey sikandan te daruwa ne pulu wey lalimma ne libu wey sabeka ne gatus (25,100) ne me sundalu te me kabuhalan ni Binhamin. 36 Ne nasahimanu te me kabuhalan ni Binhamin ne natalu e sikandan.

But the Israilitas said, “We(incl) will_retreat and let_ them _chase us(incl) there on the roads in_order that they will_be_drawn_away from their cities.”33 And the soldiers of Israil retreated and they gathered there in Baal-Tamar while the other Israilitas who hid in ambush there in Gibiya went_out. 34 The number of the chosen warriors to attack first Gibiya was ten thousand (10,000). And the war was terrifying and the descendants of Binhamin didn't know that they will_be_defeated in short_time. 35 The Lord God helped the armies/soldiers of the descendants of Israil to win over the armies/soldiers of the descendants of Benjamin. That day they killed 25,100 armies/soldiers of the descendants of Benjamin. 36 And the descendants of Binhamin realized that they were_defeated already.

Nangisues ka me Israilita tenged su migsalig ma sikandan te me duma ran ne miggepas miglingut diye te Gibiya.37 Ne miggaan-gaan miglusud ka me etew ne nanggepas diye te Gibiya wey inggule dan te egpanibas ka langun ne etew diye te siyudad. 38 Due tuus te me Israilita ne namallahuy wey seeye se me etew ne nanggepas, emun ke egpakakite e sikandan te dakel ne ebel diye te siyudad, 39 eglibed e ka me Israilita ne namallahuy, eyew egpakiggira te kabuhalan ni Binhamin. Te seeye ne timpu, nakapatey ka kabuhalan ni Binhamin te tatelu ne pulu (30) ne me Israilita. Nakakahi sikandan, “Natalu te red man-e ka me Israilita.” 40 Piru te migbunsud e mig-eebel ka siyudad, miglilingey ka me kabuhalan ni Binhamin wey nakita ran ne nasilaban e ka intiru ne siyudad dan, wey dakel amana ka ebel. 41 Ne migpalilibed e ka me Israilita wey naliyasan ka kabuhalan ni Binhamin su natahaan dan ne egkahunaan e sikandan. 42 Namallahuy sikandan peendiye te disirtu, piru neumaan ded sikandan. Neeletan sikandan te susuluhi ne me sundalu ne nanlihawang ne egpuun te siyudad. 43 Warad egkapallahuyan dan su inlingutan sikandan te me Israilita wey neumaan dan sikandan diye te igsile te Gibiya. 44 Migginguma te sapulu wey walu ne libu (18,000) ka migpatey ne bahani ne me sundalu te kabuhalan ni Binhamin. 45 Namallahuy ka duma diye te disirtu peendiye te pahangen te Rimun. Nakapatey ka me Israilita te lalimma ne libu (5,000) diye te deralanen. Impanalukunan dan ka duma peendiye te inged ne Gidum, wey nakapatey pad man-e sikandan te daruwa ne libu (2,000) ne etew. 46 Migginguma ka neyimatayan ne bahani ne me sundalu te kabuhalan ni Binhamin te daruwa ne pulu wey lalimma ne libu (25,000).

The Israilitas retreated because they trusted on their companions who hid in ambush around Gibiya.37 Then the people who were in ambush attacked quickly to Gibiya and they struck_with_swords all the people in the city. 38 There was a sign of the Israilitas who ran and those people in ambush, if they will_see an big smoke in the city, 39 the Israilitas who ran_away will_return, in_order to fight with the descendants of Binhamin. At that time, the descendants of Binhamin were able_to_kill thirty (30) Israilitas. They were able_to_say, “We(incl) defeated again the Israilitas.” 40 But when the city started to smoke, the descendants of Binhamin turned around and they saw that the entire city was_burned, and the smoke was very big. 41 And the Israilitas returned and the descendants of Binhamin were terrified because they knew that they were in trouble. 42 They ran_away going to the desert, but they were caught_up_to. They were stopped by many soldiers that came_out from the city. 43 They had nothing to run_away_to because they were surrounded by the Israilitas and they caught_ them _up there in the east of Gibiya. 44 The number of the dead warrior soldiers of the descendants of Binhamin was eighteen thousand (18,000). 45 Others ran_away to the desert going to the rocky_place of Rimun. The Israilitas were able_to_kill five thousand (5,000) there in the roads. They chased others going to the place of Gidum, and they were able_to_kill two thousand (2,000) men. 46 The warrior soldiers of the descendants of Binhamin who were_killed were twenty-five thousand (25,000).

47 Piru due nakapallahuy ne hen-em ne gatus (600) ne etew diye te disirtu diye te pahangen te Rimun, wey migtagtaheed sikandan mig-ugpe diye te hep-at ne bulan. 48 Ne migmanlibed ka me kabuhalan ni Israil wey impangimatayan dan ka langun ne etew wey me mananap ne neumaan dan. Ne impanilaban dan degma ka langun ne lungsud ne nenaliharan dan.

47 But there were six hundred (600) men who were able_to_run there in the rocky_place of Rimun, and they stayed there temporarily for four months. 48 And the descendants of Israil returned and (they) killed all the people and animals (that) they_have_reached. They also burned_down(pl) all the towns (that) they_have passed_by.

Ka me asawa te kabuhalan ni Binhamin

The spouses of the descendants of Binhamin

211 Ne migsaad ka me Israilita diye te Mispa. Migkahi sikandan, “Kene ta igpaasawa te me kabuhalan ni Binhamin ka me anak ta ne me malitan.” 2 Ne nangendiye sikandan te Bitil wey nanlungku sikandan diye te tangkaan te Manama. Migpandalawit sikandan taman te marusilem. 3 Migkahi sikandan, “He Magbebaye ne Manama te Israil, mania te neyitabu seini te Israil? Mania te naawaan te sabeka ne kabuhalan ka Israil?”

211 And the Israilitas made_promises there at Mispa. They said, “None of us(incl) will_give_in_marriage our(incl) female children to the descendant(s) of Binhamin.” 2 And they went(pl) to Bitil and they grieved(pl) there in front of God. They wept until night/darkness. 3 They said, “Oh Lord God of Israil, why has this happened to Israil? Why has one descendant been_removed_from Israil?”

4 Te maselem e, miggimu sikandan te altar diye te Bitil. Ne mig-uyan sikandan te egtutungen ne igpanubad wey me halad eyew egpekeg-uli ka meupiya ne geyinawa ran te Manama. 5 Ne migpein-inseey ka me Israilita te migkahi, “Hentew ne kabuhalan ka ware mig-apil te peglibulung ta diye te tangkaan te Magbebaye ne Manama diye te Mispa?” (Su nakasaad ma sikandan ne eggimatayan dan ka kene eggendiye te tangkaan te Manama.) 6 Piru neyid-u ka me Israilita te karumaan dan ne kabuhalan ni Binhamin. Migkahi sikandan, “Kuntee ne aldew, naawaan ka Israil te sabeka ne kabuhalan. 7 Nekey ka eggimuwen ta eyew egpakaasawa ka seeye se nenasame, te nakasaad ki ma te Magbebaye ne Manama ne kene ta igpaasawa kandan ka me anak ta ne me malitan?”

4 In the morning, they made an altar there. And they brought sacrifice(s) to burn and offerings so_that good breath/love would_return_between them and God. 5 And the Israilitas asked_each_other saying, “Which descendants didn't attend our(incl) meeting at Mispa in front of the Lord God?” (Because they had_promised that they would_kill the (one/s who) didn't go_there to the front of God.) 6 But the Israilitas were_sympathetic of their companions the descendant(s) of Binhamin. They said, “Today, Israil has lost one descendant. 7 What shall_ we(incl) _do so_that those remaining(pl) can_marry, when we(incl) promised the Lord God that we(incl) wouldn't give_in_marriage our(incl) female children to them?”

8 Ne migkahi sikandan, “Hentew ka ware mig-apil ne kabuhalan te Israil te peglibulung ta diye te tangkaan te Magbebaye ne Manama diye te Mispa?” Ne natahaan dan ne ware matig-Habis-Gilyad ne mig-apil te peglibulung. 9 Inseel ran ka me etew wey puun due, natahaan dan ne ware matig-Habis-Gilyad diye. 10 Purisu, migsuhu sikandan te sapulu wey daruwa ne libu (12,000) ne bahani ne me sundalu wey ingkahiyan dan, “Hendiye kew te Habis-Gilyad wey pangimatayi niyu ka langun ne mahinged diye, lagkes ka me malitan wey ka me bate. 11 Pangimatayi niyu ka langun ne me lukes lagkes ka me malitan ne neyilabetan e. Piru kene niyu re ilagkes ka ware pad neneyilabeti.” 12 Ne nakakita sikandan te hep-at ne gatus (400) ne mengebay ne me mahinged te Habis-Gilyad wey in-uyan dan sikandan diye te kampu ran diye te Silu ne sakup te Kanaan.

8 And they said, “Who was the descendant of Israil that wasn't included at our(incl) gathering there in front of the Lord God there at Mispa?” And they discovered that no_(one) from_Habis-Gilyad had attended the gathering. 9 They counted the people and from that, they knew that there were none from_Habis-Gilyad there. 10 Therefore, they commanded twelve thousand (12,000) soldiers that were warriors and they told (them), “Go(pl) to Habis-Gilyad and kill(pl) all the locals there, including the women and children. 11 Kill(pl) all the men including the women who had_sexual_relations already. But don't(pl) include the maidens who haven't been_sexually_active.” 12 And they found four hundred (400) marriageable_women that were locals of Habis in Gilyad and they brought the marriageable_women to their camp at Silu under_the_jurisdiction of Kanaan.

13 Nataman, migsuhu ka langun ne kabuhalan ni Israil ne egpakahiyan ka me kabuhalan ni Binhamin diye te pahangen te Rimun, “Egkaayun e ne eg-uli kew su neimpusan e ka gubut.” 14 Sikan naa ka nanguli e ka kabuhalan ni Binhamin, wey imbehey e kandan te me Israilita ka me mengebay ne egpuun te Habis-Gilyad. Piru ware de nakaatul ka me malitan kandan.

13 Then, the all descendants of Israil commanded the descendants of Binhamin there at the rocky_place of Rimun, “It's_possible now that you(pl) return_home because the conflict is finished.” 14 That's why the descendant(s) of Binhamin returned_home(pl), and they were_given by the Israilitas the marriageable_women from Habis-Gilyad. But the women weren't sufficient_to_go_around them.

15 Nalaggew ka me Israilita te kabuhalan ni Binhamin tenged su in-awe e te Magbebaye ne Manama ka kabuhalan ni Binhamin te kabuhalan ni Israil. 16 Ne migkahi ka me pangulu te me kabuhalan ni Israil, “Warad nasame ne malitan te kabuhalan ni Binhamin. Nekey naan e ka eggimuwen ta eyew due egkaasawa te seeye se ware pad asawa? 17 Keilangan ne kene egkaawaan ka Israil te sabeka ne kabuhalan. Keilangan ne due eggimuwen ta eyew egkabuhal red ka me kabuhalan ni Binhamin ne nasame. 18 Piru kene egkaayun ne igpaasawa ta kandan ka me anak ta ne me mengebay.” Nalalag dan seeye su nakasaad e sikandan ne egdilusen dan seeye se egpaasawa te me kabuhalan ni Binhamin.

15 The Israilitas were_sad for the descendant(s) of Binhamin because the Lord God removed Binhamin in the descendants of Israil. 16 And the leaders of the Israilitas said, “There's_no remaining women for the descendant(s) of Binhamin. What shall_ we(incl) _do so_that those still without spouse(s) can_marry? 17 Israil must not lose one descendant. We(excl) must do something so_that the remainder of the descendants of Binhamin will_ still _multiply. 18 But it's_ not _possible for us(incl) to cause_ our(incl) maiden children _marry them.” They were able_to_say that because they made_a_promise that they will_curse those who allow_ the descendants of Binhamin _marry_them.

19 Sikan naa ka migkahi sikandan, “Due sahakeen tagse leg-un diye te Silu para te Magbebaye ne Manama.” (Diye ka Silu te igkahibang ne balabahan te Bitil, ne igkakawanan ne balabahan te Libuna, wey kewun-aan te dalan te Bitil peendiye te Sikim.)

19 That's why they said, “There's a feast every year there in Silu for the Lord God.” (Silu was there on the north (LIT left_side) of Bitil, which was on south (LIT right side) of Libuna, and beyond the path of Bitil going to Sikim.)

20-21 Ne ingkahiyan dan ka me kabuhalan ni Binhamin, “Hendiye kew te parasan wey heles kew diye. Ne emun ke eglihawang e ka me malitan ne matig-Silu ne egsesayew, lihawang kew puun te me parasan wey kuwa kew e te eg-asawaan niyu wey uyana niyu sikandan te inged niyu. 22 Ne emun ke egsumbung kanami ka me amey ran wey ke me maama ran naa, egkahiyan ney sikandan, ‘Paasawei niyu ubag sikandan te me anak niyu tenged su ware sikandan naatul te me mengebay ne naangey ney diye te Habis-Gilyad. Kene kew red egkarilus su kene ma sikaniyu ka mig-uney-uney migpaasawa te me anak niyu kandan.’ ”

20-21 And they told the descendants of Binhamin, “Go(pl) in grapevines_field and hide(pl) there. And if the women of Silu are coming_out to dance, come_out(pl) from the grapevines_field and take(pl) those_ you(pl) _will_marry_with and bring(pl) them in your(pl) place. 22 And if there fathers or brothers protest to us(excl), we(excl) will_tell them, ‘Please cause_ them _to_marry your(pl) children because they were not given_each a unmarried_woman that we(excl) took from Habis-Gilyad. You(pl) won't be cursed because it's not you(pl) personally caused_ your(pl) children _to_marry them.’ ”

23 Ne intuman seini te me kabuhalan ni Binhamin. Taheed te nanesayew ka me malitan, mig-alam ka tagse sabeka kandan te malitan wey impehes dan sikandan uyana eyew eg-asaween dan. Ne nanguli e sikandan diye te ugpaan dan wey imbalbalawan dan te eggimu ka me lungsud dan wey diyad sikandan nangugpe. 24 Ne migmanguli e degma ka me Israilita diye te ugpaan dan wey te me pamilya ran.

23 And the descendants of Binhamin obeyed it. While the women were dancing, each one of them chose a woman and they brought them against_their_will in_order that they marry (them). And they went_home to their living_place(s) and they built again ther towns and they lived(pl) there. 24 And the Israilitas went_home also there in their home_places and to their families.

25 [xr]Te seeye ne timpu, ware Hari te Israil, sikan naa ka minsan nekey re due ka eggimuwen dan, ne kahiyen dan ne eleg kun iya.

25 [xr]At that time, Israil had no king, that's why they just did whatever_things, which they thought that (it) correct indeed.
